title: Product Manager
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**Product Manager**
,
**Shipping as a Service**
(L24)
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.**
Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.
* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.
* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.
* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.
* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.
* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.
* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.
* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.
* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.
* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.
* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

**What You Will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.
* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.
* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.
* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.
* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.
* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.
* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Platform Vision
  
  

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Build the narrative for why orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders
* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging
  
  

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention
* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing
* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date
* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.
* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight
  
  

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders
* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either
* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication
  
  

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences
* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)
* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)
* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)
* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns
* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)
* Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products
* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)
* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models
* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.
  
  
Commvault’s goal is to make interviewing inclusive and accessible to all candidates and employees. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to participate in the interview process or apply for a position at Commvault, please email accommodations@commvault.com For any inquiries not related to an accommodation please reach out to wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com.

title: Group Product Manager
description:
Licious is building the future of fresh meat and seafood in India. We operate at the intersection of
**consumer technology, fresh-food supply chain, operations and last-mile delivery**
, solving some of the most complex problems in the consumer internet space.

With a large and growing daily order base across multiple cities, our last mile is a critical part of both the
**customer experience and business economics**
. We are now investing in building a more technology-led, high-control and scalable last-mile network.

**What makes the role meaty...**

As the
**Group Product Manager**
, you will own the
**end-to-end product charter across Licious' logistics and delivery network — spanning first mile, mid mile and last mile**
, including Delivery Executives (DEs), 3P delivery partners and other frontline stakeholders.

Your charter will be to build and scale the technology that enables Licious to create a
**high-control, intelligent and scalable logistics network**
, while continuously improving customer experience, operational efficiency and unit economics.

You will:

* Own the
  **product roadmap across first mile, mid mile and last mile**
  , covering movement of inventory, order allocation, dispatch, transportation, delivery execution, exceptions and completion.
* Drive improvements in
  **SLA adherence — promised delivery time vs. actual delivery time**
  , cost efficiency and overall logistics unit economics.
* Partner deeply with
  **Supply Chain and Operations**
  to identify ground-level problems across the first, mid and last mile and build technology that improves
  **efficiency, productivity, predictability and control**
  .
* Own and evolve products and applications used by
  **Delivery Executives, frontline teams and logistics partners**
  , including the roadmap for future app-store deployment where relevant.
* Build the next generation of frontline workforce capabilities across
  **hiring, onboarding, L&D, incentives, gamification, engagement and performance tracking**
  .
* Improve the overall
  **Delivery Executive / frontline workforce experience**
  while ensuring a superior customer experience.
* Build frameworks to compare
  **3P vs. owned models**
  across CX, workforce experience, SLA adherence, productivity and unit economics.
* Leverage
  **AI and automation as first principles**
  to rethink how logistics products are designed, operated and scaled — moving beyond simply adding AI features to existing workflows.
* Develop an
  **AI-native product mindset**
  , identifying opportunities where AI agents, intelligent decisioning, predictive systems and automation can fundamentally change operational workflows and improve outcomes.
* Work closely with
  **Engineering, Data, AI/ML, Operations, CX and Business teams**
  to translate complex operational problems into scalable product solutions.
* Use data, experimentation and strong product judgment to identify the biggest levers for improving
  **speed, reliability, productivity and cost efficiency**
  .
* Coach and mentor
  **Product Managers and emerging product leaders**
  , raising the bar on product thinking, execution, stakeholder management and customer-centricity.
* Help shape the technology and operating model that will enable Licious to scale its logistics network across cities while maintaining high levels of
  **control, reliability and profitability**
  .

This is a role where
**Product meets real-world operations at significant scale**
. You will not just build software — you will influence how thousands of orders and inventory movements happen every day, how frontline teams experience the platform, and how Licious balances
**customer experience, operational efficiency and profitability**
.

It is an opportunity to solve problems across the
**entire logistics journey — from the first movement of inventory to the final delivery to the customer**
— while building products that can increasingly leverage
**AI, automation and intelligent decision-making**
.

**We hope that you have…**

**Education**

* A Bachelor's degree in
  **Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related discipline**
  .
* An MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus, but
  **strong product experience will be valued over academic credentials**
  .

**Experience**

* **6–8 years of Product Management experience**
  , with meaningful experience owning and scaling products and ideally having led or mentored Product Managers.
* Experience in
  **logistics, supply chain, last-mile delivery, mobility, e-commerce, quick commerce, food delivery, hyperlocal or other operationally intensive businesses**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **first mile, mid mile and/or last mile operations**
  , including networks, dispatch, order allocation, routing, capacity, SLAs and unit economics.
* Experience building products with a significant
  **ground operations / frontline workforce component**
  .
* Proven ability to use metrics and data to drive outcomes such as
  **on-time delivery, cost per delivery, productivity, utilisation, throughput and customer experience**
  .
* Experience working closely with
  **Operations, Engineering, Data Science/AI, CX and Business teams**
  .
* Strong product thinking and the ability to balance
  **customer needs, operational realities and business economics**
  .
* An
  **AI-native mindset**
  — you naturally think about how AI, automation, agents and intelligent decision-making can fundamentally change the way products and operational workflows are built.
* Experience coaching, mentoring or developing
  **Product Managers and product talent**
  .
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the solution requires a combination of
  **technology, process, AI and operational change**
  .

**It would be great if you have…**

* Built or scaled a
  **Driver / Rider / Delivery Executive / frontline workforce app**
  .
* Experience across
  **first mile, mid mile and last mile**
  logistics or supply-chain products.
* Experience transitioning from or operating across
  **3P and owned delivery/fleet models**
  .
* Experience with
  **workforce management, gig-worker platforms or frontline workforce products**
  .
* Exposure to
  **incentives, gamification, engagement or productivity management**
  for frontline teams.
* Experience scaling products across
  **multiple cities and high daily transaction volumes**
  .
* Exposure to
  **routing, dispatch optimisation, ETA prediction, logistics optimisation or network planning**
  .
* Experience using
  **AI/ML, intelligent automation or agentic workflows**
  to solve operational or customer problems.
* A track record of
  **coaching and mentoring product talent**
  and building a strong product culture.

title: Product Manager
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Role Summary**
The International Enablement team is seeking a Product Manager to define what we measure and how we track it across Delta’s digital platforms, including the Fly Delta App, delta.com, and our airport kiosks. Sitting at the intersection of product, business, and data, this role owns the measurement strategy for digital and international customer experiences – determining the metrics and KPIs the product team needs, then partnering with data engineers to source, model, and deliver.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Lead dashboard strategy and design, transforming complex data into intuitive, insight-driven experiences that support business decision-making.
* Develop customer journey measurement frameworks, defining funnel KPIs, key interaction points, and supporting data requirements.
* Translate business needs into scalable data strategies, data products, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
* Own the analytics product backlog, prioritizing features and capabilities based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Lead the lifecycle of analytics products from discovery and definition through delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Define and communicate the vision, strategy, and roadmap for international analytics and measurement capabilities.
* Develop customer journey measurement frameworks, defining funnel KPIs, key interaction points, and supporting data requirements.
* Define the metrics, KPIs, and measurement framework that the product team needs to track the digital customer experience, servicing performance, and outcomes
* Establish and govern standardized metric definitions, classifications, and units of measure to ensure a single source of truth across teams
* Identify gaps in current data availability and define the requirements needed to close them
* Develop and execute enablement strategies that support Delta’s international growth and partner success
* Serve as a liaison between Delta and global partners to ensure alignment on technology integration and customer experience goals
* Create and own a cross-domain international technical roadmap and centralized backlog
* Collaborate with Commercial and IT teams to implement scalable solutions for international operations and partner engagement
* Evaluate enterprise-wide tradeoffs and make decisions that optimize reliability and partner outcomes
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI and Generative AI related use cases that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency and business outcomes.
* Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Business teams to translate AI opportunities into scalable product capabilities and measurable value.
* Drive the integration of AI and machine learning capabilities into data products, analytics platforms, and decision-support solutions.

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* 15+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years of Product Management experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, MBA or a related field.
* Experience working in Agile product development environments and partnering with IT & engineering teams to deliver iterative value.
* Experience with SQL databases for verification, testing.
* Ability to develop and own technical solutions in collaboration with commercial organizations and IT, from ideation to implementation
* Working knowledge of web/app analytics and tagging platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Quantum metric, Google Analytics/GA4, Amplitude, or similar) and how instrumentation decisions affect downstream data quality.
* Ability to build good connections within Delta’s commercial and IT departments, as well as with external vendors
* Intellectually curious, highly motivated, and willing to challenge the status quo
* Can cut through ambiguity, identify solutions, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand and support complex systems, integrations, and data flows
* Excellent written and verbal skills and ability to communicate effectively with all levels of Delta’s organization
* Strong analytical and data skills
* Familiarity with AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or analytics-driven models and AI platforms and ecosystems, including Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, AWS Sagemaker, Databricks or cloud-based machine learning services.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive and building a culture of trust.
* Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders.
* Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth.
* Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes.
* Ability to advocate for customer-focused innovations, model empathy in decision-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer’s perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Familiarity with modern data platforms (Teradata, AWS & Azure).
* Working knowledge of SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, and business intelligence tools(Tableau, PowerBI etc).
* Experience building executive dashboards and enterprise-wide measurement frameworks.
* Working knowledge of airlines and airline tools, processes, and data is strongly preferred
* Experience leading multiple projects with limited supervision and making well-informed priority tradeoffs
* Ability to work well with and rally diverse teams around the globe.
* Track record of delivering thoughtful solutions while meeting or exceeding deadlines
* Experience delivering AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or analytics-driven products at an enterprise environment.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

title: Product Manager -  Generalist
description:
**About Reo**
**Who we are**
Reo.Dev is a modern revenue stack for Developer focused companies. We help Developer Tool companies identify which Engineering Teams have an Urgent need for their product and the highest likelihood of conversion. We capture and analyze a wide array of developer activity data from Github, Docs, Docker Installs, Communities, other dev specific sources and convert them to sales signals.
  
  
Read more here: https://app.notion.com/p/roverly/About-Reo-Dev-18c33e0c3ba2808280f8e4235365a052
  
  
**Great! Now let’s talk about You and this Role! 🙌**
🎉
**What will you be working on?**
We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our early team and work directly with the founders to shape the future of Reo.Dev.
  
  
This role will focus on improving the onboarding and self-serve journeys within the product — specifically the first 90 days of user experience and early customer success — while also owning broader product initiatives across the platform.
  
  
Some of your work will include:
  
  

* Own end-to-end product development for key product areas — from discovery to launch
* Drive onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention initiatives across the product journey
* Work closely with founders, engineering, and design to ship fast, iterate continuously, and improve user experience
* Deeply understand user workflows, friction points, and customer needs through user conversations and product analytics
* Translate business and user problems into clear product requirements and execution plans
* Prioritize ruthlessly and focus on initiatives that create maximum customer and business impact
* Define product requirements, write detailed specs, manage sprint execution, and maintain strong documentation
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams
* Drive product decisions using data, experimentation, and customer insights
* Contribute to product strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term product vision
* Work on complex AI and data-driven workflows powering developer and GTM intelligence

**👯
**Skills we are looking for in this role****
This is a key role at Reo.Dev and we are looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company through its next phase of growth.
  
  
We are specifically looking for candidates who:
  
  

* Have 5+ years of Product Management experience in early-stage tech startups
* Have strong experience in B2B SaaS products, ideally with exposure to PLG/self-serve product journeys
* Have worked on onboarding, activation, adoption, retention, or product growth initiatives
* Have experience working on complex systems and not just linear workflow products
* Are highly analytical and comfortable using product and usage data to drive decisions
* Can operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments
* Have strong product thinking, prioritization, communication, and execution skills
* Are highly hands-on and comfortable working closely with engineering and design teams
* Have exposure to AI products, developer tools, data products, or intelligence systems
* Have independently driven product initiatives from ideation to launch

**Preferred backgrounds:**

* B2B SaaS
* PLG SaaS
* Developer tools
* AI products
* Bottom-up SaaS products
* Growth/onboarding-focused PM roles

**👯
**What qualities we look for in our team members?****
While there is no stencil for the type of people we like, there are a few traits that might make Reo.Dev a better fit for you.
  
  
**Reo.Dev**
**might be a good fit if you:**

* Work hard, hands-on (that’s very important to us!) and want to grow really fast.
* Care about your work a great deal, find it highly unsettling if the quality of work is even slightly sub-par.
* Execute fast.
* Are hands on (we will not have elaborate reporting structures for the foreseeable future and hopefully ever).
* Are someone people like to work with, low on ego, high on humility.
* Have the ability to fail, learn and keep trying till you win. Start-ups are tough and we will not get everything right the first time.
* Have a longish view of your career growth and not optimising for the next 1-2 years.

title: Product Manager II
description:
**Let’s Build What’s Next, Together.**
We are Spotnana. We’re on a mission to modernize the infrastructure of the $11.7 trillion travel industry to power the perfect trip for travelers everywhere. Our Travel-as-a-Service platform is designed to make every trip better, whether someone is booking for work or leisure travel, building a travel tool, or looking to offer personalized experiences at scale.
  
  
We’re not just modernizing tech, we’re rethinking how the industry works. And to get there, we’re bringing together innovative, ambitious, and open-minded people who want to build something that lasts.
  
  
At Spotnana, our values and principles guide how we work and grow together:
  
  

* Build the future – We are leaders, we are innovators, we are ambitious.
* Commit to excellence – We’re accountable, we are partners, we are agile.
* Stronger together – We lead with respect and integrity, we are inclusive, we are lifelong learners.

**How You'll Help Us Build**

* Product Strategy & Vision: Define and communicate product strategy and vision, working closely with stakeholders across the organization.
* Customer Insight & Market Analysis: Understand and anticipate customer needs through direct interaction, market research, and competitive analysis.
* Product Roadmap: Develop and maintain a product roadmap, prioritizing features based on business impact and customer needs.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success teams to deliver innovative products and features.
* Product Launch: Oversee successful product launches, working with the marketing team on go-to-market strategies.
* Product Performance: Monitor key performance metrics to ensure product success and continuous improvement.

**Experience You Bring**

* 2+ years of experience in product management, preferably in a SaaS or technology product environment within the travel industry.
* Proven experience in a fast-paced, customer-focused role, with the ability to stay closely connected to the customer's needs.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Deep understanding of customer needs and a customer-focused approach
* Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What To Expect Next**
The process typically begins with an introductory call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team, where we'll discuss your background, career aspirations, and what makes Spotnana a great fit for you. Then a live virtual and onsite interview with a panel of engineers and hiring managers.
  
  
We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive environment and to encourage these values in everyone on our team. We provide an environment of mutual respect where opportunities are available without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that diversity and inclusion for people from all walks of life is key to our success as a company.
  
  
**Protect yourself from recruitment scams**
- All recruiting outreach and communication comes directly from our internal team via an email with an @spotnana.com address or through LinkedIn. We encourage candidates to verify the source of any outreach before sharing personal information. We do not use external recruiting partners for our hiring efforts or Microsoft Teams for interviews. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, visa fees, or anything else during the hiring process. We do not extend offers via text-based apps or use Microsoft Teams for interviews. All legitimate openings are listed at https://www.spotnana.com/careers/careers-listing/.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai (Remote)

**Experience:**
3–4 Years

**About Clocknext:**

At
**Clocknext**
, we're building the next-generation pricing and billing infrastructure for AI-native applications.

As AI products evolve from simple SaaS tools to autonomous agents and multi-agent workflows, traditional billing systems are struggling to keep up. We're rethinking how AI companies measure usage, manage costs, design pricing models, and monetize their products.

We're looking for a
**Product Manager who thinks AI-first, understands technology, and loves solving complex customer problems**
to help us shape the future of AI monetization.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Own product features end-to-end:**
  From understanding customer problems and defining requirements to prioritization, execution, launch, and iteration.
* **Think AI-first:**
  Explore how AI can transform product experiences, workflows, and business models.
* **Work closely with engineering:**
  Collaborate with engineers on APIs, integrations, data models, workflows, and technical product decisions.
* **Understand customer needs:**
  Engage with customers, especially AI startups and SaaS companies, to uncover problems and translate them into product opportunities.
* **Drive product discovery:**
  Research markets, analyze competitors, identify gaps, and validate ideas through customer feedback and experimentation.
* **Build for developers:**
  Help create intuitive, reliable, API-first products that developers can easily integrate into their applications.
* **Make data-driven decisions:**
  Define success metrics, analyze product usage, and continuously improve adoption and customer outcomes.
* **Move fast:**
  Work in a startup environment where you can take ownership, experiment, and see the direct impact of your decisions.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 3–4 years of experience in product management, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
* A strong technology background, with the ability to understand technical concepts and engage in meaningful discussions with engineering teams.
* An AI-first mindset, with genuine curiosity about AI applications, LLMs, AI agents, and emerging product possibilities.
* Experience translating ambiguous customer problems into clear product requirements and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and prioritization skills.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements and a high degree of ownership.
* A customer-centric mindset and the ability to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working on developer tools, APIs, platform products, or infrastructure products.
* Familiarity with usage-based pricing, subscription billing, payments, or SaaS monetization.
* Hands-on experience building with AI tools or experimenting with LLM-powered applications.
* Experience working with early-stage startups or launching products from scratch.

**Why Join Clocknext?**

* **Solve emerging problems:**
  Work at the intersection of AI, SaaS, pricing, and billing infrastructure.
* **Own meaningful outcomes:**
  Take responsibility for product decisions and see your work directly impact customers.
* **Work at the edge of AI:**
  Help shape how the next generation of AI-native companies monetize their products.
* **Build from the ground up:**
  Join a growing team where your ideas, initiative, and execution matter.

title: Principal Product Manager (CMK/Encryption Platform)
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
Atlassian is looking for a product leader to own the strategy, delivery, and operating model for our Customer Managed Keys (CMK) and encryption platform portfolio. This role will lead a high-impact area at the intersection of enterprise trust, platform capability, regulatory readiness, and customer value. The Product Lead will define how encryption capabilities scale across Atlassian Cloud, clarify product and platform scope, and drive outcomes across CMK, encryption platform, bring-your-own-key patterns, and adjacent encryption services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The CMK/Encryption Platform Product Lead is responsible for product strategy, roadmap definition, and cross-functional execution for Atlassian’s encryption platform work. The role spans both customer-facing capabilities and foundational platform services, requiring strong judgment on where to standardize, where to differentiate, and how to sequence investments across security, scale, and commercial impact.
  
  
This leader will work across product, engineering, security, go-to-market, legal, compliance, and customer-facing teams to ensure Atlassian’s encryption capabilities meet enterprise expectations while remaining durable, usable, and economically sound.
  
  
**The Team’s Scope Includes**

* Customer Managed Keys strategy, roadmap, packaging, and lifecycle
* Cryptor and related encryption platform capabilities used across Atlassian Cloud
* Bring Your Own Key and external key management patterns, including future-facing options where relevant
* Encryption standards, architecture direction, and platform consistency across products and cells
* Enterprise customer requirements related to trust, control, compliance, and key management
* Prioritization of investments that balance customer demand, risk reduction, platform leverage, and revenue influence

**What you’ll do**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for CMK and encryption platform capabilities across Atlassian Cloud
* Clarify product scope and platform boundaries across CMK, Encryption Platfrom, and adjacent encryption services so teams can execute with clear accountability
* Drive roadmap decisions across customer commitments, enterprise needs, architecture constraints, and commercial priorities
* Partner closely with engineering and security leaders on encryption architecture, technical direction, delivery sequencing, and operational readiness
* Lead planning for key initiatives such as CMK expansion, platform standardization, key management evolution, cell-scoped capabilities, and efficiency improvements
* Represent the product area in executive, cross-functional, and customer settings with clear narrative, strong judgment, and crisp tradeoff framing
* Work with field, support, and customer-facing teams to understand enterprise demand, shape adoption strategy, and unblock strategic opportunities
* Ensure roadmap choices reflect security, compliance, resilience, scale, and usability expectations for a critical trust capability
* Create alignment across product, platform, and go-to-market teams on what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured
* Maintain continuity on in-flight work while improving role clarity, planning quality, and long-term portfolio coherence

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**This Role Requires**

* Significant product management experience leading complex platform or enterprise product areas with broad cross-functional dependency
* Deep expertise in encryption, key management, and security product domains, with the ability to engage credibly on architecture, threat considerations, control models, operational risk, and customer trust requirements
* Strong command of cloud security and data protection concepts, including how encryption capabilities are designed, operated, and scaled in large multi-tenant environments
* Demonstrated ability to lead security- or infrastructure-intensive product spaces where correctness, resilience, and risk management are central to product success
* Experience translating highly technical platform investments into clear product strategy, roadmap choices, and customer value
* Track record of driving alignment across engineering, security, legal, compliance, support, sales, and executive stakeholders
* Ability to make high-quality prioritization decisions with incomplete information and competing demands
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical complexity without losing precision
* Strong customer empathy and enterprise judgment, especially for regulated, security-conscious, or large-scale customers
* Experience owning roadmap commitments and execution in areas with material business, trust, or strategic impact

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with customer-managed keys, external key services, HSM-related systems, or cloud-native key management ecosystems
* Familiarity with enterprise compliance landscapes and trust programs that shape encryption expectations
* Experience in pricing, packaging, or commercialization of advanced enterprise platform capabilities
* Background working across both foundational platform teams and customer-facing product organizations
* Understanding of large-scale migration, re-encryption, or cryptographic lifecycle programs

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Product Manager - Ansible & Terraform
description:
**Job Description**
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold
**“what if.”**
  
  
**What if**
your ideas could ignite global innovation?
  
  
**What if**
your curiosity could redefine the future?
  
  
We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of
**your**
career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect
**70% of the Fortune 500**
, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.
  
  
Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary:
**Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honours three years running**
— and what we build is world-class:  recognized  as
**CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024**
— evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So,
**what if**
the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.
  
  
In a world where you can be anything,
**Be Infoblox**
.
  
  
**Product Manager**
We have an opportunity for a
**Product Manager**
to join our Products team in Bangalore, reporting to our Director, Product Management. In this role, you will help shape the automation and cloud operations experience across the Infoblox product portfolio. You will focus on capabilities that help customers automate deployment, configuration, integration, and lifecycle operations using modern infrastructure and automation tools such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, AI-driven workflows, and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  
  
This role is ideal for a product manager who is passionate about DevOps, CloudOps, platform automation, AI-enabled operations, and improving how customers operationalize products at scale. You will partner with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams to identify automation and AI-related needs, define requirements, and help deliver capabilities that improve customer efficiency, consistency, intelligence, and time to value.
  
  
You are also expected to actively leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows as part of your day-to-day product management practice, including research, synthesis, requirements development, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.
  
  
**Be a Contributor — What**
**You’ll Do**

* Help define and execute the roadmap for DevOps / CloudOps automation capabilities across the Infoblox portfolio.
* Work with other Product Managers to identify common automation needs and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* Partner closely with engineering and UX to define, refine, and deliver automation-focused features and workflows.
* Support product requirements for REST APIs, infrastructure-as-code integrations, and automation frameworks including Ansible and Terraform.
* Help drive capabilities that simplify deployment, provisioning, configuration management, and day-2 operations across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Collaborate with Product Marketing on technical positioning, enablement content, and customer-facing materials that support adoption.
* Understand how automation requirements intersect with the broader product portfolio and help drive a consistent customer experience across products.
* Contribute to product specifications, user stories, use cases, and backlog prioritization for automation-related initiatives.
* Leverage AI tools and AI-driven workflows in day-to-day product management activities, including market and customer research, synthesis, drafting requirements, prioritization support, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Own the success of the features and capabilities you help build, maintain, and deliver.

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* 1–3 years of related product management experience, or equivalent experience in technical product ownership, solutions engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, AI-enabled platform operations, or technical program roles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with SaaS products, cloud-managed platforms, and AI-enabled product capabilities is a plus.
* Working knowledge of automation and infrastructure technologies such as REST APIs, Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD workflows, scripting-driven operational models, and practical AI applications such as copilots, intelligent workflow automation, or LLM-powered operational use cases.
* Familiarity with public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, including awareness of their evolving AI service ecosystems.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI tools and AI-assisted workflows as part of everyday work.
* Understanding of how customers deploy, integrate, and operate infrastructure and services in enterprise, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Ability to actively listen to customers, identify root problems, and make data-informed decisions, even when data is incomplete.
* Ability to partner with cross-functional teams such as engineering, marketing, UX, support, and architecture across the full product lifecycle.
* Ability to capture and clearly articulate customer problems, then translate those into product strategy, requirements, and prioritization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong initiative, comfort working independently, and willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.
* Passion for ownership, innovation, and improving the customer experience through automation and operational simplicity.

**Be Successful — Your Path**
  
  
**First 90 Days:**

* Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Infoblox products, their features, and how customers automate and operate them.
* Deliver clear product specifications, user stories, and scenarios that define customer needs and automation requirements.
* Participate in user-centric design and agile planning processes.
* Become a fully engaged member of the Product Management, UX, Architecture, and Engineering teams.
* Help drive backlog definition and prioritization for automation and CloudOps capabilities.

**One Year:**

* Be a key contributor to the roadmap and strategy for DevOps / CloudOps automation initiatives across the portfolio.
* Help drive the creation and prioritization of product requirements in partnership with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams.
* Contribute meaningfully to agile release planning and execution for automation-related product investments.
* Establish yourself as a go-to product partner for cross-portfolio automation needs.

**Belong—**
**Your Community**
Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.
  
  
**Be Rewarded —**
**Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match
* We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications

**Ready to Be the Difference?**
  
  
*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis*

title: Product Management Specialist - Fintech
description:
**Company Description**

FastFlowPe is a two-year-old, bootstrapped payment technology company building smarter payment infrastructure for businesses, with a focus on D2C brands and SaaS companies.

Our flagship product, Fast Checkout, is designed to help businesses improve payment success rates and optimise payment processing through intelligent payment gateway orchestration. By bringing multiple payment gateways together through a unified infrastructure, FastFlowPe helps businesses streamline payment collections, optimise transaction routing, simplify payouts and reconciliation, and deliver a smoother checkout experience.

Our platform combines payment gateway orchestration, smart routing, payment collection infrastructure and operational visibility to help businesses build more efficient and scalable payment operations.

As an early-stage company, we are focused on product innovation, merchant acquisition and building a scalable business. We are looking for entrepreneurial talent ready to take ownership, create new revenue opportunities and help shape FastFlowPe's next phase of growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an engineering-first Product Lead to own Fast Checkout's development and user experience, working closely with engineering, design, and business teams.

The ideal candidate combines software engineering experience with strong fintech domain knowledge, an understanding of market dynamics and user behaviour, and proven product execution skills.

You will manage the complete product lifecycle and progressively lead the development of new products, with a growth path toward
**Head of Product**
.

* **Product Ownership:**

* **New Product Development:**

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **3–4 years of software engineering/development experience**
  and
  **1–2 years in Product Management/Product Ownership**
  .
* **At least 2–3 years of experience working in the fintech industry**
  , preferably in payments, payment gateways, payment orchestration, or checkout products.
* Strong understanding of the fintech ecosystem, market trends, merchant needs, and user behaviour.
* Knowledge of payment flows, APIs, integrations, and technical architecture.
* Proven experience managing product development timelines and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong interest in UI/UX, product design, and customer experience.
* Excellent communication, analytical, prioritisation, and problem-solving skills.

Career Growth

Why Join FastFlowPe?

* Build new products from the ground up.

Application Process

Interested candidates can apply online or email their CV and covering letter to ishita.nema@gofastflowpe.com.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About Wingy**

Love and dating should feel exciting. For most of us, they come with a lot of anxiety too. Wingy is an emotionally-intelligent wingwoman who works alongside you through every part of your love life, helping make modern dating a lot less anxiety-inducing.

We are backed by Gruhas Collective Consumer Fund, ajvc, Anupam Mittal and other leading consumer-tech founders.

**First, about this JD**

You’re expected to work without one.

This is what we’re doing today and where we need help today. It will change, probably by the time you finish onboarding. If you need a fixed scope, this will be a rough ride. If a shifting one sounds like the fun part, read on.

**Two north stars: user growth and retention**

You and the founders own these together. Everything else is negotiable.

**For growth, you’ll:**

* Run our UGC engine: creators, concepts, briefs, output and iteration
* Find the channels we haven’t discovered yet
* Learn and run Meta ads. You don’t need to know how today, but you’ll need to in six weeks.
* Dig out the user insights behind winning hooks: the line that makes someone stop scrolling because it’s uncomfortably about them

**For retention, you’ll:**

* Uncover why some users stay and others disappear, and shape the product journey so more of them stick
* Optimize the whole funnel, from channels, messages and hooks that bring in the right people to the product flow itself

**You’ll probably do well here if you:**

* Are curious about people and always ask the next question
* Can take a user call in the morning, look at a retention cohort in the afternoon, and see how the two connect
* Have made something with a measurable result: content, ads, a product or a community
* Understand hooks, storytelling and internet culture, and can explain why something worked
* Start without a brief, a team or permission
* Hold strong opinions and drop them when the data disagrees

You don’t need a PM title or dating-app experience. Experience with consumer social, marketplaces or Gen Z products helps, but we care far more about how you think and how fast you move.

**What you’re signing up for**

A seat next to the founders for everything: product, users and the messy middle. You’ll learn how a consumer company gets built by building one.

In exchange, you get ambiguity, pace and real ownership, plus a healthy amount of ESOPs and skin in the game.

**How to apply**

Write to priyansha@meetwingy.com about the cool things you’ve done and include a link to your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Product Specialist - SuccessFactor Compensation
description:

title: Head of Digital Omnichannel
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**
Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.
  
  
For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Lead the Digital Delivery function across the digital commerce portfolio, translating business requirements into clearly defined features and delivery outcomes that enhance customer journeys across the Group’s digital platforms. Oversee delivery across core commerce (checkout and payments), product discovery, mobile apps, digital commerce platforms, and projects, ensuring priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered consistently. Drive strong delivery discipline, cross-functional alignment, and high-quality digital experiences for the Group’s brands.
  
  

* Translate the global digital commerce roadmap into a high-velocity delivery portfolio, partner with Dubai to align multi-squad capacity with brand priorities, ensuring predictable, high-quality execution.
* Direct complex delivery initiatives in collaboration with the CPO office, regional brand heads, and joint-venture partners.
* Drive value realization and business outcomes (conversion, AOV, adoption) by optimizing cross-omni dependency matrices, mitigating risks, and ensuring cohesive customer experiences.
* Champion Agile maturity and delivery excellence across the Omnichannel domain.
* Cultivate a high-performing guild of Capability Analysts and Leads, driving continuous improvement in delivery metrics (Sprint Velocity, Predictability Score, Cycle Time) while establishing rigorous Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) standards to eliminate defect escape.
* Responsible for developing the SLA report monthly and presenting this back to the brands to ensure Quality and product SLAs are met on a monthly basis.
* Responsible for billing across all the digital squads, ensuring that development and associated costs are billed to the business teams.
* Manage delivery demand versus squad capacity, ensuring commitments are realistic and dependencies across squads are understood before work is planned.
* Ensure the team of Analysts are focused on business requirements being translated into well-defined features, functional requirements, acceptance criteria and executable delivery outcomes before they enter development.
* Lead PI planning and delivery governance across the digital squads, maintaining objectives, risks, decisions and dependencies in Confluence.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**

* 12 to 15 years in digital commerce, and at least 10 years of experience in digital development including leading multi-squad delivery and managing teams.
* Experience delivering digital commerce capabilities across end-to-end e-commerce journeys, including site redesigns, checkout enhancements, core commerce flows, cart and shopping bag management, promotions and pricing, payments, order tracking, mobile apps, product discovery, search, recommendations, and browse-to-buy journey optimization.
* Experience of agile delivery at scale, including PI planning, capacity planning, and delivery governance.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders to agree delivery commitments, SLAs, and priorities.
* Usage proficiency in Jira and Confluence for planning, documentation, and reporting.
* Experience with digital commerce platforms such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify.
* Experience of billing, cost recovery, or commercial governance within an internal agency or shared services model.
* Certification in agile delivery, such as Scrum Master or SAFe, is nice to have.
* Preferred Profile: Retail or e-commerce domain experience. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Profiles such as Head of Digital, Digital Lead, Lead Omnichannel Digital, or Lead of E-commerce.

**What We Can Offer You**
With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
  
  
We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
  
  
**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
  
  
**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
  
  
We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.CTI MD Tech@LillyAssociate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical DevManagement Level: M1 | Job Family: Information TechnologyAbout The OrganizationCTI - Development owns the digital capability that patients, sites and study teams meet first: consent and data capture, patient engagement, and the systems that get a study designed, started and set up. The portfolio spans Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and patient engagement, and AI & Analytics. The organization is mid-transformation, modernizing platforms and scaling AI and agentic use cases while operating under strict GxP/GCP, data integrity and inspection-readiness requirements.Job DescriptionThe Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev, leads a team of engineering, product and delivery professionals and owns delivery, technical direction and capability growth across the Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and AI & Analytics domains. The role sits where clinical process meets engineering: close enough to the build to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in trial execution to shape how a study team actually works. It owns the demand relationship with clinical development business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, manages allocated budget and contractor capacity against plan, and is expected to set the agenda for AI and agentic adoption rather than wait for direction on it. Hands-on technical experience is expected and non-negotiable: a practitioner who has built and shipped software and integrations directly, and who stays current enough to pressure-test an architecture or a build versus buy call. The role is scoped at the upper end of the band and is expected to grow into responsibility for broader teams as the portfolio expands.Core ResponsibilitiesDelivery OwnershipOwn delivery execution across the portfolio (scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness, production health) for clinical experience and patient engagement products (eConsent, ePRO/eCOA, patient portals and apps) and study start-up capabilities (site activation, study build, CTMS/eTMF integration).Run the standing delivery cadence of operational reviews, backlog grooming, planning cycles (e.g., PI Planning) and release governance as a single portfolio-wide rhythm, and apply product-management rigor to prioritization, scoring business value, technical debt, effort and risk explicitly and agreeing success measures before work starts.Define and implement the portfolio metrics framework: release predictability, defect escape, production reliability, study build and site activation cycle time, and adoption by sites, study teams and patients. Instrument it where stakeholders can see it, not inside a backlog tool.Identify and solve organizational and operational problems and technical challenges across the portfolio, from resourcing conflicts and scope ambiguity to cross-team dependencies, escalating only what falls outside established guidelines and doing so with a recommendation.Technical Direction & Engineering StandardsSet and defend the technical direction of the portfolio; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, interoperability (CDISC, HL7/FHIR) and reuse across clinical platforms.Own the architecture and design decisions for the portfolio's products, approve solution and integration designs, and run a design review cadence that catches problems before a release rather than after one.Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt.Stay personally current: spend enough time in the code, the integrations and the production systems to judge an estimate, read a pull request and ask the questions only a practitioner asks.AI & Agentic TransformationDefine and land a 12 to 24 month vision for AI and agentic capability in study start-up and clinical experience: protocol and document intelligence, automated study build, site and patient-facing assistants. Make the business case for it.Find the use cases, prove them quickly at low cost, and take the ones that work through validation into production use with the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design that requires.Build the team's AI fluency, make AI-assisted engineering the normal way of working, and partner with business owners to redesign clinical process rather than automate around it.Resource, Budget & Vendor ManagementForecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage allocated budget and contractor capacity within approved guidelines, including allocation, ramp-up and release decisions.Own vendor and partner delivery: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams, and manage performance on predictability and quality.Own SOW/MSA follow-ups, renewals and scope amendments, shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.Business Stakeholder EngagementAct as the technology partner for business owners and study teams: the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Represent the portfolio externally with platform vendors, sites and industry forums, influencing partner roadmaps toward Lilly's needs.Run the demand relationship: capture and challenge incoming requests, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Contribute to the Clinical Dev business-area plan by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced delivery cycles.Translate clinical need into technical options, and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on, with no surprises at release.People LeadershipHold management responsibility for the team, including hiring, onboarding, goal-setting and performance appraisals; hire for the capability the portfolio needs next, such as AI engineering, product thinking and clinical domain depth.Coach and develop through specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own; serve as career advisor and partner with HR on growth plans.Grow engineering craft, not only careers: use design and code review as teaching moments, and build shared practice across internal pods and partner teams so good patterns spread.Build bench strength and succession, remove single points of failure, and lead through senior engineers, technical leads and partner pod leads as the portfolio grows, setting direction for work executed beyond direct line management.Quality, Compliance & Process LeadershipDeliver in a GxP/GCP-regulated environment covering computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness; design for security and patient data privacy from the start; own incident response and the service levels agreed with study teams.Implement and refine a standard framework for backlog management, delivery governance and execution (Agile/Kanban, PI Planning), and own the portfolio-level leadership reporting cadence.Required Skills And Expertise10+ years of relevant experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership or product/platform management, including 4+ years of people-leadership experience managing technical teams.Deep, current, hands-on engineering background: able to build, review and troubleshoot services, APIs and integrations, not solely credentialed from past roles. Fluency in at least one modern programming language and SQL, with working command of cloud platforms and integration patterns.Proven experience taking AI, machine learning or agentic solutions beyond proof of concept into governed production use.Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships, including SOW/MSA administration within established commercial guidelines, and forecasting resource needs against an allocated budget.Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship: shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.Demonstrated experience defining delivery or product metrics frameworks that stakeholders actually use.Demonstrated success building and retaining a technical team: hiring engineers, coaching through design review, and keeping critical talent.Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices, with fluency in Agile/Kanban delivery and tooling (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow or equivalent).Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, clinical and regulatory language.Preferred Skills4+ years supporting clinical development technology: study start-up, site activation, patient- or site-facing systems, or clinical data capture.Experience with Veeva Vault Clinical, Medidata or comparable clinical platforms, working knowledge of clinical data standards (CDISC CDASH/SDTM, HL7/FHIR), and exposure to decentralized or hybrid trial designs.Education & ExperienceBachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (Master's preferred); Agile or PMP certification a plus.Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform, shaping technical direction from direct engineering experience.Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions.
