title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

**Your Role**
The Senior Digital & eCommerce Localization Lead is an expert practitioner responsible for the localization strategy, execution guidance, and cross-functional collaboration within one or more assigned pillars of the D&E Localization function. Pillars span Legal Compliance & Partnership, Digital Marketing, Customer Activation, Core Commerce, and Retention.
  
  
Operating as an embedded strategic advisor, this role ensures that localization investment is directed where it generates the greatest commercial return — prioritizing by impact rather than responding to individual market requests. Rather than owning every localization activity end-to-end, the Senior Lead guides, consults, and connects — ensuring the right accountability exists within the relevant functional teams while driving global consistency, quality, and measurable business impact.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Embedding & Planning**

* Actively participate in product roadmap, feature launch, and campaign planning cycles, representing localization requirements before decisions are finalized.
* Advocate for localization as a first-class input into D&E strategy, not a downstream production activity.
* Apply a commercial lens to localization decisions — prioritizing markets, channels, and features based on revenue impact, compliance risk, and strategic opportunity rather than volume of requests.
* Support the Head of Localization in maintaining and refining ROI-based prioritization criteria, ensuring localization investment is allocated to the highest-impact opportunities.

**Pillar Ownership & Delivery**

* Serve as the accountable lead for localization activity within assigned pillar(s), ensuring deliverables are clearly defined, prioritized, and executed to standard.
* Guide functional teams on how to implement localization requirements within their pillar — advising on approach, standards, and tooling rather than executing directly.
* Maintain a clear view of the localization backlog, pipeline, and in-flight activity within assigned pillars, surfacing risks or capacity issues proactively.
* Coordinate with other pillar leads to ensure cross-pillar dependencies are identified and managed effectively.

* Apply commercial and ROI judgement when translating market priorities into localization requirements — recommending investment where impact is evidenced, and deprioritizing where it is not.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, providing clear, evidence-based guidance on localization investment, scope, and sequencing.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across Commercial, Legal, RMTC, DDIT, and Customer functions as relevant to assigned pillar(s).

* Advise on vendor selection, briefing, and review processes where third-party localization or translation services are engaged.
* Ensure that compliance, regulatory, and data privacy requirements are embedded in localization workflows within assigned pillar(s).
* Proactively escalate quality, capacity, or compliance risks to the Head of Localization before they impact the business.

* Use customer feedback, market data, and performance insights to identify improvement opportunities and refine localization approaches.
* Contribute to the global Digital & eCommerce community, sharing expertise, market insights, and best practices across the teams.

* Demonstrated expertise in at least one APAC or key commercial market language (e.g., Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bahasa Indonesia, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of digital and eCommerce ecosystems, including content management, search, transactional platforms, and/or digital marketing channels.
* Proven ability to operate as a senior advisor and influence stakeholders across commercial, product, legal, and technology functions without direct authority.
* Experience working in cross-functional, matrixed global organizations with multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities.
* Strong communication skills; able to translate complex localization topics into clear business language for senior stakeholders.
* Fluent English, written and spoken, to business standard.

**Preferred**

* Knowledge of SEO, GEO, and SEM principles in multilingual and multi-market contexts.
* Experience with agile product development and cross-functional pod or scrum team working.
* Knowledge of data privacy regulations applicable to key markets (e.g., GDPR, PIPL, PIPA, LGPD, CCPA).

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

**Retention**

* Own D1, D7 and D30 retention — and the habit loops that drive them.
* Build the hooks that bring users back daily: notifications, streaks, personalised content, re-engagement.
* Reduce churn and lift repeat usage and renewal rates.
* Turn one-time watchers into long-term, paying, engaged aspirants.

**How you'll work**

* Live in the data — Mixpanel, funnels, cohorts — and let it decide what to build next.
* Run a tight experiment cadence: hypothesis → test → read → ship or kill.
* Partner with engineering, design, content and marketing to ship fast.

**Who We're Looking For**

Our ideal candidate comes from a
**short-video or consumer-tech company**

and has already solved acquisition
**and**

retention at real scale. If you've worked on a product people open every day — a short-video, streaming, social, gaming or consumer app — you'll feel right at home.

You likely have:

* **3+ years as a Product Manager**

  in consumer tech, with a clear growth or retention focus.
* A track record of
  **moving real numbers**

  — you can point to funnels you improved and retention curves you bent upward.
* **Short-video instincts**

  — you understand why people watch, scroll, return, and what makes content habit-forming.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Join NetApp's Data Protection and Business Continuity team as a Staff Product Manager where you'll drive innovation in solutions that help organizations safeguard their most valuable asset their data. We're looking for strategic thinkers who are passionate about solving customer challenges and shaping the future of data resilience. At NetApp, we believe diverse perspectives fuel innovation. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experience paths who share our commitment to customer success and continuous growth.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* As a Staff Product Manager, you'll own the product vision and strategy for our data protection portfolio:
* Define and execute product roadmaps that align with customer needs and market opportunities in data protection and business continuity
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, sales, marketing, and support teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes
* Engage directly with customers and partners to understand pain points, validate solutions, and drive product adoption
* Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to identify strategic opportunities
* Champion customer-centric innovation by translating complex requirements into actionable product features
* Drive business results through data-driven decision making, measuring product performance and customer satisfaction
* Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of ownership, belonging, and high performance
* Communicate product vision and progress to stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to executive leadership

**What We're Looking For**

* We value skills and potential over specific backgrounds. You'll thrive in this role if you bring:
* Product management experience with enterprise technology solutions, demonstrating ownership of product outcomes
* Strong customer empathy and ability to translate customer needs into product strategy
* Analytical mindset with experience making data-informed decisions and measuring success
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and business audiences
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and drive results in dynamic environments
* Growth mindset with curiosity about emerging technologies and market trends
* Experience or interest in data protection, backup, disaster recovery, or or related infrastructure domains

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in technology, business, or related field.
* Product management, technical, or customer-facing experience in enterprise software or infrastructure.
* Understanding of data management, cloud technologies, or storage concepts.
* Requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
  
  
**Our culture**
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
  
  
**Submitting an Application**
To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
  
  
**AI Disclosure**
For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: Senior Digital Product Manager - Platform Product Management
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Digital Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of platform capabilities that enable scalable, innovative digital experiences across the enterprise. This role requires a highly collaborative product leader with strong technical acumen, capable of partnering closely with engineering, design, and architecture teams to build reusable platform services and foundational capabilities that drive meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Define and execute the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise platform capabilities and services.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, design, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and reusable platform solutions.
* Translate complex business and technical requirements into product capabilities, features, and prioritized backlogs.
* Drive product discovery, customer research, and data-driven decision-making to identify opportunities and increase platform adoption.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, integration patterns, and platform architecture decisions.
* Define product requirements, success metrics, and acceptance criteria while balancing customer value, business impact, and technical considerations.
* Establish platform standards, API design principles, developer experience best practices, and governance frameworks.
* Monitor platform performance, adoption, and customer feedback to continuously enhance the product experience.
* Champion AI-enabled capabilities and automation opportunities that improve customer experiences and business outcomes.
* Influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations to align priorities, drive execution, and deliver measurable results.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Digital Product Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education.
* 2+ years of platform product management experience supporting platform, API, developer, infrastructure, or enterprise technology products.
* Strong technical background with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps, leading platform product initiatives, and partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable technology solutions.
* Experience integrating AI-driven capabilities into digital products and customer experiences.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while effectively managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proven success managing the full product lifecycle, from discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and optimization.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams to assess technical trade-offs, scalability requirements, and solution design considerations.
* Ability to build strong partnerships and collaborate effectively across business, product, engineering, architecture, and operations teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills within complex, matrixed organizations.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and facilitate discussions that drive clarity, alignment, and decision-making.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Agile software delivery methodologies, information architecture, digital platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
* Proactive, innovative, and customer-centric mindset with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Expectations**

* Strong technical and product management expertise, with experience defining product strategies and roadmaps while partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities, modernization initiatives, and enterprise technology solutions.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management
  
  
**General Summary**
Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, process, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing, and distribution as the product(s) and/or product line(s) move through their lifecycle. Formulates and executes long-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends. Directs those involved in the design, modification, and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the product or product line.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or technical related field.
* 2+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.
* 1+ year of working in a large matrixed organization.
* 1+ year of working with operating budgets and/or project financials.
* 1+ year of negotiating 3rd party business agreements.

**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Conducts analyses to assess marketability of products based on market, customer, technology, and other ecosystem demands.
* Serves as a market and business advisor in the formation of a business case for the development of a new product or product features (i.e., time to market, cost, market share).
* Drives the launch efforts of products and technologies for own area of responsibility by staying up to date on technological developments and customer needs through direct customer contact.
* Seeks out market information and displays an understanding of the marketplace to contribute to the product roadmap.
* Directs the development of moderately complex products and services under some supervision and communicates with individuals across functional teams.
* Completes product development and definition activities including determination of cost and impact, and interacts with sales team to generate forecasts.
* Stays up to date on competitors, technological advances, and product ecosystem and supports the development and design of new products.
* Maintains effective communication within own team and cross-functional team(s) on the management of a single product.
* Ensures successful cross-functional collaboration by ensuring that agreed upon KPIs and specifications are met for a single product, upon delivery by engineering team.
* Supports the establishment of product goals (e.g., performance, cost, timeline) and collaborates with others to execute tasks based on established goals.

**Level Of Responsibility**

* Working under some supervision.
* Making decisions that are low to moderate in impact; errors may have relatively minor financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.
* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey information that may be somewhat complex to others who may have limited knowledge of the subject in question. May require basic negotiation and influence, cooperation, tact, and diplomacy, etc.
* Completing tasks with multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; some planning and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively; mistakes may result in some rework.
* Exercising creativity to draft original documents, imagery, or work products within established guidelines.
* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or incomplete; intermediate data analysis/interpretation skills may be required.

**The Responsibilities Of This Role Do Not Include**

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).
* Influence over key organizational decisions.
* Role in strategic planning.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Level Up Your Career!**
At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile and the indie PC and Console space.
  
  
As well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.
  
  
**Join the team!**
Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape what comes next in our live games: what we change, why, and what it will earn.
  
  
You’ll team up with our Executive Producers: they lead how we build, you lead what we build and why, and together you make our games better and better.
  
  
We’ll match the title to your experience. This role is for you if you’re a product leader who loves living in player data, forming bold hypotheses about retention, engagement, and monetisation, running clean experiments, and turning results into confident decisions.
  
  
This role is based in our Bangalore studio, working onsite 5 days per week, where our daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand the games inside out. Know the key numbers for each game, find the biggest opportunities in retention, engagement, economy, and monetisation, and size them.
* Start with a hypothesis. Turn every opportunity into a clear hypothesis with a success metric, so every feature ships with a purpose.
* Run experiments that decide. Design A/B tests with our product analysts, read them with an open mind, and decide together with the producer what ships next.
* Shape the roadmap. Build and prioritise the game roadmap with the Executive Producer, ranked by the value it will create.
* Connect growth and product. Bring what UA and creative learn about our players into the games, and work with monetisation on the best player experience.
* Grow the product craft. Guide our product analysts and help set how we do product across the portfolio.
* Spot tomorrow’s hits. Bring a product view to our most promising new games as they grow.

**What You’ll Own**
Great product decisions and the extra player value that they will create in our biggest games.
  
  
You’ll be the champion who ensures every big player opportunity gets a smart hypothesis, a clear experiment, and a place on the roadmap.
  
  
**How We’ll Celebrate Your Success**

* Growth in LTV and profit from product changes
* Retention, engagement, and monetisation in your games
* Experiments launched, learned from, and shipped
* Clear, well-reasoned roadmap decisions

**Essential**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* Senior product management experience in F2P mobile games, with live games you’ve measurably improved.
* Strong analytical skills: at home with cohorts, funnels, and experiment design; A great understanding of game economies, progression, LiveOps, and hybrid monetisation.
* A hypothesis-driven mindset: you know what you expect to happen, why, and what you’ll do if you’re wrong.
* Experience partnering closely with producers or game leads
* A clear, warm communicator who makes the case in players and pounds.

**Desirable**

* SQL experience.
* Experience guiding or mentoring analysts.
* Puzzle or hybrid-casual mobile game experience

**Why Kwalee?**

* Generous Holiday: Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* Flexible Working: We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* Health Cover: Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* Free Food & Drink: Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* Gaming Goodies: Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* Transport: Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* Office Location: Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* Professional Development: Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* Merch & Events: Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
  
  
Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.
  
  
We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Associate, Product Manager-Clinical Intelligence
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The
**Senior Associate, Product Manager-Clinical Intelligence**
at Amplify Health plays a critical role in shaping the future of digital health solutions across Asia. This position operates at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation, driving transformative initiatives that improve patient outcomes and redefine healthcare delivery models.

The Product Manager is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of products—from ideation and concept validation to development, launch, and continuous optimization. This includes defining the product vision, setting strategic priorities, and ensuring that every product aligns with Amplify Health’s mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective.

The role requires a strategic thinker and hands-on executor who can translate high-level business objectives into actionable product roadmaps. The Product Manager leverages emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures to deliver innovative solutions that meet evolving customer needs and regulatory requirements.

As a key leader, the Product Manager collaborates cross-functionally with business, technology, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery. They champion customer-centric design principles, integrating behavioral insights and advanced analytics to personalize health experiences and improve engagement.

This position is ideal for a visionary product leader who thrives in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, embraces complexity, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to transform healthcare across Asia.

**Responsibilities**

**1) Clinical Product Strategy & Vision**

* Own 1 clinical‑backed product strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned to customer outcomes and business objectives.
* Drive the clinical, insurance and technology roadmap and vision of the product will intersect clinical and insurance
* Define target problems, personas, JTBDs, and success metrics for payers, providers, employers, and members.
* Drive data‑informed prioritization using frameworks such as WSJF, RICE, or equivalent value models.
* Make explicit trade‑offs balancing customer value, technical complexity, regulatory risk, and commercial impact.

**2) Discovery, Design & Outcomes**

* Run structured discovery (customer interviews, prototype tests, betas, VOC programs), and instrument products with dashboards/analytics to measure adoption, engagement, and outcomes.
* Champion API-First design for B2B scalability and enhanced Integration experience adoption through use-cases based interfaces, SDKs, Implementation guide.

**3) Interoperability & Data Architecture**

* Partner with architecture/engineering to deliver API first, cloud agnostic services and integrations, leveraging HL7 FHIR/SMART on FHIR for data models, auth and scopes, and secure EHR/payer connections.
* Ensure solutions can ingest/serve longitudinal health data and payer data, and support bulk data and near real-time workflows where appropriate.

**4) Privacy, Security & Compliance**

* Embed privacy by design; for example, align to PDPA in Singapore (and analogous regimes in other markets), and incorporate NEHR/HIB data sharing requirements in Singapore.
* Collaborate with InfoSec to implement ISO/IEC 27001 controls and pursue standard like HITRUST aligned assurance for healthcare customers, as appropriate to product scope.

**5) Delivery & Quality**

* Run Agile delivery with crisp backlog management, well-formed PRDs/Epics/Stories, and definition of done that includes security, privacy, performance, and observability.
* Drive experimentation and A/B testing; ensure robust post launch monitoring and incident response playbooks are in place for mission-critical B2B Integrations.

**6) Go-To-Market & Commercialisation**

* Partner with Sales, CS, Clinical and Operations on packaging, pricing, launch readiness, and product enablement playbooks, with minimum adjustments to different customer segment and country.
* Own success metrics: time to value, logo/market expansion, renewal/retention, measured clinical/financial outcomes per solution.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline required.
* Medical degree (MD/MBBS), health sciences background, MBA, or other advanced degree is highly advantageous.
* Minimum of 5+ years of experience in either:
* B2B product management with end‑to‑end lifecycle ownership and a demonstrated track record of delivering impactful features,
  **or**
* A healthcare insurer environment, with strong understanding of end‑to‑end processes, operational workflows, and key pain points.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, cross‑functional products within agile development environments.
* Strong interoperability awareness, including understanding of OpenAPI concepts, FHIR resources, and how SMART on FHIR enables secure, scoped access to health data (OAuth 2.0/OIDC and app launch patterns).
* Working knowledge of data privacy and security requirements, including PDPA obligations (consent, purpose limitation, protection, and breach notification), with experience collaborating with Information Security teams toward ISO 27001 controls.
* Demonstrated proficiency in prioritization and value‑based decision‑making, leveraging frameworks such as WSJF and RICE, defining KPIs and OKRs, and applying product analytics to measure outcomes.

**Preferred:**

* Possess understanding in insurance and healthcare ecosystems and products would be advantageous.
* Experience with AI/ML in healthcare (e.g., risk scores, triage, personalization) and familiarity with governance and policy framework would be preferred.
* Experience integrating with payer/provider systems using FHIR APIs (R4/R5), and familiarity with SMART App Launch and Backend Services patterns.

**Competencies & Core Characteristics:**

We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale-up environment:

* **Health InsurTech Domain Expertise:**
  Knowledge and understanding of how insurers, providers, regulators in the healthcare industry work end to end from payments, integrations, operations, product, member, claims and clinical journeys. Possess either deep knowledge in 1 or 2 APAC markets with additional context on what is best in class and deep understanding of client pain points in the end to end lifecycle and which pain points customers are willing to pay for to solve.
* **Clinical Domain Knowledge:**
  Knowledge of clinical coding terminology for providers and insurers (such as CPT, ICD10CM, ICD11, etc.) Knowledge of clinical tools including coders, groupers, and classifications. Understanding of clinical measurements and outcome frameworks such as AHQR, HEDIS, etc. Knowledge of WHO frameworks for member program pathways, clinical guidelines and other clinical interventions. Knowledge and understanding of how clinical variation impacts insurers and providers. Knowledge of CMS based guidelines for clinical payment arrangements, quality programs, screening and prevention and other clinical payment applications.
* **Technical Expertise Domain:**
  Demonstrates strong technical acumen to bridge business and technology effectively, ensuring scalable and secure product delivery. Possesses proficiency in agile methodologies, data analytics, cloud platforms, and API-driven architectures, while maintaining awareness of emerging technologies such as AI/ML and IoT. Applies privacy-by-design principles and collaborates seamlessly with UX/UI teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.
* **Customer Obsessed & Outcome-driven:**
  Act as a relentless advocate for customers, prioritizing user needs, integration experiences, and real‑world outcomes in every decision. Practice continuous discovery, including customer interviews, structured betas, and VOC loops, to validate problems and solutions. Champion user‑centric and API‑consumer‑centric design, collaborating closely with UX/UI and engineering to maximize adoption and engagement. Define and track clear north‑star metrics (adoption, engagement, clinical and financial impact) using real‑time dashboards and analytics.
* **Strategic Architect:**
  Ability to translate business vision into scalable product architecture and long-term roadmap. Demonstrates foresight in anticipating market trends and aligning product strategy with organizational goals.
* **Data-Driven Decisiveness:**
  Leverage data, experimentation, and evidence‑based insights to inform prioritization, validate hypotheses, and optimize product outcomes. Apply structured prioritization frameworks (e.g., WSJF, RICE) and OKRs to balance customer value, risk, and business impact. Comfortable running experiments (including A/B tests where appropriate) and learning quickly from results—both successes and failures.
* **Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer:**
  Builds strong relationships across diverse teams, fostering collaboration and alignment between business, technology, and external partners. Skilled at influencing without authority and driving consensus in complex environments.
* **Coach & Talent Multiplier:**
  Empowers team members through mentorship and guidance, creating an environment that encourages learning and growth. Recognises and nurtures talent to maximize team performance.
* **Resilient Operator:**
  Thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced environments, maintaining composure under pressure. Demonstrates adaptability and problem-solving skills to overcome challenges and deliver results.
* **Insatiable Curiosity:**
  Continuously explores emerging technologies and industry trends. Brings creativity and a willingness to experiment with new ideas to drive innovation and differentiation.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
**Company Overview**
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.
  
  
**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:

+ Analog and custom IC design
+ Standard cell design and optimization
+ Physical implementation
+ Design migration and design reuse
+ Semiconductor design automation
+ Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows

* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.
  
  
**Why us?**
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.
  
  
A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Report product health, risk, and roadmap progress directly to senior leadership — including exec/C-suite settings — with the judgment to say what leadership needs to hear, not just what's easy to report. Be the External and Internal Face of the ProductPitch Code Insights directly to CISOs, SecOps leads, and security architects; be comfortable being challenged on technical depth and defending the product's position against competing SAST, SCA, and secrets-detection tools. Own customer pilots end to end, from technical validation through commercial conversion — you carry the pilot, not just support it. Close the loop from field to roadmap: translate customer and prospect input into product decisions, and be willing to say no to requests that don't fit the strategy. Represent the product internally to sales, marketing, and execs as the person who can explain not just what Code Insights does, but why it wins and where it's still catching up. Grow the Product-Led Opportunity (Growth Track)Use Code Insights' shift-left, developer-first design (CLI, pre-commit hooks, CI/CD integration) as a foundation to build organic, self-serve adoption. Partner with Design and Marketing to test and refine the self-serve journey — from first scan to habitual use to internal champion. Treated as a strategic opportunity to grow into, not a prerequisite — we'll support you in building this muscle if it's new to you. What We're Looking For:We're looking for technical judgment and business fluency in the same person:Seniority — 6–7+ years in product management or a customer-facing technical role, with real ownership of roadmap decisions, not just execution. Security domain grounding — working knowledge of application security concepts (SAST, SCA, secrets detection, or software supply chain security) sufficient to hold your own with security practitioners. Deep AppSec expertise is a strong plus; a fast learner with adjacent technical credibility can also thrive here. Business and interpersonal range — we're actively looking for candidates with an MBA or equivalent business training who pair that with technical depth — people who can move fluently between an engineering standup, a CISO pitch, and an exec update in the same week. Strong written and verbal communication, executive presence, and the judgment to know when to push back matter as much as domain knowledge. Commercial instinct — comfortable owning outcomes tied to revenue and retention, not just shipped features; you think in terms of business impact, not just backlog throughput. PM fundamentals — track record managing roadmaps, backlog hygiene (Jira or equivalent), and clear stakeholder reporting. Nice to have, not required — prior exposure to PLG or self-serve growth motions. We see this as an opportunity for you to grow into, not a filter we're screening for. This role has a direct line of visibility to the exec/C-suite team on Code Insights strategy and results — you'll be expected to present, and defend, your own work in that setting.Additional InformationBenefits:33 days of holidays (this includes public and religious holidays)Contributions to your Provident Fund which can be matched by the company above the statutory minimum as agreedGratuity paymentsPrivate Medical Insurance provided by the company (Employee + Spouse + 2 Children + 2 Parents)Personal Accident Insurance (Employee Only)12 Weeks Paid Paternity Leave, 6 months Maternity leaveSupport with childcare costs (50%)Work from Home Equipment allowanceFlexible Work from Home policy - 2 days home p/wFlexible Work from Long Distance - 4 weeks a yearSponsored Learning OpportunitiesTeam SocialsStay connected with us on LinkedIn or keep an eye on our career page for future opportunities!

title: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet’s most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet’s data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy

* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America

* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About GeneralMind**

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.

You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.

This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.

**What You'll Do**

* Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.
* Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.
* Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.
* Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.
* Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.
* Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.
* Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
* Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.
* Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.
* A strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
* Fluency in English.
* Excitement about AI-native products and autonomous systems.

title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Director, AI Build, the^delta prize
description:
**About The Team**
the^delta Prize is a platform to draw talent, capital, and public attention towards the most pressing developmental problems in India. the^delta Prize aims to guide markets where they are needed the most, inducing population-scale solutions and innovations that have disproportionate impact on stagnant livelihood opportunities and ecosystems for underserved segments. We research, design and conduct tech-based scale-up competitions to discover and innovate disruptive solutions, and pull in capital to solve the most complex problems in India, faster.
  
  
This role sits within Future Enterprises, the^delta Prize's vertical dedicated to India's MSME sector, and leads day-to-day product and delivery of the AI platform within Samriddhi (AI for MSME prosperity). Samriddhi runs through two approaches: Grand Challenges, and an AI-first platform that connects youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities to career pathways, skilling, apprenticeships and jobs, while helping MSMEs access job-ready talent.
  
  
**Who are we solving for?**
Youth and jobseekers in tier 3–4 cities, whose access to career guidance, skilling and jobs is limited by language, geography and the thin guidance available to them. The platform also serves MSMEs that find it difficult to articulate their hiring requirements and reach job-ready talent.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
India's youth-to-work transition is fragmented across three points. Skilling remains supply-led while MSME demand for talent goes largely unmet. Career guidance for tier 3–4 youth is thin, rarely personalised, and rarely available in the youth's own language or in a voice-first format. The existing landscape of job and skilling platforms is fragmented, with several credible players serving overlapping segments through incompatible systems, which makes duplication the main design risk.
  
  
The platform is designed to address these three points together, and to run on top of existing government-led skilling councils, job and skilling networks and education-employment infrastructure instead of building parallel rails. The ambition is to reach 10–12 million young people over three years.
  
  
**What are we looking for?**
the^delta Prize is looking for a senior AI/product leader to build and lead the technology platform within a new, large-scale AI x MSME initiative in India.
  
  
The first major build is an AI-first workforce readiness and career pathways platform connecting young people to skills,
  
  
apprenticeships and jobs, with a particular focus on the talent needs of India’s MSME sector. The ambition is to reach
  
  
10–12 million young people over three years, working with government systems, skilling and education networks,
  
  
employers and existing digital infrastructure.
  
  
This is a build role, not a program-management role.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**

* Built and shipped a significant technology product/platform, ideally from 0→1 through scale
* Strong working fluency in AI/LLMs, agents, data, APIs and platform architecture — enough to make and

challenge consequential technical decisions
  
  

* Experience with AI-native products, DPI/DPGs, open/interoperable platforms or population-scale digital

systems
  
  

* The product and business judgement to decide what to build, buy, partner or integrate
* The ability to assemble and lead strong engineering/AI partners without relying on a large in-house technology

team
  
  

* The seniority to work across technology companies, startups, government, employers and institutional partners

This could fit a startup founder/CTO/CPO, senior product or platform leader, or DPI/DPG builder looking to apply their
  
  
experience to a consequential India-scale problem.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals, irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Data & AI Strategy Portfolio Lead
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**Work Arrangement:**
Remote with travel as and when to HQ
  
  
**What We Do At Weir**
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably.
  
  
Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. That is why we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we are driving the shift to smarter, more efficient, and sustainable mining.
  
  
**Make Your Impact**
You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. Using your expertise, you will help deliver results that matter, whether through technology, planning, innovation, or collaboration. You’ll work with purpose, learn continuously, and contribute to a more sustainable future.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Portfolio Ownership & Roadmap Delivery: Own the enterprise Data & AI BAU portfolio and prioritisation cycles, maintaining a rolling roadmap aligned with enterprise objectives and S4+ programme constraints. Lead demand intake, triage, and prioritisation processes, ensuring transparent decision-making and preventing duplication or divergence from target data standards and architecture.
* Delivery Accountability: Take accountability for Data, Analytics, and AI delivery outcomes. Establish outcome-focused governance, including objectives, acceptance criteria, and definitions of success. Monitor delivery performance, dependencies, and risks, escalating issues that may impact programme milestones or enterprise standards.
* AI Enablement & Adoption: Lead the adoption of AI across BAU activities by managing an AI use-case pipeline supported by value hypotheses, adoption plans, and benefit tracking. Make pragmatic decisions on whether initiatives should continue, evolve, or stop based on measurable value, risk, sustainability, and alignment to the future-state vision.
* Governance & Partner Management: Oversee Data & AI governance and external partner performance to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, governance requirements, and risk appetite. Balance business value delivery against the potential for technical debt and future rework.
* Transformation Alignment & BAU Absorption: Maintain business-as-usual momentum throughout the S4+ transformation programme while preparing BAU teams to adopt and sustain the new data foundations post-go-live. Collaborate closely with programme leaders to align standards, controls, and operating practices.
* Safety First: Demonstrate a commitment to Weir’s zero-harm culture and actively support the development of world-class safety behaviours and practices.

**What You'll Bring**
**Essential Experience**

* Proven experience leading and delivering Data, Analytics, or AI portfolios in a BAU environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across complex, matrixed organisations.
* Deep expertise in portfolio prioritisation, roadmap management, and balancing value delivery against technical debt.
* Comprehensive understanding of enterprise data platforms, analytics ecosystems, AI adoption approaches, and governance frameworks.

**Desirable Experience**
.
  
  

* Technical background in data architecture, software development, or transformation delivery.
* Experience delivering Data & AI programmes within multinational organisations.
* Experience supporting organisational change associated with automation and AI adoption.
* Knowledge of portfolio management methodologies or value realisation frameworks.

**Why Join Weir?**
At Weir, our values guide everything we do. We put safety first, do the right thing, respect one another, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate success together.
  
  
We are passionate about helping deliver the natural resources essential for building a better future. By combining deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation, we create innovative end-to-end solutions powered by our industry-leading technologies.
  
  
We believe every voice matters. We are committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can do their best work. Through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives, you will have the opportunity to help shape our future culture.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and rewards package.
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning support.
* Access to global inclusion networks and communities.
* Regional and team-specific benefits.
* Sharebuilder scheme.
* Health and wellness support for you and your family.
* Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and experts.
* Study assistance and professional development support.

title: Product Owner

title: Principal Manager, Tech (Treasury Tech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for an exceptional Principal Manager to join the Treasury Tech team in the firm’s office in Bengaluru. Treasury Tech was established in 2021 to integrate DESCO and Arcesium-owned datasets, enabling sophisticated reporting and advanced analytics for Treasury functions. The team partners closely with Front Office systems to deliver critical margin simulation and broker optimization workflows. Core focus areas include measuring broker profitability and building tools to optimize cash and collateral usage while supporting broker negotiations through standardized data views and comparative analytics. A key capability is providing a unified interface for margin simulation, both pre-trade and intraday integrated with Front Office systems to facilitate portfolio and prime broker optimization across complex, multi-counterparty environments. Treasury Tech also delivers insights into total counterparty spend, identifying drivers of commissions and financing costs, while automating manual reporting processes to improve operational efficiency across CRM and Treasury teams. Additionally, the team enhances broker risk reporting to enable proactive monitoring and pre emptive action, helping avoid agreement terminations and excessive collateral requirements by delivering advanced simulation, optimization, and analytics capabilities.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will execute individual projects and deliverables while collaborating closely with DESCO Treasury and other business groups to deeply understand their workflows, challenges, and requirements. You will leverage technology to ideate, design, and deliver high-quality solutions that address complex business needs. Your responsibilities will include performing research and development to evaluate appropriate technologies, resolving application and data issues in production within defined timelines, and driving complete project lifecycles from requirements gathering and analysis through project delivery and deployment to clients. You will provide direction and guidance to junior team members, actively participate in code and design reviews, and champion engineering best practices to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* A bachelor's/master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 8 to 12 years of Software Engineering experience
* Proficiency in Python with robust coding and debugging abilities
* Thorough understanding of software development principles, quantitative abilities, data structures, architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies
* Experience or knowledge of frontend technologies such as React/Redux/Angular/Javascript/NodeJS
* Exposure in managing small to medium-sized teams and in project management
* Attention to detail, effectiveness in interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to work autonomously with focus and discipline
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical skills, and passion for technology
* Excellent communication, creative and strategic thinking skills, and technical expertise to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Prior experience in the financial domain of working with investment banks, HFTs or fintech-based startups

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/ProjMan2026
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
