title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Alexa Smart Properties
description:
**Description**
The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.
  
  
If you’re passionate about building enterprise-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.
  
  
Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights - through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.
  
  
With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.
  
  
Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.
  
  
You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best-of-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.
  
  
On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona - including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.
  
  
You will make informed trade-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.
  
  
You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**Why N-able**
At N-able, we’re not just helping businesses be secure —we’re redefining what it means to be cyber resilient. Our end-to-end platform blends AI-powered capabilities and flexible tech stacks, so customers can manage, secure, and recover with confidence. But the real power behind it all? Our people. We’re a global crew of N-ablites, who love solving complex problems, sharing knowledge, and delivering solutions that actually make a difference. If you're into meaningful work, fast growth, and a team that’s got your back, you’ll be surrounded by people who believe in what they do—and in you.
  
  
We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to own a core area of the
**Adlumin XDR/MDR**
portfolio — its strategy, roadmap, and delivery, leading initiatives in AI DLC model. N-able PMs are full-stack PMs. You'll partner deeply with engineering on what gets built and why, but the job doesn't stop at the backlog. You're expected to know the threat landscape, the competition, and where the technology is heading, and to bring that back into decisions others can act on. You'll be in front of partners and customers regularly and trusted to run your area with limited supervision.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area of the Adlumin XDR/MDR platform, plus the full lifecycle from ideation to launch: market research, product definition, roadmap planning, and go-to-market.
* Translate detection, response, and security operations problems into clear product requirements — and defend the tradeoffs behind them.
* Partner day to day with engineering, data science, and the SOC to deliver capabilities that measurably improve detection quality, response time, and analyst efficiency.
* Run continuous discovery: talk to MSP partners, internal IT teams, SOC analysts, and prospects; separate what people ask for from what they actually need.
* Maintain a live view of the competitive landscape (XDR, MDR, SIEM, EDR, SecOps) and the trends reshaping it, and turn it into positioning and roadmap decisions rather than slideware.
* Define and track the success metrics for your area — adoption, retention, efficacy, unit economics — and act when they move the wrong way.
* Work with product marketing, sales, and service delivery on launches, enablement, and pricing/packaging inputs.
* Apply AI across your workflow and the product: use AI-assisted development practices to move from problem to spec to working software faster, and set the bar for how the team does this.
* Mentor junior product managers and raise the bar for craft across the team.

**What You'll Bring**

* 6+ years in product management, with meaningful time on technical B2B or security products.
* A driver's operating style. Self-motivated, comfortable with ambiguity, effective under loose supervision. You decide, you communicate, you follow through.
* Strong product sense. Good instincts for what to build, what to cut, and what “good” looks like for a security practitioner under time pressure.
* Breadth across cybersecurity, with depth in at least two domains(cloud security, identity, endpoint, network, email, vulnerability management)

**Big Pluses**

* Hands-on experience with XDR, SIEM, SOAR, EDR, or SOC operations - as a product manager, practitioner, or analyst.
* Security certifications (Security+, CISSP, cloud security certs) or a background in security engineering or incident response.
* Experience building AI-powered product capabilities in a security context.
* Practical experience using or experimenting with AI DLC approaches and tooling - spec-driven development frameworks such as GitHub Spec Kit, AI coding agents, prototype-first workflows.

**Purple Perks**

* Group Medical , Personal Accident & Term life coverage
* Generous PTO and observed holidays
* 2 Paid VoluNteer Days per year
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* FuN-raising opportunities as part of our giving program
* N-ablite Learning – custom learning experience as part of our investment in you
* The Way We Work – our hybrid working model based on trust and flexibility

**About N-able**
At N-able, Inc. (NYSE: NABL), we are a global software company that turns IT possibilities into capabilities. That means we partner with technology leaders who support companies around the world by offering secure infrastructure and tools to navigate their evolving IT needs. We build strong relationships with our customers to help them thrive at every stage of growth, and at the heart of this effort is our network of N-ablites—a global team of extraordinary, diverse creators who are dedicated to making a difference in how our partners do IT.

title: Product Manager- Edge computing
description:

A fast-scaling tech firm specializing in edge computing and distributed infrastructure solutions, we enable enterprises to process data closer to the source—driving low-latency, real-time decision-making across IoT, manufacturing, telecom, and smart city verticals. Our product teams architect next-gen edge platforms that unify hardware abstraction, orchestration, and AI inference at the network’s edge—scaling reliably from factory floors to 5G towers.

* IoT platforms
* Kubernetes
* Containerization
* Product roadmap
* User stories
* API design

**Preferred**

* Telecom or manufacturing domain

title: Senior Product Manager, Payments
description:
**Let’s Build What’s Next, Together.**
We are Spotnana. We’re on a mission to modernize the infrastructure of the $11.7 trillion travel industry to power the perfect trip for travelers everywhere. Our Travel-as-a-Service platform is designed to make every trip better, whether someone is booking for work or leisure travel, building a travel tool, or looking to offer personalized experiences at scale.
  
  
We’re not just modernizing tech, we’re rethinking how the industry works. And to get there, we’re bringing together innovative, ambitious, and open-minded people who want to build something that lasts.
  
  
At Spotnana, our values and principles guide how we work and grow together:
  
  

* Build the future – We are leaders, we are innovators, we are ambitious.
* Commit to excellence – We’re accountable, we are partners, we are agile.
* Stronger together – We lead with respect and integrity, we are inclusive, we are lifelong learners.

* Technical background and ability to engage engineers on architecture and trade-offs, and translate technical capabilities/constraints into product decisions. A software engineering background is welcome but not required.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done.

title: Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
**Vacancy Name**
Senior Product Manager - AI
  
  
**Vacancy No**
VN1077
  
  
**Job Title**
Senior Product Manager - AI
  
  
**Work Location City**
Bangalore
  
  
**About Solifi**
Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.
  
  
**About the Position**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.
  
  
**Role and Responsibilities**
Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.
  
  
**About You**
What We Are Looking For:
  
  

* 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products.
* Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome.
* Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products.
* Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems.
* Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior.
* Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs.
* Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration.
* Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product.
* Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains.
* Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability.
* Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system.
* Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart:
* You have taken an AI product from hypothesis → prototype → evaluation → production → continuous monitoring and improvement.
* You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products.
* You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow.
* You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences.
* You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it.
* You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features.
* You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

**Preferred Experience Level 7 Years**
**Preferred Education Level**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Employment Basis**
Full Time
  
  
**Benefits**
Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave
  
  
**Applications Close Date**
07 Apr 2027

title: Product Manager - Consumer Platform

**About Rupeek**

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, Rupeek is an asset-backed digital lending fintech making credit more accessible by helping Indians unlock the value of their gold. We combine technology, customer-focused design, and on-ground execution to make borrowing simpler and more convenient.

Rupeek is backed by leading investors including
**Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia), Accel, Bertelsmann India Investments, and Elevation Capital**
.

Join us to solve meaningful challenges at the intersection of consumer experience, technology, and financial services—with ownership to shape products and see their impact on customers and the business.

Collaborate with
**Sumit Maniyar
, Founder & CEO**
,
**Setu Poddar
, CTO**
, and Rupeek’s business and operations leaders. Gain firsthand exposure to company strategy, contribute to important product decisions, and build products alongside the people shaping Rupeek’s next phase of growth.

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
3–5 years in product management

**The opportunity**

**Build the platform that helps the teams deliver faster, more reliable customer outcomes.**

As Product Manager for the Platform team, you’ll own products that power lending. Your users will be the teams executing customer journeys every day, and your work will directly influence their productivity, service quality, and cost to serve.

You’ll spend time understanding how work happens on the ground, uncover bottlenecks, and turn complex workflows into simple, dependable tools. This role is for someone who enjoys solving problems where software meets real-world execution.

**What you’ll own**

* **Business workflows:**

  Shadow frontline and operations teams to understand workarounds, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.

  Reduce repetitive work, manual handoffs, and avoidable errors through better product design and automation.

* **Product strategy and delivery:**
  Own your roadmap, make clear trade-offs, and partner with engineering, design, business, risk, and compliance from discovery through rollout.
* **Adoption and outcomes:**
  Ensure products work in practice, measure adoption, and iterate based on results.

**What success looks like**

Faster turnaround times, fewer errors and escalations, higher team productivity, stronger platform adoption, and a lower cost to serve—while maintaining service quality and appropriate controls.

**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years of product management experience, with ownership of products from problem discovery to measurable outcomes.
* The ability to break down complex processes and design for both everyday workflows and exceptions.
* Strong analytical skills; comfort using data to identify bottlenecks and evaluate impact.
* Empathy for operational users and a willingness to learn directly from teams on the ground.
* Clear communication, sound prioritization, and effective collaboration with engineering and business teams.
* Experience with customer platforms, internal tools, logistics, fintech, or workflow-heavy products is valuable. SQL proficiency is a plus.

**Why this role**

* **See your impact in daily operations:**
  Build products that change how teams work and how customers experience Rupeek.
* **Solve substantial product problems:**
  Work across software, people, and physical processes.
* **Own outcomes end to end:**
  Shape the problem, influence the solution, and follow it through to adoption.
* **Build for scale:**
  Help to handle growth with greater efficiency and consistency.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Staff Product Manager | Adtech | Retail
  
  
**About The Role**
We're building India's premium retail media platform, taking the commerce and AdTech infrastructure we've built and battle-tested at scale and externalizing it as a high-performance ads platform for brands, sellers and retail partners. This is a rare opportunity to productize proven infrastructure: high-QPS ad serving inside live shopping journeys, rich first-party commerce signals and closed-loop measurement that connects ad spend directly to sales.
  
  
We're looking for a Staff product manager who can operate as true owners, people who go deep on the problem, write the doc, align the room, ship, refine and repeat. This is an individual contributor role with outsized scope and direct access to leadership, customers and partners.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own the product end-to-end. Break down the vision, define the scope for your area of the retail media stack- from competitor research and seller ecosystem discoveries through PRDs, MVPs, launch and iteration. You write crisp docs, and your docs drive decisions.
* Translate business goals into product strategy. Take ambiguous, high-stakes objectives, monetization targets, brand adoption, shopper experience guardrails and turn them into a clear, sequenced roadmap with measurable outcomes.
* Ship, measure, refine. Break complex problems into executable slices, run tight sprints with engineering, define success metrics upfront (ROAS, ACOS, relevance scores, incrementality) and iterate fast on real data, delivering at scale and on time.
* Build experiences, not just features. Obsess over both sides of the marketplace: brands and sellers who need intuitive self-serve tools, and shoppers whose experience must never degrade for the sake of monetization. Think in ecosystems campaign consoles, APIs, reporting, retail partner workflows, not isolated deliverables.
* Balance relevance and revenue. Partner deeply with search, recommendations and data science teams on auction mechanics, product relevance/ranking and ad-load decisions where commerce relevance and monetization meet.
* Drive alignment across the company. Work daily with engineering, QA, ops, category, and seller-facing teams and liaise with Legal, Finance, IT, and Regulatory on the things that make or break an ad platform including (but not limiting to) privacy, compliance, billing, fair marketplace policies.
* Be the face of the product externally. Engage directly with brands, sellers, retail and tech partners, from discovery conversations to API and feed integration deep-dives and bring their voice back into the roadmap.
* Influence without authority. Communicate product vision clearly to senior leadership and key stakeholders and shape how the platform is positioned in the retail media market.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 4-8 years of product management experience, with meaningful time in retail media or commerce ads. You've built or scaled ad products on a marketplace, e-commerce/q-commerce platforms, retail media networks or commerce DSPs.
* Hands-on exposure to the retail media stack. Sponsored products, sponsored brands, PLA/PLP (collection based display ads), Search Ads. Understands ad placements, auction design and bidding (CPC/CPM, second-price), budget pacing and self-serve campaign management for advertisers of every size from enterprise brands to long-tail sellers.
* Fluency in commerce data and measurement. First-party shopper signals, catalog and feed integrations, closed-loop attribution, ROAS and incrementality measurement with exposure to clean rooms, audience products with offsite extension to programmatic and social.
* Strong grasp of marketplace dynamics and privacy. You understand the tension between ad load and shopper experience, fair-ranking and marketplace-neutrality considerations and the evolving privacy landscape (DPDP, GDPR, consent frameworks, and the post-cookie shift).
* Sharp analytical instincts. You're comfortable in data, defining metrics, sizing opportunities, debugging funnel drops and making a quantitative case for your roadmap.

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. JioStar India Private Limited (formerly known as Star India Private Limited) is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

As a P5 Lead Product Manager Analyst AI for Marketing and Prospecting, you own Agent Use Case Definition & Business Outcomes by identifying high-impact business workflows. You define technically viable agent requirements and translate business problems into clearly defined agent capabilities feasible within the enterprise tech stack. For Applications Workflow Design & Orchestration, you define the end-to-end workflow an agent will perform across enterprise systems, specifying triggers, context, actions, and escalation paths. You handle Collaboration, Value measurement, and Continuous improvement by defining success metrics, tracking outcomes, and refining agent behaviors based on operational feedback. Finally, you manage Autonomous Boundaries and Safety by determining the extent of agent autonomy, defining guardrails, approval checkpoints, and the human-in-the-loop model.
  
  
This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Martech & Prospecting Applications.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Identify the highest-value problems for business development, sales and account executives where an agent can save time, reduce effort, and take useful action
* Be very savvy with data, crunch the current state funnel metrics, and pipeline performances to determine the highest value use cases to agentify
* Influence senior leaders and cross-functional teams on use cases we should automate, what to build first, and how to stay at the forefront of this space
* Understand intent signals, prospecting signals, propensity scores, next best recommendations etc to determine the best execution strategies for prospecting
* Evaluate rapidly new capabilities from model providers, tooling ecosystems, and internal platforms, and translate them into clear product bets
* Build scrappy but convincing prototypes using available models, agent frameworks, tools, and lightweight interfaces to test usefulness, trust, and feasibility
* Partner with engineering, ML, design, and platform teams to turn promising prototypes into scalable product experiences
* Shape how memory, context, orchestration, permissions, and human handoff should work in prospecting journeys
* Define safe patterns for agents that take action, including clear explanations, user approvals, visibility into what the agent is doing, and recovery paths when things go wrong
* Establish success metrics, launch criteria, and learning loops for these experiences, balancing ambition with trust, reliability, latency, and cost

Job Designation
  
  
**Hybrid:**
Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)
  
  
Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Basic**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including meaningful work on AI/ML products, automation systems, developer tools, platforms, or other technically sophisticated products.
* Hands-on builder mindset, with the ability to use model APIs, agent tooling, and simple code in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript to create or guide working prototypes
* Proven track record of taking new product areas from ambiguous opportunity to strategy, prototype, launch, and measurable impact

**Preferred**

* Experience building assistants, agents, copilots, or AI products that use tools to complete tasks
* Familiarity with memory, tool calling, browser or computer use, voice, multimodal interaction, or agent orchestration
* Background in software engineering, ML, data science, or a similarly technical field
* Strong point of view on when an agent should act autonomously, when it should ask for permission, and how to keep users in controlStrong technical fluency and comfort working at the boundary of product and engineering and be able to reason about APIs, orchestration, data flows, permissions, latency, and failure modes
* Strong judgment in trust-sensitive experiences, including transparency, control, privacy, and reliability
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders
* Strong Data Analysis, Data Science and engineering skills

Life at Docusign
  
  
**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
  
  
We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Staff Inbound Product Manager - Hill Climbing Product and Customer Instance Program
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the role**
AI Specialists don’t get better by accident. Hill climbing is how we improve them. We test against real customer environments, find what’s failing, fix it, and test again. Now we want every AI Specialist team to climb this way, faster, and without needing us to run it for them. You’ll own the product and the program that make that happen.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the hill climbing product roadmap and scale it across our priority AI Specialists and beyond.
* Run the customer instance program with our business units and product teams, expanding access to real customer environments so every specialist is tested where it actually runs.
* Cut the loop time from a shipped change to a clear, actionable quality verdict from weeks to days.
* Convert eval findings into prioritized fixes with specialist product teams, and stay with those teams until the fixes ship.
* Turn hill climbing into a method product teams can run on their own, with the tools, guides and defaults to do it well and without heavy support from our team.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* You have 9 or more years of work experience, including product management on AI or ML products in production.
* You’ve owned a product roadmap and scaled a product from one team to many.
* You’ve run fast improvement loops on ML or LLM systems, from experiments and error analysis to prioritized fixes that shipped.
* You’ve taken a process that needed expert support and turned it into a tool or method other teams use without you in the room.
* You can line up product, engineering and business teams behind one plan and keep it moving.
* You have experience with agentic AI, enterprise workflow software or the ServiceNow platform.

FD21
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Product Owner - Success Factor Compensation
description:
Who you are

Are you passionate about Total Rewards and how it creates a comprehensive offer for co-workers? Do you enjoy understanding how systems, processes, and workflows connect end-to-end? Are you someone with a genuine interest in how to improve through a smart combination of technology and processes? If yes — keep reading, this might be your next role!

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Total Rewards team. You will play a key role in shaping and maintaining our Total Rewards area.

We believe you bring:

* Strong knowledge of HR domain and HR processes and systems – SAP SuccessFactors, ADP Global View, Benefits, Variable Pay
* Experience in data standardization — data models, consistency, and quality
* Experience owning and communicating a product roadmap, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines
* The ability to identify gaps in data pipelines and translate them into clear use cases for engineering teams
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — you can bridge business, data, and technology
* 5–6 years of experience in a similar role within HR Tech and product-oriented environments Proven experience in collaboration driven outcome Strong communication and visualization skills

A day in your life with us

As a Product Owner in the Total Rewards team, you will play a key role in ensuring that our products across the Total Rewards landscape (Success Factor, Global View, Benefit, as well as in-house built systems) delivers value to the business and supports efficient, data-driven decision-making.

You will take ownership of the area, continuously improving it by aligning capabilities with business needs. You will work hands-on with roadmap tools and jira, ensuring solutions support how we actually operate.

You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the bigger platform area, ensuring alignment and driving adoption.

This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, where your work directly impacts our many co-workers.

This means that you will:

* Own the overall Total Rewards area end-to-end in a product perspective
* Translate business needs into solutions, workflows, and improvements
* Identify gaps between capabilities and business needs, and define solutions
* Work with various needs, requests and non-functional requirements and consolidate into a product backlog
* Collaborate with our global business organization, center of excellence as well as our config- and engineering teams
* Support planning, prioritization, and backlog work
* Ensure structured and reliable data/process flows
* Drive adoption by ensuring solutions are practical and user-friendly
* Manage stakeholders proactively and ensure alignment
* Continuously improve processes, usage, and quality

Together as a Team

You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organization.

You will be part of a team that is leading the Total Rewards digital solutions — with a clear vision: to bring our Total Rewards solutions to our many co-workers.

We are a team that believes in:

* Being data driven in our approach and decisions
* Collaborate between people and teams in a pragmatic and open way
* Continuously learn and improve – the landscape is evolving and so are we
* Transparency - we communicate our roadmap clearly and hold ourselves accountable to it
* IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive.
* We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together

Job Title: AEM Product Owner
  
  
**Role Overview**
At Bridgestone Retail Operations the Customer is #1. BSRO operates more than 2,200 stores and employs over 21,000 teammates in the United States and is the industry leader in Complete Auto Care. Our locations include the Firestone Complete Auto Care, Tires Plus, Hibdon Tires and Wheel Works brands.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for an experienced
**Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Product Owner**
to lead the development and enhancement of our AEM-based digital experiences. This role requires a deep understanding of
**AEM capabilities, content management, and personalization**
, combined with Agile product ownership expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and UX designers to ensure AEM-powered solutions align with business objectives and provide exceptional user experiences.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy & Planning:

+ Define AEM-based product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with organizational goals.
+ Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews to identify opportunities.
+ Translate business objectives into actionable product goals and deliverables.

* Product Development:

+ Collaborate with engineering and design teams to define product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure timely delivery on AEM product backlog.
+ Develop user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria to guide development teams.
+ Monitor progress and resolve bottlenecks during the product development lifecycle.

* Stakeholder Management:

+ Serve as the primary liaison between stakeholders, customers, and development teams.
+ Communicate product updates, release plans, and feedback loops effectively to all stakeholders.
+ Balance competing priorities and ensure alignment across all teams.

* Performance & Feedback:

+ Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate product success.
+ Gather and analyze customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
+ Conduct post-launch reviews and implement learnings into future product cycles.

**AEM Content & Experience Optimization**




+ Drive enhancements in content management, workflows, and personalization to maximize AEM’s potential.
+ Oversee AEM integrations with analytics, CRM, e-commerce, and marketing automation platforms.
+ Utilize Adobe Analytics, Target, or similar tools to measure engagement and optimize user experiences.

* Market & Customer Focus:

+ Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and customer needs.
+ Identify opportunities for product differentiation and innovation.
+ Advocate for the customer to ensure the product delivers value and a great user experience.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–7 years of experience in product management or related roles.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
* Technical Skills: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Trello), and data analysis tools.
* Customer Focus: Strong understanding of customer needs, behavior, and market dynamics.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate product vision and requirements clearly.
* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with the ability to solve complex problems and make data-driven decisions.
* Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage stakeholders.

title: Product Specialist - UBOR
description:
**Company Overview**

Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant, early in their career (with 1 to 2 years of post-qualification experience), to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Gurugram/Hyderabad/Bengaluru office as an Individual Contributor. This product team is responsible for the core portfolio and P&L accounting product offering on our platform. This role offers the opportunity to build strong domain expertise in fund and portfolio accounting for some of the most sophisticated hedge funds in the world, while working closely with engineers, product managers, and client-facing teams.

**What You'll Do:**

* Carry the product/feature from concept to creation
* Brainstorm product/feature and its value proposition to our client base
* Distill the vision into documents such as product roadmap and product/feature specification via deep dives into domain, gathering requirements and/or business analysis
* Work closely with the engineers/architects to translate the Product Specification to design, and then to the product itself
* Prepare comprehensive business test cases/beds to aid the engineering process
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of product/feature-in-flight by leveraging the created test cases/beds and ensure compliance to the product/feature specification and the vision
* Track and question risks/assumptions
* Proactively escalate issues and mitigate execution risks

**What You'll Need:**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1-2 years of post-qualification experience
* Strong foundation in accounting principles, financial statements, and journal entries
* Working knowledge of, or strong aptitude to quickly learn, fund/portfolio accounting concepts such as NAV, P&L, accruals, and corporate actions.
* Knowledge on fixed income and derivatives will be an added advantage.
* Comfortable working in Excel; exposure to SQL. Python or LLM agentic tools is an added advantage
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and timeliness
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage multiple lines of work under tight deadlines
* Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to work directly with stakeholders
* A collaborative attitude and willingness to learn from and work closely with cross-functional Engineering, Product, and Operations teams
* Outstanding academic background and a genuine interest in financial markets and technology

**Job Description**
The Alternatives Product organization seeks a qualified leader with strong experience and interest in leading alternatives projects for our alternatives product organization, primarily within Private Equity & PE Fund of Funds. The individual must bring strong experience in Alternative Asset Classes and program/project management to manage complex business transformation and technology development. This role will interact directly with key stakeholders across the business, technology and within the product organization, including senior management. The successful candidate must have excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, be highly organized, and have a good understanding of our Alternatives business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and/or perform the execution of specified Alternative development programs, with a focus on Private Equity and PE Fund of Funds, including partnering with other members of the client facing, product, global delivery and technology teams.
* Use latest AI technology to manage project documentation including business case creation, requirements, development plans.
* Facilitate program governance including compliance with policies, best practices, oversight of issues, risks, audit and compliance items in support of program reporting.
* Participate as product owner or business analyst for agile development programs including prioritization, epic & story creation, status tracking, execution status meetings, issue escalation/resolution, testing & implementation
* Collaborate globally across business units to share approaches, develop best practices and improve the teams capabilities to successfully execute and deliver new capabilities or better serve clients.
* Manage project status meetings, ensuring complete and accurate reporting and updates for senior management and key stakeholders around issues, risks, progress and accomplishments.
* Understand the firm’s strategic plans, business, process and architecture and apply that knowledge in the solution design and development phases.

**Skills**

* Highly proficient in AI
* Highly organized, strong analytic skills, ability to operate independently and to move seamlessly between multiple projects/implementations with changing client requirements
* Ability to organize, prioritize, balance key tasks and manage time effectively.

* Working knowledge of SDLC, Jira, Clarity and other development related tools.

title: Senior Product Owner, Workday HCM & Onboarding
description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Senior Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
  
  
This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding & Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player-manager who both delivers and develops.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to review, validate, and contribute to configuration work alongside the Associate Product Owner.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Review and approve design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Support the Associate Product Owner(s) in day-to-day delivery, providing guidance, review, and quality oversight.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Team Development**

* In the near term, work closely with and provide functional guidance to the Associate Product Owner(s) aligned to your module area.
* As the team grows, take on formal line management responsibility for your Associate Product Owner — supporting their development, performance, and career growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role)**
Depending on the specific Product Owner role, candidates should bring deep expertise in one or more of the following clusters:
  
  

* Core HCM, Onboarding & Workday Help: Org design, job architecture, business process configuration, worker data, Workday Help case management.
* Compensation & Advanced Compensation: Salary structures, merit and bonus plans, compensation cycles, equity, allowances, and global pay practices.
* Recruiting, Paradox & HiredScore: Recruiting business processes, offer management, candidate experience, AI screening tools, and sourcing integrations.
* Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
* US Benefits & US Payroll: Open enrollment, benefit plans, ACA compliance, payroll processing, tax configuration, and off-cycle runs.
* People Analytics & Peakon: Workday Prism Analytics, dashboards, engagement survey design, action planning, and People Analytics storytelling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Our People Technology team sits at the centre of this multi-entity, multi-jurisdictional operating model. We run a single Workday tenant that serves a federated landscape of PortCos, each with its own workforce, HR policies, compensation structures, payroll requirements, and compliance obligations. This complexity demands technology professionals who thrive in ambiguity, operate with an enterprise mindset, and can design solutions that scale across legal entities, geographies, and business models.

title: Founder’s Office Associate - Product & Growth
description:
**Build things. Open markets. Turn opportunities into revenue.**

We’re looking for a curious, resourceful builder with 1–2 years of experience to work closely with our founders across product, market launches, partnerships, and growth. You’ll help us figure out what to build, where to expand, and how to make the company work better. Then you’ll get involved in making it happen. Some days, you’ll be exploring a new market or speaking with a banking infrastructure partner. Other days, you’ll be prototyping a product idea, building an internal tool, or helping turn a promising opportunity into revenue. The common thread: understand the problem, exercise good judgment, and carry the work through.

**What you’ll work on**

**Market launches:**

Research opportunities, understand customer needs and local requirements, and work with our teams to bring new offerings to market.

**Product decisions:**

Turn customer conversations, partner capabilities, and business needs into clear recommendations, prototypes, and experiments.

**Internal tools:**

Build tools and automations that remove repetitive work and help people across the company get more done.

**Partnerships:**

Find and engage potential partners, including banks and infrastructure providers, and help move relationships from initial conversations to working partnerships.

**Revenue:**

Identify commercial opportunities, support customer conversations, and help turn ideas and partnerships into measurable business.

You’ll own defined projects from discovery through execution, working closely with the founders and the teams involved.

**Who you are**

* You have 1–2 years of experience in product, an early-stage startup, solutions, partnerships, or another role where you’ve taken meaningful ownership.
* You have product instinct: you ask good questions, understand who a solution is for, and can decide what is worth building.
* You already use Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools to build working prototypes, internal tools, or automations.
* You can explain technical ideas clearly and hold a thoughtful conversation with a customer, engineer, or banking partner.
* You write clearly, follow through, and ask for help when it matters.
* You enjoy learning unfamiliar things and making progress when the path isn’t fully defined.

**Why join**

Work directly with the founders, get close to consequential product and commercial decisions, and see your work become tools people use, partnerships that launch, and revenue the company earns.

**To apply**

Send your portfolio or work sample to rajith@volopay.co, CC: sandeep.juttuga@volopay.co, and tell us what you built or drove forward, what problem you were solving, what you personally did, and what the outcome was.

title: Principle Supply Chain AI Solution Lead
description:
**Job Summary:**

* Champion the implementation and scale-up of advanced AI and AI Agent solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot and custom generative AI assistants) across the global supply chain, bridging business needs with digital technology capabilities to accelerate transformation.
* Lead the introduction of new digitalization capabilities by integrating generative AI tools and AI co-worker (Copilot-style) functionalities into supply chain processes, driving greater efficiency, enhanced decision-making, and semi-automation of routine tasks.
* Serve as a cross-functional product owner for supply chain AI initiatives, coordinating with supply chain teams, IT, and data science to ensure AI tools align with business goals, integrate with enterprise systems (ERP, analytics platforms), and deliver measurable value.

**A Day in the Life:**

* Start the day by reviewing AI tool usage and adoption metrics (e.g., how employees are using new Copilot features or AI assistants). Address any overnight user feedback or technical incidents to continuously improve the AI tools’ performance and user experience.
* Mid-morning: Host a workshop with supply chain process owners to identify and prioritize new opportunities where AI co-workers or generative AI could streamline tasks (such as automating data analysis or augmenting planning decisions). Collaboratively outline use cases and gather requirements.
* Midday: Collaborate with IT and data engineering to fine-tune AI configurations or set up Copilot Studio agents and workflows, ensuring solutions are technically sound and securely integrated with SAP/Oracle ERP systems and data platforms.
* Afternoon: Lead a training session for end-users (planners, buyers, analysts) to drive adoption of a new AI capability. Demonstrate real-world scenarios (e.g., using a supply chain Copilot to expedite report generation or analyze inventory) and share best practices to build user confidence.
* Late afternoon: Develop or refine change management communications – such as announcements, how-to guides, FAQs – to support upcoming AI tool releases. Emphasize business benefits, user guidelines, and available support, fostering an environment of openness to digital change.
* End the day by compiling a progress update for leadership. Highlight key milestones (e.g., pilot results, adoption rates, early wins like time saved) and outline next steps or resource needs for the AI roadmap. Plan for future iterations and new AI pilots based on feedback and evolving technology.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI & Digital Capability Introduction: Identify, evaluate, and introduce new AI and digital automation tools (including generative AI co-pilots, AI assistants, multi-agent solutions) to digitize and improve supply chain processes. Translate manual or legacy workflows into AI-enabled, efficient operations.
* Enterprise AI Implementation & Integration: Lead cross-functional projects to implement and scale AI co-worker capabilities (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot features, custom Copilot Studio agents) in the supply chain environment. Ensure seamless integration of these solutions with existing systems (ERP, planning tools, data platforms) and embed AI outputs into daily workflows for direct business use.
* Product Ownership & Value Delivery: Act as the Product Owner for supply chain AI initiatives from concept through deployment. Develop business cases, define scope and success metrics, and coordinate development and deployment. Track and communicate value delivered (operational improvements, ROI) to stakeholders.
* Change Management & Adoption: Own the change management strategy for AI tool rollout. Drive user adoption through comprehensive plans – stakeholder alignment, training programs, internal marketing, user support, and feedback loops. Ensure high end-user engagement and smooth transitions to AI-enhanced processes.
* Governance & Compliance: Ensure AI solutions adhere to enterprise governance, security, and responsible AI policies. Obtain necessary approvals (e.g., for sensitive data usage in AI), maintain clear documentation, and enforce guidelines for safe, ethical AI usage in supply chain contexts.
* Continuous Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging AI and digital trends (advances in co-pilot capabilities, new automation tools, enhancements in generative AI) and proactively recommend new pilot projects or improvements. Foster a culture of innovation, regularly refining the digital supply chain roadmap to incorporate promising technologies.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field (Master’s/MBA preferred). 8+ years of combined experience in supply chain operations and digital/technology implementation roles, with at least 3+ years leading AI-driven or digital transformation initiatives.
* AI & Digital Tools Expertise: Hands-on experience launching and scaling enterprise AI “co‑worker” solutions – such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, generative AI assistants/chatbots, or custom Copilot Studio agents. Demonstrated ability to define use cases, configure/implement these tools, manage their rollout and drive successful adoption in a business environment.
* Project & Change Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects introducing new technology. Strong skills in change management, including developing user adoption strategies, training plans, and communications to ensure new digital capabilities are embraced by target users.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Familiarity with AI/ML technologies (e.g., basic understanding of large language models, prompt engineering, data analytics). Comfortable working with enterprise systems and integrating digital tools via APIs or low-code platforms (e.g., Power Platform). Able to analyze process data and AI output to refine solutions and demonstrate value.
* Supply Chain Domain Knowledge: Solid knowledge of supply chain processes and systems (planning, procurement, sourcing, logistics) in a manufacturing or operations environment. Understanding of ERP data (SAP/Oracle) and analytics tools in decision-making, to effectively integrate and tailor AI solutions.
* Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills. Able to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders – explaining AI solutions in business terms and gathering business requirements for technical teams. A collaborative team player who can align diverse groups toward common digital goals.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Data Science) is a plus.
* Strategic & Innovative Mindset: Demonstrated ability to shape and execute a digital transformation strategy. Experience identifying opportunities to use AI/digital solutions to solve business challenges, and balancing innovation with governance in a large enterprise context.
* Broader Technology Skills: Familiarity with cloud-based AI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML services). Exposure to Robotic Process Automation (RPA) or similar process automation tools. Understanding of data architecture and data governance principles.
* Global Business Experience: Experience working in global, cross-functional teams or multi-site projects. Proven success leading change across different regions or cultures, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs.
* Certifications: Professional certifications in project management (PMP, Agile/Scrum) or change management (e.g., Prosci) are desirable. Any relevant AI/ML or data analytics certifications (e.g., Azure AI, data science) is an advantage, signaling continuous learning.

**Success Measures:**

* Deployment & Adoption: Number and reach of new AI capabilities delivered, and their adoption rates among target users. Measured by active usage metrics and user satisfaction scores, indicating that AI co-worker tools (like Copilot features) are being utilized effectively.
* Process Efficiency Gains: Improvements in supply chain process metrics attributable to AI tools – such as reductions in manual work hours, faster planning cycles or data analysis, increased throughput, or improved accuracy in routine tasks due to AI support.
* Business Impact & ROI: Tangible business value realized from AI initiatives, demonstrated by return on investment or impact on key performance indicators. Examples include cost savings, faster decision making, improved inventory management or service levels, and other quantifiable benefits tied to AI-enabled solutions.

title: Lead ML Operations Engineer
description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

**Job Summary**

Acts as the primary technical and functional owner for Copilot-based solutions, managing the lifecycle of AI use cases and ensuring alignment with enterprise policies and standards.

* Copilot / GenAI Platforms Hands-on experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, or similar enterprise GenAI platforms.
* Product Ownership / Delivery Experience Experience managing product backlog, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement for AI or digital products.
* AI Champions / Federated AI Model Exposure Experience working in federated AI environments or enabling business users to build and scale AI solutions.

* Governance & Compliance Understanding of AI governance processes (PIA/BIA, security, privacy, DLP).
* Agent Lifecycle & Platform Understanding Experience or familiarity with agent development, deployment, environment management, and monitoring.
* Technical Skills Proficiency in Python and SQL with ability to analyze data and evaluate AI outputs.
* Leadership & Communication Strong stakeholder management and ability to work across business and technical teams.

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Product Operations Lead
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Lead Product Operations Manager to oversee the operational aspects of our product portfolio. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of our products, optimizing processes, and driving successful product launches. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in operations management, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for driving excellence in product operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product and NPI execution**

* Lead and coordinate Product Operations activities across ideation, discovery, development, launch readiness, commercialization, and post-launch reviews.
* Improve the quality and consistency of NPI deliverables, including discovery outputs, Voice of Customer evidence, value propositions, business cases, launch plans, and readiness reviews.
* Establish and maintain milestone, risk, dependency, and action tracking for priority NPI programs.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, clearly documenting decisions, owners, due dates, and escalations.
* Monitor NPI performance and generate actionable insights to improve launch quality, predictability, adoption, and commercial execution.
* Support root-cause and corrective-action activities for delayed, underperforming, or at-risk offerings.

**Process governance and operational excellence**

* Deploy and sustain Honeywell Accelerator Global Design Models and associated governance routines.
* Drive adherence to standard work while identifying opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate duplication, and reduce administrative burden for Offering and Portfolio Managers.
* Build repeatable intake, prioritization, governance, documentation, and escalation mechanisms.
* Partner with process owners and subject-matter experts to resolve gaps across tools, workflows, roles, and decision rights.
* Identify and implement practical automation, AI, reporting, and workflow improvements that increase team productivity and data quality.
* Create reusable job aids, templates, training materials, and best-practice resources.

**Portfolio and lifecycle operations**

* Support portfolio-review cadences by consolidating data, validating inputs, preparing decision materials, and tracking agreed actions.
* Enable portfolio roadmap execution and maintain the operational data needed for product and offering decisions.
* Translate product, market, customer, financial, and operational data into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Maintain decision logs and action registers that improve transparency and follow-through.

**Customer, market, and commercial evidence**

* Support Voice of Customer planning, evidence collection, data management, and analytical synthesis.
* Develop or coordinate centralized customer, market, and competitive insights for product and portfolio teams.
* Support ideation events, discovery workshops, segmentation, market assessment, and value-proposition activities.
* Connect customer evidence and market insights to portfolio, investment, roadmap, launch, and commercialization decisions.
* Support sales enablement and commercial readiness activities for priority launches.

**Cross-functional leadership**

* Serve as the operating connector among OLering Management, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance, PMO, and business leadership.
* Influence teams without direct authority and create clarity across complex, multistakeholder initiatives.
* Facilitate productive governance forums and ensure issues reach the appropriate decision-makers.
* Communicate risks, choices, recommendations, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Coach stakeholders on Product Operations processes, tools, data expectations, and standard work.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing, operations, data analytics, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, Portfolio Management, Business Operations, or a related cross functional role.
* Experience coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and milestones.
* Strong analytical skills and experience transforming data into decision-ready reporting and recommendations.
* Proficiency in business reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI.
* Strong written communication, executive presentation, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to establish structure, improve processes, and drive accountability in an ambiguous environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or an advanced degree in business, product management, engineering management, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience supporting new product introduction, product development, launch readiness, or commercialization.
* Familiarity with Voice of Customer, discovery, segmentation, competitive analysis, and value-proposition development.
* Experience creating management operating systems, dashboards, governance routines, training content, or standard work.
* Experience applying automation, AI, or workflow tools to improve operational productivity.
* Experience working in a matrixed, global industrial technology, automation, software, or engineering organization.

**Leadership Attributes**
