title: Product Manager II
description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager/Product Manager**

**About Eloelo Group**

Eloelo Group is one of India’s fastest-growing consumer technology companies, building category-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group’s flagship products, Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning, have together placed two Eloelo apps in India’s Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day.

**About Master**

Master is India’s #1 micro-learning app. It scaled to
**5M+ users in 50 days**
and offers
**1,000+ bite-sized courses**
across AI, finance, English, and life skills, making learning as easy and addictive as scrolling short videos.

**Role Overview**

As an Associate Product Manager or Product Manager at Master, you will own one or more key product areas end-to-end, such as course discovery and recommendations, the lesson and learning experience, onboarding, gamification and habit loops, AI-powered learning features, or subscriptions and monetisation. You will work at the intersection of user research, data, design, content, and engineering to build a learning product that millions of Indians open every day. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who is user-obsessed, data-informed, and ready to execute.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your product area, in line with Master’s business goals.
* Find opportunities through user research, data analysis, competitor benchmarking, and stakeholder input.
* Prioritise features using structured frameworks (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW) to maximise impact.

Discovery & User Research

* Run qualitative and quantitative research to understand how learners discover, consume, and complete courses.
* Turn insights into clear problem statements and well-defined product requirements.
* Validate assumptions through A/B tests, user interviews, usability testing, and analytics.

Execution & Delivery

* Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the engineering and design teams.
* Work with engineering leads to scope, plan, and ship features on time with high quality.
* Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management for your pod.

Data, Metrics & Growth

* Define and track key metrics, such as DAU/MAU, D1/D7/D30 retention, lessons completed, course completion rate, streaks, and free-to-paid conversion, and own the dashboards for them.
* Use data to drive product decisions, find growth levers, and change course when needed.
* Build a culture of experimentation by designing, launching, and analysing A/B tests.

Learning Experience & AI

* Work with the content team to shape bite-sized course formats that keep learners engaged and help them finish.
* Build personalisation and AI-powered features, such as smart course recommendations, AI tutors, adaptive learning paths, and quizzes.
* Design habit-forming loops through streaks, rewards, reminders, and progress tracking.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver a cohesive product.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results clearly to leadership and partner teams.
* Be the voice of the learner in every decision.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in product management or a related product role, preferably at a consumer internet, edtech, content, or subscription company.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL and product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, CleverTap, or similar), and able to turn data into action.
* Experience writing PRDs and working in agile teams.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive alignment across teams.
* Clear communication and storytelling skills.
* A strong ownership mindset and the ability to deliver in a fast-paced environment.

**Good-to-Have**

* Prior experience with video streaming platforms, OTT products, content recommendation systems, or creator economy tools.
* Exposure to personalisation, ML-driven features, or recommendation algorithms is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with monetisation models AVOD, SVOD, in-app purchases, or creator revenue sharing.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an MBA from a premier institution is a plus.
* Experience working in a high-growth startup environment.

**Traits That Will Make You Exceptional**

* You are deeply curious about what users want and even more curious about why.
* You treat data as a compass, not a crutch; you know when to trust the numbers and when to trust your instincts.
* You are a strong communicator who can inspire a team around a vision and also get into the weeds with engineers when needed.
* You move fast without breaking things; you know how to ship iteratively and learn quickly.
* You are passionate about storytelling, content, and the future of entertainment in India.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to shape the product experience of a rapidly growing digital entertainment platform.
* A collaborative, creative, and fast-moving work environment with passionate colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, performance-linked bonuses, and ESOPs.
* Direct access to leadership and a culture that values product thinking at every level.
* Significant career growth opportunities as Story TV scales its audience and product portfolio.

**Position Overview**
Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology

* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions
* Experience defining and measuring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Technology organizations
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, User Experience, Operations, and Business teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Microsoft Power BI, Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Data Platforms, or similar Marketing Technology and GTM solutions
* Experience designing and launching AI-powered user experiences, AI agents, Copilot solutions, AI-powered Sales Development Representative capabilities, or Generative AI features for enterprise applications
* Experience developing or optimizing Machine Learning-based lead scoring, predictive lead qualification, or propensity models
* Experience with lead enrichment, identity resolution, data quality, and integration of external data providers into Lead Management workflows
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, experimentation, predictive analytics, and customer journey optimization

**The Ideal Candidate**
The ideal candidate is a strategic and technically accomplished Product Management professional who combines deep Marketing Technology expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership to modernize Lead Management capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes
  
  

* Demonstrates strong product leadership and a clear vision for modernizing and simplifying Lead Management through scalable, integrated technology solutions
* Applies deep knowledge of lead lifecycle management, marketing automation, and GTM systems to improve lead quality, qualification, and conversion
* Uses data, experimentation, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in business performance
* Leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to develop intelligent lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, prioritization, and routing capabilities
* Improves seller productivity by ensuring Sales teams receive qualified leads with relevant context at the appropriate time
* Drives AI-powered lead engagement and qualification to reduce manual effort, improve lead coverage, and accelerate response times
* Identifies and removes friction across the lead-to-pipeline journey to improve conversion rates and accelerate revenue opportunities

* Builds trusted partnerships across Attribution, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and GTM teams to deliver connected insights across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle
* Identifies opportunities to streamline operational processes through automation, AI-powered workflows, and scalable technology solutions
* Collaborates effectively across the GTM product portfolio to strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve organizational productivity
* Influences strategic direction and serves as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders

title: Lead,Tech Product Owner
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio is a global leader in eDiscovery, document review, legal talent, and consulting services, helping organizations navigate complex legal and business challenges.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) Technical Product Owner is accountable for defining, prioritizing, and delivering EDW capabilities that create measurable value for internal clients and business stakeholders. This role establishes product direction, maintains a clear and actionable backlog, and serves as the primary decision-maker for scope and priority throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
The Technical Product Owner partners closely with stakeholders, data engineers, developers, architects, project managers, and technical leads to translate strategic objectives and operational needs into product outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans. The role supports enterprise data solutions across relational databases, reporting platforms, ERP and CRM applications, middleware and iPaaS platforms, and proprietary systems. Success requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder leadership, disciplined prioritization, clear communication, and the ability to make informed trade-offs among value, risk, effort, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, goals, roadmap, and delivery priorities for assigned data warehouse, reporting, and integration capabilities.
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for product scope, backlog quality, prioritization, and acceptance decisions.
* Partner with sponsors, stakeholders, subject matter experts, and technical teams to define desired outcomes, success measures, and product requirements.
* Create, refine, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog, including epics, features, user stories, technical enablement work, defects, and operational improvements.
* Develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria that communicate business value, expected behavior, data requirements, and quality expectations.
* Balance stakeholder demand, strategic alignment, technical dependencies, risk, capacity, and delivery effort when making priority and sequencing decisions.
* Lead backlog refinement and actively participate in sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, release planning, and retrospectives.
* Provide timely product decisions and clarify scope, intent, and acceptance criteria so delivery teams can proceed without avoidable delays.
* Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams on solution options while maintaining accountability for product outcomes rather than prescribing implementation details.
* Coordinate dependencies across source systems, data integrations, enterprise data warehouse processes, semantic models, reports, and downstream consumers.
* Ensure data quality, security, privacy, governance, auditability, and supportability considerations are represented in product priorities and acceptance criteria.
* Engage stakeholders throughout delivery, communicate roadmap and release expectations, and manage changes to scope or priority transparently.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing by defining expected outcomes, identifying appropriate participants, reviewing results, and determining readiness for release.
* Accept or reject completed work based on agreed acceptance criteria and product quality expectations.
* Monitor production feedback, adoption, defects, support trends, and changing business needs to guide continuous product improvement.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Maintain product documentation and provide release communication, knowledge transfer, and training support as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role for data, or analytics products.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog and writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and release planning.
* Experience working with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent platforms, including a practical understanding of SQL and data structures.
* Experience collaborating with technical teams delivering data warehouse, reporting, or data pipeline solutions.
* Experience using Jira or an equivalent product planning and work management platform.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, decision-making, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand technical concepts, evaluate delivery trade-offs, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience defining product outcomes, acceptance measures, and release readiness.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse architecture, dimensional modeling, ETL or ELT patterns, data quality, metadata, and data governance.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI, Python-based data pipelines, or comparable data engineering and analytics technologies.
* Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, SnapLogic, or similar enterprise applications and integration platforms.
* Experience managing products that ingest data from multiple source systems and serve reporting, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle practices, test planning, production support, and release management.
* Project management experience or experience coordinating cross-team initiatives and dependencies.
* Experience in eDiscovery or legal technology is preferred but not required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 products, including Power BI, Excel, OneNote, and Teams.

**Core Competencies:**

* Product ownership and accountability
* Roadmap and backlog management
* Value-based prioritization and trade-off decisions
* Technical and data fluency
* Stakeholder alignment and expectation management
* Agile delivery leadership
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Risk, dependency, and release management
* Analytical problem-solving and continuous improvement

**Work Model**

* 3 days Work from Office
* 2 days Work from Home

**Shift Timing**

* 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM night shift

**Consilio’s True North Values**

* Client Experience | Listen for the “why ”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
* Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography , generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
* Innovation | Always be curious (ABC ). Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
* Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

**Engineering Product Owner**

**Purpose of this position / Position summary**

The Engineering Product Owner - Lifecycle owns requirement clarity, backlog readiness, and cross-functional execution for Refraction Product lifecycle management and sustaining-engineering topics in a regulated medical-device environment at Vision Care Solutions.

The role consolidates customer, service, quality, regulatory, product-management, UX, software, hardware, and systems-engineering inputs into traceable requirements, prioritized backlogs, and measurable lifecycle outcomes that improve product quality, usability, serviceability, and installed-base performance.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

**Lifecycle ownership and installation-base improvements**

• Own engineering coordination for lifecycle initiatives, installed-base enhancements, technical escalations, issue resolution, upgrades, and end-of-life actions.

• Translate field feedback, complaint trends, CAPA inputs, service data, customer needs, and product priorities into clear lifecycle scope, milestones, risks, and success criteria.

• Track closure effectiveness, customer impact, serviceability improvements, lessons learned, and benefit realization through agreed lifecycle metrics.

**Requirement engineering and backlog ownership**

• Lead end-to-end requirement engineering, including elicitation, analysis, refinement, validation, signoff, and audit-ready documentation.

• Convert high-level business, clinical, user, and technical needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and definition-of-ready expectations.

• Maintain feature-to-user-story-to-acceptance-criteria traceability and ensure alignment with product intent, risk controls, verification strategy, design-transfer impact, and QMS expectations.

• Own and prioritize the product/lifecycle backlog by balancing customer value, regulatory commitments, technical debt, security, usability, resource constraints, and delivery priorities.

**UX, software delivery and agile execution**

• Collaborate with UX/UI, software, systems, hardware, architecture, test, and service teams to ensure requirements translate into feasible, user-centric, secure, and scalable solutions.

• Create or review mockups, wireframes, screen flows, usability feedback, and workflow alignment before development where applicable.

• Provide inputs for Agile ceremonies, sprint/program planning, backlog refinement, dependency resolution, MVP definition, roadmap planning, and release readiness.

**Quality, regulatory, risk and compliance**

• Ensure lifecycle decisions are supported by documented rationale, traceable inputs, impact analysis, verification evidence, and appropriate quality records.

• Partner with quality and regulatory teams on investigations, CAPA actions, risk management, hazard analysis, defect management, validation needs, privacy/security considerations, and release constraints.

• Operate in line with applicable QMS/design-control expectations and relevant medical-device standards, including IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA/MDR expectations, and Software as a Medical Device consideration where applicable.

**Stakeholder leadership and decision support**

• Act as the central engineering interface between product management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, quality, regulatory, service, manufacturing, commercial, regional teams, suppliers, and external partners.

• Communicate priorities, progress, risks, trade-offs, decision needs, and customer impact through concise dashboards, reviews, metrics, and leadership updates.

• Use data-driven analysis to support prioritization, product maintenance decisions, troubleshooting, resource and budget planning, and continuous improvement.

**Innovation and emerging technologies**

• Stay current with technology and industry trends and work with technical teams to introduce practical innovations that improve product outcomes and future readiness.

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML-enabled product capabilities and AI tools for requirement analysis, documentation efficiency, product insights, and user experience improvement.

**Technical / domain skills**

• Strong requirement engineering, documentation, backlog management, stakeholder alignment, and product-definition skills.

• Broad exposure to software delivery, systems engineering, hardware/software interfaces, product lifecycle management, and regulated product-development practices.

• Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum/SAFe, sprint planning, backlog grooming, traceability, verification evidence, defect management, dashboards, and cross-functional delivery governance.

• Ability to work with architecture and development teams, translate complex requirements, clarify legacy-system gaps, and drive development-ready backlog quality.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills across global and cross-functional teams.

**Education, experience and job specifications**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline.

• Typically 10 to 12 years of experience in software/product engineering, technical product development, lifecycle engineering, sustaining engineering, or regulated technology execution.

• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Engineering Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, or equivalent requirement/product ownership role.

• Hands-on experience in software development, systems engineering, hardware/software product development, or Agile delivery environments is preferred.

• Experience in medical devices, digital health, optometry, ophthalmology, Vision Care, refraction/centration/diagnostic devices, clinical workflow solutions, or comparable regulated domains is preferred.

**Preferred qualifications / certifications**

• SAFe PO/PM, PMP, ScrumMaster, Business Analysis, System Engineering, Lean, DFSS, or DFR certifications are advantageous.

• Experience working with global teams, suppliers, OEM partners, contractors, external engineering providers, and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.

**Desired characteristics**

• Customer-focused engineering mindset with strong ownership of quality, usability, serviceability, security, compliance, and installed-base impact.

• Clear, concise communicator who can influence leadership, technical teams, and business stakeholders without direct authority.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and results-driven approach with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex technical dependencies.

• Collaborative leadership style with a continuous-improvement mindset and commitment to audit-ready execution.

**Role expectations**

This is an engineering ownership role accountable for lifecycle execution, requirement quality, backlog readiness, product-owner discipline, and cross-functional delivery clarity. Success requires technical judgment, QMS awareness, customer focus, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to drive decisions across global teams and regulated medical-device lifecycle programs.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
  
  
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
  
  
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
  
  
**The team**

* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.

Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**

* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.

**Core Consulting**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.

**Preferred:**

* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Product Analyst**

**Experience:**
1-2yrs

**Location:**
Bengaluru
**(Onsite only)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly communicative Product Analyst to join our Product team. This role goes well beyond dashboards and reporting—you will partner closely with Product Managers, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and customers themselves to help shape what we build and why.

You will combine data-driven thinking with deep product understanding, transforming customer problems, market insights, and competitive intelligence into well-defined product requirements. From discovery through release and adoption, you will play a key role in ensuring we deliver solutions that create measurable value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery & Research**

* Conduct deep research into customer workflows, industry trends, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.
* Perform competitor analysis to understand positioning, identify feature gaps, and recommend strategic improvements.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, internal stakeholders, and support teams into actionable product insights.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses and product recommendations.

**Product Requirements & Documentation**

* Draft high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Use AI-assisted research and documentation tools (including Claude Skills or similar workflows) to accelerate research, requirement gathering, and documentation while maintaining high quality and accuracy.
* Ensure product specifications are complete, testable, and clearly understood by engineering and design teams.
* Maintain documentation throughout the product lifecycle as requirements evolve.

**Product Validation & Quality**

* Participate in feature reviews, QA demonstrations, and pre-release validations to verify that delivered functionality aligns with product intent and customer expectations.
* Provide product sign-off or recommend changes before features are released.
* Collaborate with QA and Engineering to identify functional gaps, usability issues, and edge cases early in the development process.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in customer meetings, discovery sessions, implementation discussions, and feedback calls.
* Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support customer-facing teams by helping explain new functionality and gather structured feedback for future improvements.
* Deliver product demonstrations and contribute to customer training sessions when required.

**Product Analytics**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, engagement trends, and feature success measures.
* Analyze user behavior, funnels, retention, and usage patterns to inform product decisions.
* Build evidence-based recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data rather than intuition alone.
* Evaluate product experiments and recommend next steps based on measurable outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, or similar product documentation.
* Ability to conduct independent research and convert findings into practical product recommendations.
* Comfort working directly with customers and presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.
* Experience participating in feature validation or QA reviews with a product mindset.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints when making recommendations.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.

**Nice to Have**

While not required, we would especially value candidates who have worked on digital transformation initiatives within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or field operations organizations. Experience in these environments can provide useful context for understanding operational workflows and user needs, but we welcome applicants from all industries with strong product and analytical capabilities.

**Success in This Role**

**A successful Product Analyst will:**

* Produce clear, thoughtful, and implementation-ready PRDs.
* Surface meaningful insights through research and competitive analysis.
* Help ensure features meet both business goals and customer expectations before release.
* Confidently represent the Product team in customer conversations and training sessions.
* Act as a trusted partner to Product Management by combining analytical rigor with strong communication and sound product judgment.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Category Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East)
description:
**Alike.io**



is a passionate bunch of people, working hard to make it easy for everyone to travel like the people they like. We are the world’s first unified AI social travel platform: travel content creators share their travel stories from their personal travel studios, and Eia, our AI travel companion, turns that social content into trip ideas, then plans and books the entire holiday – from hotels, experiences, visas and commute to eSIMs – all in one place, supporting travellers before, during and after their trip with real human experts.

We are looking for enthusiastic folks with a get-it-done mindset to join us in this mission. For us, hard work is important, but even more important is keeping our promises, delivering on our commitments. Being a hero is good at Alike but being a team player is priceless. And finally, making the right choice usually means going the difficult path, and that is the Alike way.

**The role**

As a Growth Manager, Experiences (Middle East), you will own the customer-facing side of our Experiences business in the Middle East, with a key focus on UAE. You will be the revenue owner for the geography, responsible for the user journey, website conversion, pricing, promotions and propositions that turn demand into bookings. You will report to the Director, Experiences and work in close partnership with the Supply Manager, Middle East, who owns supplier sourcing and contracting, as well as with the marketing, digital commerce, product, operations and finance teams.

You will take a data led approach to test and improve the customer journey and propositions across channels and customer segments and will be the in-market expert on what travelers want to do and experience in the region.

.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the revenue and margin targets for Experiences in the Middle East, with a focus on UAE – plan, forecast and deliver against them.
* Develop and execute the category strategy and roadmap for the Middle East, aligned with the global Experiences strategy and informed by customer insights, market research and competitor analysis.
* Own the end-to-end user journey for Middle East experiences, from discovery and search through to booking and post-booking, identifying and removing friction at every step.
* Drive conversion rate optimisation (CRO) on the website – define and run A/B tests, and optimise listing pages, content and checkout in collaboration with the product, digital and design teams.
* Manage the end-to-end proposition lifecycle, from ideation and validation to launch and optimisation, ensuring that propositions across attractions, tours, activities and curated experiences are customer-focused, differentiated and profitable.
* Develop and implement pricing strategies, aware of the seasonality, events and festivals, booking window, demand fluctuations and competitor pricing.
* Plan and run promotions, offers and campaigns with the marketing team, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and margin.
* Partner with the Supply Manager, Middle East and cross-functional stakeholders, including marketing, digital commerce, product, operations, finance and customer support, translating customer demand and performance data into supply priorities and delivering propositions that meet customer expectations and business goals.
* Monitor and report on funnel and commercial performance using data and customer feedback and contribute to the global Experiences playbook by sharing learnings with the other geographies.

.

**Key requirements for the role**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
* A deep understanding of the UAE market dynamics and trends is a must.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering successful and innovative propositions that meet customer needs and drive revenue and margin growth.
* Use AI-powered dashboards, analytics and experimentation tools to monitor funnel and commercial performance in near real time, and to inform pricing, promotions and conversion decisions.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Creative and customer-oriented mindset, with a passion for travel and creating memorable experiences.
* Highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented, able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

 

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Private medical insurance
* Family friendly work environment, we understand what’s important in people’s lives
* A supportive and ambitious team to help you grow

title: Associate Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Associate Business Process Analyst will work closely with cross‑functional teams to shape and evolve a core product offering. Acting as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the IT development team, you will translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize enhancements, and ensure the product remains usable, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Elicit, document, and validate business requirements for product enhancements.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications for the development team.
* Collaborate with IT to design, develop, and test new product features.
* Analyze existing product performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, feasibility, and ROI.
* Facilitate communication between business users and technical teams.
* Conduct user acceptance testing and ensure solutions meet quality standards.
* Provide recommendations for process automation and efficiency gains.
* Monitor product metrics post‑release and suggest iterative refinements.
* Maintain up‑to‑date documentation and knowledge base for stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a data‑driven mindset.

title: Delivery Lead - RGM
description:
Delivery Lead – Revenue Growth Management (RGM) / Commercial Analytics
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Delivery Lead – RGM / Commercial Analytics will own end-to-end delivery of Revenue Growth Management programs for global CPG and Retail clients. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, advanced analytics, and execution excellence, with accountability for pricing, promotion, assortment, trade investment, and net revenue management use cases.

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location:**
Jayanagar, Bengaluru — in office
  
  
**Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
1-2 years
  
  
**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**App-Level Product Management**

* Own the Core Funnel: Optimize app-level surfaces end-to-end—onboarding, couple-pairing/invite flows, home tab navigation, and permission prompts (push notifications, mic, media).
* Drive Retention & Notification Loops: Architect the lifecycle messaging engine (push, in-app nudges) tailored around couples' bedtime usage (9 PM–midnight).
* Monitor App Health & Friction: Track app-level hygiene metrics (app cold-start time, crash-free sessions, ANRs, session length) and systematically eliminate UX friction points across Android and iOS devices.

**A/B Testing & Experimentation**

* Run a High-Velocity Experimentation Engine: Formulate crisp, hypothesis-driven test designs across onboarding variants, invite copy, game discovery feeds, and engagement triggers.
* Define Metrics & Guardrails: Establish clear primary success metrics (e.g., D1/D7 retention, couple-activation rate) alongside explicit guardrail metrics (e.g., unsubscribe rates, session abandonment) for every test.
* Own Telemetry & Instrument Events: Define and audit exact tracking schemas (clicks, impressions, state changes) in tools like PostHog, Mixpanel, etc. to ensure clean event telemetry before launching variants.
* Analyze & Iterate: Interpret experiment results using sound statistical principles (statistical significance, minimum detectable effect, sample size calculations), document post-test readouts, and scale winners while killing losers fast.

**Discovery & Execution**

* PRDs: Write concise, zero-fluff specs with explicit edge cases, state diagrams, and variant logic that engineers (and Claude) understand in one-shot.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Super Curiosity (The "Why" Driver)
* First-Principles Breakdown: You constantly dissect consumer apps—deconstructing why an onboarding flow converts, why a specific push copy gets opened, or why an experiment produced counter-intuitive data.
* Obsession with Human Behavior: You care deeply about relationship psychology and bedtime rituals, spending time understanding what motivates couples to return every night.
* Hunger for Data Nuance: You do not accept surface-level dashboard summaries; you segment cohorts (OS, network speed, partner presence) to uncover hidden patterns.
* High Agency (The "Make It Happen" Driver)
* Proof of Unprompted Building: You have designed, shipped, or operated something from scratch—a campus product, a micro-SaaS, or an automated tool.
* Zero Learned Helplessness: If tracking is broken, you read the documentation and debug the payload. If copy is missing, you write five variants. You never wait for someone to unblock you.
* Extreme Ownership
* Experimentation & Analytical Rigor
* Statistical Common Sense: Solid grasp of sample sizing, confidence intervals, p-values, and false positives. You understand why declaring an A/B test winner after 12 hours is misleading.
* Funnel Literacy: Deep familiarity with conversion mechanics, cohort retention curves, and leading vs. lagging indicators.
* Communication Clarity: Exceptional structured writing—capable of summarizing complex experiment results and trade-offs in three concise bullet points.
* Working knowledge of SQL

Bonus points (helpful, not required)
  
  

* Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms or feature flagging.
* Familiarity with modern AI prototyping stacks (Cursor, Lovable, v0) to demonstrate functional product flows.

Interview process
  
  

* Application Screen: Focused strictly on proof-of-work, clarity of thought, and personal projects.
* 15-Minute Intro Screen: Evaluates agency, pace, and core motivation.
* 60-Minute Live Product & Experimentation Jam
* 45-Minute Founder Chat: Deep dive into ambition, work ethic, self-direction, and cultural alignment.
* Reference Checks: Concrete verification of agency, grit, and speed of execution.

Calling anyone at Kulfi directly or contacting them on WhatsApp will result in immediate rejection of your application.

* **Work with R&D to improve models.**

title: Group Product Manager, Physical AI & Robotics
description:
**Who We Are**
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization
  
  
From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.
  
  
**Location & Flexibility**
**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.
  
  
We are hiring a
**Group Product Manager**
for the
**Physical AI Robotics product team**
. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.
  
  
Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems) or equivalent experience..
* Technical depth to hold a real conversation with a research team.
* Direct experience with one or more of: egocentric or wearable data capture, teleoperation systems, robot data pipelines, multi-sensor collection rigs or similar setups
* Experience defining product vision and roadmaps in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Hands-on robotics background. Robotics, ML engineer on embodied models, teleoperation engineer, or similar.
* Familiarity with imitation learning, VLA models, or manipulation policy training, and the data those methods need.
* Experience managing distributed human operations, including crowd or contractor workforces.
* You have shipped something physical and understand calibration, sensor sync, and coordinate frames, and how they fail.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
*At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.*
We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.
  
  
For more information on how we use your information, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Product Director, End User Computing & Identity
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Product Director, End User Computing & Identity**
is accountable for the strategy, product direction, governance, and end-to-end lifecycle of Haleon’s workforce identity, access, endpoint, and virtual workplace capabilities. The role brings these services together as one integrated product portfolio, ensuring colleagues and partners can securely access the right applications, data, devices, and digital workspaces from the right location and at the right time.
  
  
The portfolio includes Active Directory, authentication and access services, joiner-mover-leaver enablement, privileged and conditional access integration, endpoint and mobile device management, standard device builds, application access and delivery, workplace security controls, virtual desktop and remote access services, and governance of workplace accessory policies. The role owns the product and technology lifecycle across these capabilities, from strategy and investment through design, engineering, adoption, service performance, modernisation, and retirement.
  
  
As Product Director, the role leads a multidisciplinary team of product, engineering, and service specialists and directs strategic partners. It works across Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Applications, HR, and business teams to deliver a coherent colleague experience, strengthen identity-led security, simplify the technology estate, and improve reliability, cost, and user experience at global scale.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the global vision, strategy, target architecture, roadmap, and investment priorities for Workplace Identity & End User Computing.
* Own the integrated product portfolio covering workforce identity, authentication, access, endpoints, device builds, application delivery, virtual desktops, secure remote access, enterprise telephony and unified communications, document management and digital signature services, managed print services, and secure external file sharing and transfer capabilities.
* Provide end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Active Directory and cloud identity capabilities, ensuring resilient, scalable, and well-governed directory, authentication, federation, and access services.
* Partner with Cyber Security and application owners to embed identity-first and Zero Trust principles, including strong authentication, conditional access, least privilege, access recertification, and effective control of privileged access.
* Ensure identity and access services support efficient joiner, mover, and leaver journeys, role-based access, external-user access, and reliable integration with HR, SaaS, cloud, and enterprise applications.
* Own the endpoint and mobile product strategy and lifecycle across laptops, desktops, smartphones, tablets, shared devices, and specialist workplace endpoints, including procurement standards, enrolment, configuration, compliance, refresh, support, secure disposal, and oversight of workplace accessory policies and standards.
* Set the direction for modern endpoint management, standard device builds, operating system currency, patching, configuration, application packaging and deployment, endpoint security, and user experience.
* Own virtual desktop, application virtualisation, and remote access products, ensuring they provide secure, performant, and cost-effective access for employees, partners, specialist users, and regulated use cases.
* Create a seamless access experience across physical and virtual endpoints so that identity, device trust, application entitlement, and security policy operate as one coherent control framework.
* Maintain prioritised product roadmaps and backlogs, balancing colleague needs, security risk, regulatory obligations, resilience, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, cost, and strategic value.
* Define and track product outcomes and service measures covering user experience, adoption, access success, device compliance, service availability, security posture, lifecycle health, cost, and business value.
* Lead major modernisation, simplification, migration, and decommissioning initiatives across identity, endpoint, and virtual workplace technologies, with effective service transition and change adoption.
* Provide senior ownership of service health, major incidents, problem management, continuity, capacity, obsolescence, audit actions, and material risks across the portfolio.
* Manage strategic technology providers and delivery partners, setting clear outcomes and ensuring strong commercial control, licensing optimisation, performance, innovation, and accountability.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team, establishing clear accountability, succession plans, capability development, and an inclusive product-led culture.

**About You**
**Essential Skills**

* Significant senior leadership experience across enterprise workplace technology, identity and access, or end user computing within a large, complex, global organisation.
* Strong product and lifecycle management capability, with experience defining strategy, target state, roadmaps, investment cases, product outcomes, and service improvement priorities.
* Deep understanding of enterprise identity services, including Active Directory, cloud identity, authentication, federation, conditional access, role-based access, privileged access, and identity governance integration.
* Strong understanding of modern endpoint management, device build and provisioning, operating system and application lifecycle, patching, configuration, compliance, and endpoint security.
* Experience leading virtual desktop, application delivery, and secure remote access capabilities in a global enterprise environment.
* Proven ability to bring identity, device trust, application entitlement, and access controls together into a coherent user experience and security model.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary internal teams and strategic partners, with accountability for people development, service performance, delivery quality, and organisational capability.
* Strong commercial, financial, and supplier-management capability, including investment prioritisation, contract performance, licensing, demand, capacity, and cost optimisation.
* Excellent senior stakeholder leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence technology, cyber, HR, risk, and business leaders and make clear decisions across competing priorities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and the wider Microsoft security and management ecosystem.
* Experience with enterprise virtual desktop and application delivery technologies such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or VMware platforms.
* Practical knowledge of Zero Trust, passwordless authentication, identity governance, privileged access management, endpoint detection and response, and security compliance frameworks.
* Experience simplifying global technology estates, modernising legacy identity or endpoint services, and delivering complex migrations with minimal business disruption.
* Relevant Microsoft, identity, cyber security, product management, architecture, or service management qualifications, with experience in regulated or high-risk environments.

Location – this role is based in: Bangalore, India
  
  
Please save a copy of the job description, as this may be helpful to refer to once the advert closes.
  
  
**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-29
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
