title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Executive Director, Product Management, SBU Connectivity
description:
**About The Role**
The SBU Connectivity Product Management Lead is the portfolio-level owner for product management, product evolution, go-to-market orchestration, and lifecycle value realization across SBU Connectivity. The role consolidates the former product-specific Business Lead responsibilities into one Product Management organization while maintaining distinct product lines for telematics and connectivity offerings and clear interfaces with the Global Business Lead for overall commercial/business ownership.
  
  
You will translate market, customer, technology, and RFQ signals into a coherent portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, differentiated product propositions, and executable business cases. Drive a product-first operating model that increases reuse, reduces bespoke development, improves R&D return, and strengthens global market adoption through close partnership with NPI, Systems/Solution Architecture, Product Engineering, Global RFQ/Early Engagement, Global Delivery, Finance, Sales, and the Global Business Lead.
  
  
You will lead a globally distributed team of product managers and regional GTM product managers and influences a broad matrix spanning engineering, architecture, delivery, finance, sales, marketing, and customer teams. Success requires enterprise-level judgment across multiple product lines, regions, customers, investment horizons, and technology generations.
  
  
Manage the global Product Management organization spanning telematics/connectivity product lines and regional GTM product management in the Americas, Europe, Japan, India/APAC and other priority markets. You
  
  
will build a strong product management discipline with common methods for roadmaps, business cases, product requirements, lifecycle governance, GTM readiness and portfolio decision making.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own Portfolio Product Management: Drive product evolution, 3–5-year roadmaps and lifecycle decisions across Connectivity, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and profitability.
* Lead GTM & Regional Product Management: Convert market and Voice-of-Customer signals into product priorities, positioning, value propositions, sales enablement and launch readiness.
* Partner for Growth: Work with Global Business Lead, Sales and RFQ/Early Engagement to shape opportunities around scalable products and derivatives rather than bespoke solutions.
* Own Product Business Cases & Value Realization: Establish product investment logic across market potential, pricing, revenue, margin, R&D, lifecycle cost, reuse and ROI in partnership with Finance.
* Manage Product Performance: Track adoption, pipeline fit, reuse, financial contribution, roadmap execution and customer feedback, taking corrective action when expected value is not realized.
* Connect NPI to Product Ownership: Partner with NPI to mature new concepts and technology opportunities into validated product propositions with disciplined transition into portfolio ownership.
* Drive Cross-Functional Product Realization: Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Global Delivery to translate market needs into scalable platforms, executable roadmaps and reusable production-ready releases.
* Establish Product Management Excellence: Standardize MRD/PRD, roadmap, business case, launch, lifecycle and decision frameworks while resolving cross-product priorities at portfolio level.
* Build Global Product Leadership: Develop a high-performing global Product Management and GTM organization with strong accountability, a customer-centric, data-driven, product-first culture.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.

* 10+ years leading senior, globally distributed teams and complex matrix organizations across multiple regions, customers and product lines.

* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance revenue, margin, R&D investment, product reuse, time-to-market and long-term portfolio value.
* Broad understanding of automotive connectivity and telematics technologies including cellular/5G, V2X, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS, cloud/edge services, cybersecurity, OTA and automotive-grade hardware/software platforms.

* Executive communication and influencing skills with credibility across customers, senior leadership, engineering, sales, finance, partners and globally distributed teams.
* Ability to make high-quality decisions under ambiguity and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* MBA or advanced degree paired with a technical undergraduate degree.
* Experience leading telematics/connectivity portfolios spanning mobility segments.
* Experience with ecosystem partnerships, new business models, software/services monetization and global OEM commercialization.

**What Makes You Eligible**

title: Director - AI Delivery Product
description:

With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a commercially astute and technically visionary Director to own and scale Firstsource's AI & Cloud product portfolio across multiple product lines. You will set product strategy, engineering standards, and investment priorities across the portfolio, while mentoring a team of Associate Directors and engineering leaders. With 18+ years of experience, you bring deep Python and Generative AI expertise, enterprise cloud architecture mastery, and the executive presence to shape AI product strategy at the CXO level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Strategy & Architecture**

* Define multi-year product strategy and investment roadmap across the AI product portfolio.
* Set enterprise architecture standards and reference patterns embedding Generative AI and agentic workflows across all product lines.
* Approve major architecture decisions and technology bets across product engineering teams.

description:
**Job Description:**

You will provide strong operational and program leadership while working closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

* Lead the identification and definition of complex business challenges, whether they arise from delivery challenges (resource bottlenecks, technical obstacles) or customer-side issues (usability, satisfaction). Break down these challenges into smaller, manageable components and align teams toward clear goals and outcomes.

* Articulate complex business problems, product strategies, and program progress to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner. Provide regular updates on program status, roadblocks, and solutions.

* 10 - 14 years of overall work experience, with 7+ years of experience in Program and Project Management.

* Strong understanding of SQL for querying databases and analyzing data.
* Familiarity with the technical aspects of data product development, including architecture and cloud infrastructure, to effectively communicate with development teams.
* Experience in building data processing applications using Hadoop, Spark, and NoSQL databases.
* Experience in building scalable enterprise data warehousing and modelling on-prem and/or on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience in managing and executing large programs; ability to act as an Agile coach to teams and customers.
* Experience in managing multiple teams and scaling them.
* Ability to identify and analyze complex business challenges (technical, operational, or client-related) and break them into smaller, manageable problems, support proposal creation and pre-sales activities.
* Experience in creating and maintaining data and product roadmaps, adjusting them based on changing priorities, feedback, and unforeseen challenges (risk and change management, risk mitigation).
* Ability to build strong relationships with multiple stakeholders, including developers, designers, marketing, sales, and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Operational leadership experience in overseeing the execution of operational processes and improving workflows for maximum efficiency.

**Business & Client Leadership:**

* Develop a strong understanding of client business processes, domain priorities, and strategic objectives to ensure engineering initiatives are aligned with measurable business outcomes.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions and delivery roadmaps.

**Account Growth & Stakeholder Management:**

* Build and nurture relationships with key client stakeholders, proactively identifying opportunities for account expansion, renewals, and cross-functional engagement.

* Experience coordinating hardware development activities across engineering disciplines, external suppliers, and manufacturing teams.
* Working knowledge of EMI/EMC, safety, and environmental regulatory compliance requirements for telecommunications systems.
* Strong documentation, analytical, risk management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical and program-level information effectively.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
  
  
Req ID: 63818
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
Posting Start Date: 21/10/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 28/10/2026
  
  
Division: BT International
  
  
Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld
  
  
Advertised Salary: Competitive
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Own Service Management Engineering: Lead the end-to-end engineering, integration, and evolution of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms for BTI, driving business process improvement, end-to-end process optimisation, and service workflow simplification to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity & improve operational effectiveness.
* Drive Service Delivery and Assurance: Engineer integrated service capabilities that improve end-to-end service visibility, fulfilment, monitoring, incident management, problem resolution, and service restoration, delivering a more seamless and reliable customer experience.
* Deliver Customer and Service Migrations: Own technical solution design and engineering delivery for customer and service migrations, ensuring migration readiness, data and integration integrity, operational acceptance, and minimal customer disruption.
* Embed SAFe and Agile Engineering Delivery: Partner with Service, Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams across Agile Release Trains to translate business priorities into service enablers, solution increments, and release plans. Drive alignment across teams, manage dependencies, and accelerate value realisation through iterative delivery.
* Accelerate AI-led Service Transformation: Drive the adoption and industrialisation of AI, intelligent automation, and predictive service capabilities through OpsFabric. Enable proactive fault detection, intelligent incident triage, faster diagnosis and resolution, reduced manual effort, and improved customer and operational experiences.
* Drive Service Landscape Simplification: Lead engineering initiatives leveraging BTI AI solutions to simplify and modernise the Customer Experience (CX) and Service IT landscape, rationalising platforms, reducing duplication and technical debt, streamlining processes, improving agility & cost efficiency.
* Ensure Engineering Excellence and Platform Resilience: Establish and enforce engineering standards across architecture, APIs, integrations, security, observability, testing, release management, and operational readiness. Drive improvements in availability, scalability, performance, recoverability, and technical quality.
* Own In-life Engineering Governance: Provide clear accountability for the technical management and communication of production incidents, problems, and production releases (PRs). Coordinate stakeholders, manage risks and escalations, drive root-cause resolution, and ensure timely, transparent communications and effective service restoration.
* Strengthen Cross-functional Leadership: Build strong partnerships across BTI, BT UK, Service Operations, Product, Architecture, Cyber Security, and delivery partners to align priorities, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain accountability for outcomes.
* Drive Continuous Improvement and Operational Automation: Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive activities, optimise service processes, improve engineering productivity, and shift from reactive support towards proactive, data-driven service management
* Measure and Deliver Business Outcomes: Define and track engineering and service KPIs, including customer experience, service availability, incident resolution, migration success, release quality, automation adoption, platform performance, and cost-to-serve. Use insights to prioritise investments and demonstrate measurable business value.
* TSA/RTSA Engineering Dependencies: Manage technical dependencies on BT UK-owned service tools under TSA and enable BT UK journeys through BTI-owned platforms under RTSA, ensuring continuity, clear ownership, effective risk management, and delivery against transition commitments for Service Ops.

**Skills Required**
This role requires a doer who can think strategically, engineer pragmatically, collaborate across boundaries, and deliver relentlessly - connecting technology, process, people, and AI to create a simpler, smarter, and more reliable service experience for Telco B2B customers.
  
  

* Technically credible: Understands the technology deeply enough to challenge designs, guide engineering decisions, and help solve complex problems hands-on.
* Business outcome focused: Understands that technology is an enabler and consistently looks for ways to improve customer experience, simplify processes, and deliver measurable value.
* Execution oriented: Uses SAFe and Agile practices pragmatically to align teams, manage dependencies, overcome blockers, and get solutions into production.
* Change agent: Is curious, proactive, resilient, and willing to challenge the status quo—turning emerging technology, particularly AI, into practical improvements in how services are delivered and assured.

**The skills you’ll need to succeed:**

* Technology & Engineering Expertise: Strong knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms, modern architecture, APIs, cloud, integration, DevSecOps, and platform reliability, with the ability to translate business needs into robust, scalable engineering solutions.
* AI, Innovation & Process Transformation: Understanding of AI, GenAI, AIOps, intelligent automation, and predictive analytics, with the ability to apply emerging technologies to simplify business processes, optimise service workflows, and improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Execution Excellence & SAFe Delivery: Practical experience with SAFe and Agile delivery, translating strategy into executable roadmaps and backlogs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, and driving solutions from design through production.
* Hands-on Engineering & Problem Solving: A proactive, go-getter mindset with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; willing to get into technical detail, challenge the status quo, remove blockers, and take end-to-end ownership of outcomes.
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Leadership: Ability to work across Product, Service, Architecture, Engineering, BTI, and BT UK teams, influence without authority, manage complex dependencies, and communicate technical issues and decisions clearly.
* Service Reliability, Governance & Continuous Improvement: Strong understanding of service assurance, incident and problem management, production releases, operational resilience, security, and risk management, with a focus on improving service quality and reducing recurring issues.
* Business Outcomes & Delivery Accountability: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in customer experience, service availability, migration success, automation, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term technology strategy.
* The defining ethos: Think like a product owner, engineer like a technologist, deliver like an Agile team, and measure success through customer and business outcomes. Treat Service Management platforms not simply as tools to maintain, but as products to continuously evolve - using engineering, data, and AI to make services smarter, simpler, and more customer-centric

**Experience Required**
A track record of combining hands-on engineering credibility, product ownership, and operational accountability - using SAFe to mobilise teams and AI to improve service outcomes, while maintaining consistently strong service levels.
  
  

* Service Management Technology & Architecture
* AI, GenAI & Intelligent Automation
* Business Process Optimisation & CX Improvement
* SAFe, Agile Delivery & Backlog Prioritisation
* Hands-on Engineering & Technical Problem Solving
* Service Level Management & Operational Resilience
* End-to-End Solution Integration & Migration
* DevSecOps, CI/CD & Engineering Excellence
* Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Leadership
* Outcome Ownership & Data-driven Decision-making
* Continuous Improvement & Technology Simplification
* Proactive Leadership, Accountability & Execution
* Product Engineering & Platform Ownership

**Leadership Accountabilities**
**Leading inclusively and safely**

* Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture where Product, Service, and Engineering teams are empowered to contribute, challenge ideas, and deliver their best work.
* Embed security, resilience, quality, and operational risk management into engineering decisions, ensuring innovation does not compromise service levels or customer trust.

**Owning outcomes**

* Take end-to-end accountability for Service Management product roadmaps, engineering delivery, platform performance, and service levels.
* Translate customer and business priorities into measurable outcomes, balancing continuous innovation with service stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations across BTI, BT UK, and partner teams, ensuring commitments are delivered and issues resolved.

**Growth mindset**

* Champion continuous learning, experimentation, and adoption of emerging technologies, particularly AI and intelligent automation, to improve customer experience and service performance.
* Encourage teams to challenge the status quo, learn from failures, simplify processes, and continuously improve engineering practices and service outcomes.

**Customer first**

* Champion customer needs throughout the product engineering lifecycle, using customer feedback, service insights, and operational data to identify opportunities to improve CX.
* Drive seamless, proactive, and differentiated service experiences, ensuring engineering priorities deliver tangible improvements in service quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction.

**Collaborating for impact**

* Bring Product, Service, Architecture, and Engineering teams together through SAFe to align priorities, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of shared outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across BTI and BT UK, fostering transparency, constructive challenge, and collective accountability for service performance and transformation.

**Driving innovation and simplification**

* Lead the evolution towards a product-led Service Management engineering organisation, with clear platform ownership, roadmaps, reusable capabilities, and continuous delivery.
* Drive AI-led transformation, automation, and service landscape simplification to reduce complexity, improve productivity, and make service experience a competitive differentiator.

**Delivering Through Others**

* Set clear direction, empower teams to make decisions, and establish accountability for engineering quality, delivery commitments, and service outcomes.
* Combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, removing blockers and enabling teams to deliver reliable services and sustained business value.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Associate Product Manager

**Location**
: Bangalore

**Role Type**
: Full-time

This role is for someone who wants to get their hands dirty, move fast, and solve real problems in a space that matters.
**It will be a grind.**
If you're looking for a large team with clearly defined swim lanes, this isn't it. If you want to own things end-to-end from day one, read on.

What you'll be doing

You'll work across two of our core products:
**Lumen**
(our energy management platform) and
**Contracts**
(how we structure, price, and operationalise renewable energy agreements for C&I businesses).

1. **Lumen:**
   Work with engineering and design to ship features — bill digitisation, multi-site dashboards, contract monitoring, Scope 2 reporting. Understand what our customers need, write clear specs, and follow through to delivery.
2. **Contracts:**
   Help translate complex energy contract logic into usable product flows. Think through how a CFO or facility manager experiences a contract — from onboarding to monthly settlement — and make it smoother.
3. **Customer Feedback Loops:**
   Talk to customers. Sit in on calls. Synthesise what you hear into things the team can act on.
4. **Data & Analytics:**
   Dig into usage data, identify patterns, and flag things that matter. We have a large and growing dataset of electricity bills and metering data — there's a lot to find.
5. **Cross-functional Work:**
   Work closely with our energy, sales, and engineering teams. At this stage, product sits at the centre of almost everything.

What we're looking for

Qualifications

* Recently completed a bachelors programme at a Tier I institution (IITs, IIMs, BITS, NIT-K).
* At least one prior product internship — we want to see that you've written a PRD, talked to users, or shipped something, even if small.
* Strong written communication. You'll be writing specs, summarising customer calls, and flagging issues clearly.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. Early-stage means the brief changes. You need to be okay with that.
* Genuine curiosity about energy. You don't need to know what a DISCOM is on day one — but you should find it interesting when you find out.

The kind of person we want

We want someone who thinks energy is a genuinely interesting problem, who reads things they don't have to read, and who'll push back when something doesn't make sense.

Early-stage startups are hard. The upside is that you'll do more in six months here than you might in two years elsewhere.

Serving small through enterprise manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, industrial equipment, and engineered products, Discrete Manufacturing focuses on modern execution-connecting planning, production, traceability, and automation to help manufacturers run more resilient, efficient, and predictable operations.

**CAI India**

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.

**About the Role**

The Product Owner will operate within our AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) model, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, and AI coding agents (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI-based tools) to translate manufacturing and customer needs into precise specs and intents that AI agents can implement directly. Rather than authoring only traditional user stories, this role owns Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for the team — writing unambiguous specifications, reviewing AI-generated plans and code before execution proceeds, and making the human judgment calls that AI-DLC defers to people. This is a hands-on execution role focused on driving agentic delivery of MES capabilities that improve shop-floor efficiency, visibility, and control, while maintaining human oversight and accountability at every stage of the AI-DLC cycle.

Location

* Bangalore, India – Hybrid In Office

Responsibilities

* Own the MES product backlog as a set of AI-DLC intents and units of work, ensuring each is scoped precisely enough for agentic execution within a delivery cycle (bolt).
* Translate high-level MES product strategy into precise specs, acceptance criteria, and workflows detailed enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Work closely with Engineering, QA, and UX — often in mob-programming/pod sessions with AI agents — to refine specs, clarify requirements, and remove ambiguity before and during delivery cycles.
* Review and validate AI-generated plans, user stories, and implementation proposals before execution proceeds, acting as the human decision-maker in the AI-DLC oversight loop.
* Make day-to-day scope, priority, and risk-acceptance decisions for the team, deferring to Engineering only the technical calls AI-DLC reserves for specialists.
* Define acceptance criteria and evaluation checks ("evals") that AI agents and QA use to verify completed work against business intent, and provide timely feedback and sign-off.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (Product Management, Implementation, Support, Customer Success) to translate plant and user feedback into new specs and backlog priorities.
* Monitor MES usage, defects, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to identify improvements and incremental value opportunities, feeding learnings back into specs.
* Maintain transparency on team progress, AI-generated changes, risks, and dependencies through clear communication and reporting.
* Ability to build Product markdown files to provide AI agents contextual background to the MES product.

Required Qualifications

* 4–7 years of experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role on software development teams.
* Hands-on experience with LLM tools such as Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI, used in a professional product or development context.
* Working knowledge of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — able to write specs precise enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Strong experience writing user stories/Intents, defining acceptance criteria, and managing backlogs in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of software methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) and how to adapt them to agentic, AI-DLC-based delivery.
* Ability to understand technical concepts relevant to MES (APIs, integrations with ERP/PLM/SCADA, data models) and communicate effectively with both engineers and AI agents.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) methodology is a plus.
* AI & Technical Fluency — comfortable evaluating AI-generated code, plans, and test coverage well enough to approve or redirect them.
* Experience with AI-DLC & agentic delivery — working in mob-programming/pod formats with cross-functional teams and AI coding agents.
* Data-driven product management — using shopfloor KPIs, usage analytics, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to shape backlog priorities.

Candidate Profile

* Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning the “what” and “why” for the MES team while directing AI agents on the “how” — knowing when to step in personally.
* Thrives in a collaborative, fast-moving environment; curious and adaptable to a methodology where tooling and process evolve quickly. Works effectively across time zones and functions (engineering, implementation, product, and customer-facing teams), including alongside AI agents as delivery partners.

**Why Join CAI**

You will build software that runs real factories — the systems that tell operators what to make, capture what happened on the shop floor, and keep supply chains moving. You will be paired with experienced engineers, given ownership of well-scoped features from your first sprint, and exposed to the full product lifecycle: requirements, design, code, test, release and customer feedback. You will learn both modern engineering practices and the manufacturing domain in depth, building a career foundation that is in high demand across the industry.

At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6,200+ customers across 15+ industries and active investment in AI-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like — and we are building the team to lead that work.

Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers — and how we work:

* Built to Fit - Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
* Built to Expedite - Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays.
* Built to Deliver - AI turns action and insights into measurable performance.
* Built to Scale - Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

CAI Software is an "EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer."

**Benefits & Remuneration**

is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

title: Sr. Director Product Management
description:
Voyager (94001), India, Bangalore, Karnātaka
  
  
Sr. Director Product Management
  
  
At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart, a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts.
  
  
Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.
  
  
****Team Description:****
**Capital One Software**
is a new line of business within Capital One that provides software to allow regulated Enterprises to unleash data to safely empower innovation. Capital One Software launched Slingshot, an AI assisted Data warehouse optimization product and Databolt, a data management and protection platform with many more innovations still in progress. Customers want to enable safe use of proprietary data to allow agents and AI models to build differentiated business offerings. Capital One Software is a catalyst for this change and Capital One India is fueling the innovation and next generation of products and services for Capital One Software. Our bold entrepreneurial initiative to build the Data Management and protection platform for an AI first world where data, specifically proprietary and sensitive data, becomes the key enabler for an Enterprise business.
  
  
****About the Role:****
Capital One Software in India is looking for senior product leadership to spearhead our foray into the next generation of Capital One Software in an AI native world. This role involves working backwards from customers, working with product leaders to define the precise problem we are solving, and leading Engineering teams to build impactful products that delight customers. The role encompasses recruiting, developing, and motivating an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad, and focused on our mission to develop world class data products.
  
  
****In this role, you will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in four key areas:****
****Human Centered****

* You’ll deeply immerse yourself in knowing your internal and/or external customer(s) needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions.
* You’ll be challenged to discover customer needs and inspire innovative solutions or products in light of industry trends, emerging technologies and business and customer insights.

****Business Focused****

* You’ll be the leader to develop a compelling portfolio or product vision for our organization to deliver capabilities that empower differentiated customer experiences and deliver breakthrough business value.
* You’ll lead a team that translates vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while managing cyber, operational and/or regulatory risks.

****Technology Driven****

* You’ll partner with Technology leaders to influence end state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant and scalable technology solutions that solve material customer and business problems.
* You’ll be responsible for making technology investments decisions by assessing opportunities for reusing Enterprise solutions or for and building new ones with extensibility & enterprise scalability in mind.

****Transformational Leadership****

* You’ll influence a broad set of senior executives across the enterprise and your organization who are stakeholders or delivery partners to successfully deliver on your portfolio/product vision.
* You’ll establish a long term product portfolio strategy, informed by customer and business needs, to gain alignment, secure resources and overcome impediments.
* You’ll attract, grow, empower, and inspire top product talent as they develop and deliver on their local product strategy.

****The Ideal Candidate:****
****Intellectually Curious:****
You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic product vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
  
  
****A Strong Communicator & Influencer:****
You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your product vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.
  
  
****A Do-er with Action Oriented:****
You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering valuable in an iterative way focusing on minimum viable product.
  
  
****Passionate & Customer Focused:****
You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs and build long lasting relationships.
  
  
****Growth Mindset:****
You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies; you will seek for internal solutions before building new ones.
  
  
****A Team Player:****
You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor in product development.
  
  
****Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:****

* Develop and communicate the product vision and strategy for your area of responsibility.
* Partner with business and technology leadership to align on prioritization of key problems to be solved to maximize business and customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with teams in India and USA to drive alignment with different teams working on the platform.
* Incorporate design thinking and analytics to inform product design.
* Responsible for a team of directly reporting product managers.
* Maintain a healthy backlog of work and play a critical role in many agile ceremonies.
* Support the team with escalation and resolution of impediments.
* Serve as the connection between customers, Capital One’s mission, and your team.

****Basic Qualifications:****

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or Computer Science
* At least 16 years of experience, with a focus on product management across software engineering or machine learning products
* At least 8 years of experience in digital product management
* At least 5 years of experience in people management
* At least 5 years of experience leading multiple teams within an agile environment
* At least 3 years of experience managing other managers including talent development, performance management, team building and succession planning

****Preferred Qualifications:****

The ideal candidate must possess significant industry recognition, executive-level gravitas, and a mature professional network across utilities, renewable developers, EPCs, system integrators, grid operators, and regulatory bodies.

The primary goal of this role is to accelerate market adoption and solidify our market share in emerging energy transition spaces, including
**Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), Virtual Power Plants (VPP), and grid-scale BESS solutions**
. The scope directly aligns with modern utility-grid integration requirements around microgrids, BESS controls, grid balancing, ancillary services, and advanced energy management platforms.

  Work as a seamless technical conduit between product management, core engineering, and field-commissioning teams.

**Required Experience & Competencies**

**Minimum Qualifications & Experience**

  within electric utilities, utility-scale renewable energy companies, grid operators (ISO/RTO organizations), energy technology providers, or tier-1 energy consulting firms.

  Nationally or globally recognized subject matter expert in Energy Management Systems (EMS), Grid Controls, BESS, Renewable Integration frameworks, or complex Microgrid Systems.

title: Principal Product Manager, Retail Business Services, RBS: Cost To Serve
description:
**Description**
Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) is a Senior Leadership Team mission to remove unnecessary cost in Amazon's retail business, anchored to a shared S-Team goal of $5B Cost Out Impact (COI) in 2026, scaling to a proposed $10B in 2027. UDE requires a myriad of mechanisms and we're in search of a Principal Product Manager to lead the development of the software platform portfolio from within the Retail Business Services team to manage all defects.
  
  
Retail Business Services (RBS) is the force multiplier team for Amazon's Retail business growth worldwide through three core strategic initiatives: (1) Defect Elimination, identifying cross-all-retail defects at their root cause and driving extirpation to increase margins; (2) Selection, creating and enriching Amazon inventory data increasing gross merchandise sales growth; and, (3) Operational Excellence, to ensure Amazon's retail business is running efficiently and effectively.
  
  
RBS evolving a horizontal internal platform complete with a front-end interface to oversee our UDE program; and, we need an experienced Principal Product Manager to own product vision and lead a small, growing team of product managers as a player-coach across our tracking, reporting, identification, and extrapolation products. This role has significantly evolved in last couple of years, with additional products and capabilities expected to be either ramped up or developed.
  
  
As the Principal Product Manager, you would own the development life cycle of our UDE platform portfolio spanning defect tracking, reporting. Own the tool which uses AI for defect identification, and extrapolation to enrich defects with root cause, upstream system, and system owner built with an AI-first development philosophy. Moreover, the leader will lead efforts on simplifying underlying data architectures (with help of dedicated BIE team and central Data Engineering team) for ease of usage of these products, while leading the impact assessment capabilities. Our success is built on a one-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging.

**About Albertsons Companies India:**

At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company’s technology journey to support millions of customers’ lives every day.

At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology & Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165-year-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well-being.

**Senior Technical Program Manager – AI**

**Position Summary:**

The Technical Program Manager should have a background leading and managing complex enterprise technical programs with cross-functional technical and business teams. The role interfaces with executive leadership and key business partners, identifies and mitigates risks, and ensures regulatory compliance. Candidates must have personally led enterprise AI-first transformation / AI enablement and adoption with proven, evidenced results, from prioritization and experimentation through production, scaling, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **End-to-end AI delivery:**
  Lead AI initiatives from use-case prioritization and experimentation through production deployment, scaling, ways of working, continuous improvement, change management including and not limited to driving AI Upskilling efforts etc.
* **Program leadership & delivery:**
  Lead and manage multiple complex programs with urgency; develop plans, track progress, set clear accountability and timelines, and lead ad hoc special projects for the leadership team. Apply Agile and other fit-for-purpose delivery approaches as appropriate.
* **Measurable outcomes**
  : Define and track outcomes such as adoption, productivity or cycle-time improvement, quality, risk reduction, and realized business value; use evidence to communicate impact.
* **Executive & enterprise stakeholder engagement: T09**
  – interface with executive-level management for support, status, and issues; T10 – serve as a core spokesperson, highly influential with senior and executive leaders & cross-functional teams. Both levels develop recommendations and presentations for SLT leadership.
* **Strategy and change**
  : T09 – anticipate challenges, recommend new processes, standards, or operational plans, and contribute to functional strategy. T10 – Proactively identify and solve the most complex problems impacting business management and direction, with broad latitude to apply judgment and discretion.
* **Influence and conflict resolution:**
  Provide thought leadership to SLT leadership; align stakeholders without direct authority; resolve cross-team conflicts on priorities, dependencies, and resources; influence senior and executive leaders on short- and long-term issues.
* **Planning and financial ownership:**
  Own program planning, budget, resource and financial planning, tracking, reporting, and risk assessment.
* **Responsible AI and operational readiness:**
  Partner with relevant teams to address responsible AI, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, model evaluation, and production monitoring.
* **Best practices and people:**
  T09 – adopt existing Program Management best practices. T10 – identify and develop them, facilitate continuous improvement and cross-organization events. Both levels mentor, develop, and train TPMs and comply with regulatory directives.

**Qualifications – Must Have:**

* PMO - Strong experience working with or within a PMO
* Significant global offshore/onshore experience; Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Excel, or other PM tools , using AI tools for effective & efficient Program Management; lead ambiguous, complex situations to measurable plans; facilitate continuous improvement and cross-organization events; collaborate in a matrix/virtual environment; experience with external vendors management
* Strong Documentation and knowledge management best practices
* AI First (required, both levels) Personally led enterprise AI-first transformation / AI enablement and adoption in a current or previous company, with evidenced results
* AI delivery and approaches - End-to-end AI delivery from use-case prioritization and experimentation through production deployment, scaling, and continuous improvement; experience with Agile and other suitable delivery approaches
* Also required at both levels Enterprise transformation experience; influence without authority; cross-team conflict resolution; demonstrated strategic influence at SLT / executive level. Contribution, planning, or support roles alone do not meet the AI First requirement. Well-organized, detail-oriented, strong communicator, thrives in a fast-paced environment.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree, specialized training, or relevant professional qualification.

Competencies: Program management (planning, budget, resource and financial planning, risk); communication and cross-functional leadership; mentoring TPMs; compassionate, inclusive, learning-focused, strategic thinking, customer focus, and consistent delivery of results with tangible metrics. Learning-focused, finding ways to improve in their field and using positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally.

**Preferred:**
Hands-on use of AI tools for program management is a plus.

title: Senior Business Solutions Engineer, BizTech(LegalTech)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
L9 - Senior Business Solutions Engineer, Legal Tech
  
  
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI-powered tools, implementation of legal systems & integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
We're looking for a world-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end-to-end, from design through support.
  
  
You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.
  
  
This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.
  
  
If you're energized by fast-paced problem-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Embedded Deployment & Enablement
  
  

* Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in-house counsel to identify high-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.
* Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.
* Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.

Governance & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.
* Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.

AI Enablement
  
  

* Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.
* Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).
* Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 8+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.
* Proven track record of architecting and building AI-powered applications including multi-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations
* Proven track record in forward-deployed, embedded, or client-centric technical positions.
* Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation
* Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.
* Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration in large global organizations.
* Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.
* Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy-in from stakeholders and leadership..

**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused Product Owner to support the delivery
  
  
of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is

management.

centric
  
  

* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum

team
  
  

* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team

member
  
  

* Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and

release

* Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and

feasibility
  
  

* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Healthcare Domain Support
  
  

* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and

* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with

* Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product

features

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and

feedback

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
**Meet the Team**

Cisco Data Center Networking is the infrastructure foundation for the AI era. We are a global leader in technology innovation, dedicated to delivering advanced networking solutions that power AI factories and data centers across the globe.

We empower hyperscale, neocloud, sovereign-cloud, enterprise, and public sector customers to modernize data centers to support large AI clusters by seamlessly integrating optics, silicon, systems, and software.

We are committed to fostering a collaborative, diverse and inclusive work environment where creativity and innovation can thrive.

We are seeking Principal Product Manager to manage our product portfolio and drive the product definition of new products.

**Your Impact**

* Influence, lead, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to help define Cisco’s Data Center Networking strategy and roadmap for secure, scalable AI/ML fabrics and enterprise data center fabrics
* Steer product portfolio by identifying data center market opportunities and defining new product strategy to capture emerging opportunities
* Articulate and promote our portfolio value proposition to drive business growth with an emphasis on emerging opportunities in building secure, scalable infrastructure for AI/ML applications and enterprise workloads
* Influence and work with engineering, supply chain, finance, customer service, sales, and channel partner teams to build differentiated products and drive business.
* Develop business plans for product offerings including market analysis, competitive analysis, financial models, and pricing proposals
* Translate product capabilities into simple, compelling messages that resonate with customers
* Build impactful product marketing content and collateral such as presentations, blogs, and videos
* Provide solution/product briefings to customers or partners and cultivate relationships
* Represent or present Cisco’s Data Center Networking vision and solution/product innovations at internal and external events
* Partner with the broader marketing and sales team to amplify product messaging and drive market success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* MBA or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical fields
* 5+ years of product management experience in related areas
* 10 years of working on networking concepts, protocols, and architectures, or related areas
* Demonstrable knowledge of data center networking technologies and experience working with cross-functional teams to bring new products or solutions to market

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Solid understanding of data center networking concepts, technologies, and system design
* Experience in financial analysis, forecasting, market analysis, and competitive analysis
* Experience in ramping up and sustaining products by building opportunity pipeline and closing bookings

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* begin with screening or an interview

title: Senior Product Manager – DNA
description:
**Job Description**
It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.
  
  
**Who are we?**
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.
  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!
  
  
*Summary:*
The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.
  
  
The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.
  
  
If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.
  
  
*Duties and Responsibilities:*

* Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.
* Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.
* Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.
* Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks
* Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.
* Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.
* Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.
* Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.
* Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.
* Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:*
(To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)
  
  

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.
* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

**About You**

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and execution of the roadmap for SmartSense CRE, Ecolibrium's commercial real estate product line within the broader SmartSense platform. The role will work closely with Engineering, Design, Field Operations, Sales and Delivery to turn market insight and customer feedback into products that are competitive, high-quality and aligned to Ecolibrium's business goals.

The Senior Product Manager will lead market research, define product strategy, guide development from concept to launch and track performance against clear KPIs. SmartSense is a technically layered product spanning real-time IoT telemetry, deterministic rules engines, machine learning models and, in select modules, conversational AI. This role requires strong strategic thinking, genuine technical fluency across these layers, stakeholder management and the ability to inspire and align teams around a shared product vision. Requires 7+ years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartSense CRE, in alignment with Ecolibrium's business goals.
* Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis, including in AI-enabled energy and building management tooling, to identify trends, opportunities and customer needs.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
* Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.
* Define and monitor key product performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and inform product decisions.
* Drive continuous product improvement through customer feedback, data analysis and industry best practices.
* Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product goals.
* Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable product requirements and prioritised backlogs.
* Partner with Sales and Presales to support go-to-market activities, positioning and customer-facing product narratives, ensuring AI capabilities are represented accurately and never overstated.
* Lead and motivate cross-functional teams, setting a compelling product vision that inspires others to deliver against it.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
* 7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.
* Experience in IoT, building management systems or related industries is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, market research techniques and data analysis tools.
* Working fluency with AI product concepts: able to distinguish deterministic rule-based logic from machine learning and from LLM-based conversational features, and to make sound product decisions about where each is appropriate.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to think strategically and translate market insights into actionable product strategies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and AI-related concepts to diverse, including non-technical, stakeholders.
* Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.

**Desirable**

* Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.
* Exposure to energy management, industrial IoT or connected-building product categories.
* Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
* Familiarity with agile product development and data-driven experimentation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices relevant to enterprise B2B products, such as per-tenant data isolation, model risk considerations and honest disclosure of AI capability and certification status.
