title: Product Manager
description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.
  
  
As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.
  
  
Visa is seeking a seasoned Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.
  
  
As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer-Centric Product Vision: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* 5+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 2+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience in product management in payments, common services, and identity and access management.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams in global, highly matrixed organizations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Sr. Product Manager, High Confidence Supply-chain
description:
**Description**
As a Sr. Product Manager - High Confidence Supply-chain at Amazon, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for products that bring determinism in our fulfillment experience, and consequently, shape our concession and returns reduction strategy. You will work backward from customer needs, maneuver operational constraints and tailwinds, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to tackle ambiguous problems, make high-judgment decisions, and drive products from concept through launch and beyond across multiple countries — all while operating in an environment that rewards creative thinking and a bias toward experimentation.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from business and customer needs, using a combination of customer research, benchmarking, on-ground operational learnings, and data-driven insights to prioritize investments and make smart trade-offs.
* Partner with engineering, design, science, and cross-functional teams to translate product strategy into well-scoped deliverables, define acceptance criteria, and drive execution from prototype through launch and post-launch optimization.
* Influence without authority across teams with different priorities, building alignment among stakeholders in engineering, marketing, sales, legal, finance, and operations to deliver cohesive customer experiences.
* Own product performance by defining success criteria and key metrics, analyzing usage data and customer behavior, and iterating rapidly to improve adoption, satisfaction, and business impact.
* Leverage generative AI tools and emerging technologies to accelerate development cycles, generate deeper insights, and identify new opportunities for product innovation.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and operational partners, debating trade-offs on a new feature and for running existing ones. After lunch, you lead a cross-functional alignment meeting to resolve dependencies with a partner team. Later, you draft a product narrative for an upcoming initiative, grounding your recommendations in customer research and data. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA

* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking the best talent for a Technical Product Manager -Intercompany & Value Chain Management (VCM) to be in Bangalore, India.
  
  
As part of the Innovative Medicine (IM) Transcend and IM Finance Transformation (IMFT) programs we are looking for a strong leader that can set direction and can drive implementation based on proven knowledge and experience in the field of ERP (S4 Hana) Finance across Value Chain Management, Intercompany and Supply Chain Finance.
  
  
IM Transcend is a global business transformation program that will modernize our foundational transactional processes across the value chain of Innovative Medicine business.
  
  
IMFT is the transformation program within Innovative Medicine Finance, dedicated to enabling Finance and its business partners to deliver superior value and sustainable competitive advantage for our organization, partners, and patients.
  
  
The Technical Product Manager Intercompany & VCM will be an active member of the Innovative Medicine (IM) Supply Chain JJT team, driving global standardization within Innovative Medicine utilising ERP technology solutions in the scope of Intercompany & VCM.
  
  
The role will fundamentally lead all aspects of continuous improvement, assessment of technology capabilities & efficiencies across the ERP Intercompany & VCM scope, enabling strategic capabilities, human centred design, and platform integration across our digital ecosystem. The role will partner closely with the IM Transcend business process owners, IMFT business stakeholders, ecosystem owners and various vendor partners to ensure end to end capabilities are supported and evolved. The role will operate closely with the IM Transcend deployment organization to grow and evolve the capabilities as business and regional deployments are executed.
  
  
**Role**
The Technical Product Manager ERP Intercompany & VCM role will take responsibility for an integrated solution design supporting Financial flows across the following primary functions:
  
  

* Deliver / Logistics / Trade Sales
* Tax
* Finance
* Plan/Source
* Make

**Major Duties & Responsibilities**
**Roadmap & Backlog (30%)**

* Own vision and prioritization of new technical features and/or enhancements for Intercompany & VCM capabilities to meet business needs.
* Establish technology roadmaps to achieve efficient & effective delivery of business & customer value for Intercompany requirements.
* Balance business value with technical feasibility while prioritizing features, optimizing cost, and improving delivery efficiency.
* Further refine the backlog by adding necessary technical features and epics; work with Suppliers and Product owners, regarding supplier delivered capacity & architectural integration is understood.
* Help Product Owners prioritize their backlogs, manage product / platform constraints, and resolve cross-team dependencies; manage demand intake as required

**Solutioning (30%)**

* Accountable for solution design and implementation of the Intercompany & VCM capabilities for Innovative Medicine on the ERP platform and the integration with the ERP ecosystem
* Drive business process standardization and strategies to drive best in class design for ERP Intercompany flows + VCM
* Apply a strong understanding of BTP capabilities and integration mechanisms to automate end-to-end transactions.
* Actively engage with business and functional teams in providing the best fit technical solutions while aligning to Transcend program design and implementation standards
* Drive selection of product / platform solution options, work with the Engineering team to assess tech elements of the solution prior to user testing and to balance tech debt
* Provide technical leadership in the design and architecting of ERP solutions that will enable best in class integrations across End-to-End Intercompany flows, inclusive of integration technologies.

**Delivery (30%)**

* Accountable for technical delivery and value realization in partnership with the business workstream lead
* Accountable to manage the integrated build with the Engineering team to ensure the end-to-end build of a particular part of a solution is compliant and works as designed.
* Oversee planning and execution of Technical Testing by Engineering team; Support business workstream lead to plan and execute User Acceptance Testing
* Apply compliance requirements within scope of responsibility, ensures SDLC documentation, system configuration and compliance activities are up to date as required.
* Drive continual measurement of capabilities against demand volume, complexity, business challenges and improvement within value stream(s)

**Leadership (10%)**

* Act as the JJT workstream lead for all Intercompany & VCM integration topics, partnering closely with the Intercompany & VCM business stakeholders.
* Lead an international cross regional project team of Product Analysts through project design, execution, and deployment phases.
* Coordinate, lead, coach, motivate and inspire the team to both deliver on agreed plans and to continuously improve.
* Help Shape and Grow JJT organization to enable a global intake, build and sustain process that will drive parallel program releases and on-going operations, projects and enhancements as TranSCend goes live.
* Foster an environment of continuous improvement and innovation.

**Required Minimum Education**
: bachelor’s degree in management accounting, finance, supply chain
**Other:**
**Required Years of Related Experience:**
A minimum of 3 years of progressive experience in program/people management leadership roles within Operations, Supply Chain, or large transformation programs. A minimum of 10 years of Supply Chain Technology experience. A minimum of 3 years of ERP platform experience in a healthcare or health services industry.
  
  
**Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Domain Expertise
* Deep End-to-End understanding of Financial and Logistical Flows in multinational operations and how primary functions integrate with one another (Plan, Make, Deliver, Finance, Tax).
* Strong Knowledge of SAP-ERP integration across Production Planning, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution and Financial Accounting and System Integration with the ERP ecosystem. Applied knowledge of S/4 HANA is preferred.
* Understanding the end-to-end business process linkages across Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Finance and Master Data.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals/Healthcare industry and good Knowledge of SOX & GxP compliance regulations.
* Experience with Agile methodology and strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle Management model and documentation.
* Leadership Skills & Behaviors
* Focuses on Business agility, Agile delivery with a fail-fast mindset, and measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, with success leading multi-functional, self-organized teams
* Experience working in a global environment and leading teams across multiple countries.
* Experience effectively collaborating and managing partners.
* Contributes ideas that challenge thinking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to accurately assess situations and make well-informed decisions.
* A constant learner, looking for new ways to implement features and functions that creates higher levels of customer satisfaction.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Applied knowledge of S/4 HANA.
* People management experience, inclusive of developing, mentoring and coaching.
* Experience working in a global/regional setting.
* Experience in a large-scale business transformation program.
* Experienced in managing a product backlog/release plan, tracking team level metrics, attend product team ceremonies, removing blockers.

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Analytical Reasoning, Consulting, Cost Management, Developing Others, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Inclusive Leadership, Leadership, People Performance Management, Performance Measurement, Product Development, Product Strategies, Project Management Methodology (PMM), Research and Development, Resource Management, Software Development Management, Strategic Supply Chain Management, Team Management

title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Workday Integrations
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Associate Director, Product Owner - Workday Integrations is responsible for maximising the value of their product (Workday Integrations) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the HR product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Workday Integrations Product Owner guides delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the SD People Services and Reward and VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Associate Product Owners and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the SD People Services and Reward and the VP of HR Digital & Tech.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Knowledge of functional domains within Workday and broader HR technology ecosystem.
* Deep technical expertise over Workday Integrations.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, DevOps, Digital Solutions, Product Delivery, Product Strategies, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Story, Web Services, Workday EIB, Workday Integration, Workday Studio
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: Sr. Technical Product Manager-Networking and Switches
description:
We are seeking a deeply technical product leader to take ownership of our extensive Networking and Switches portfolio: secure console servers, managed and unmanaged PoE Ethernet switches, media converters, industrial connectivity, and serial extension solutions. This product line is central to our customers' operations across datacom, industrial, and secure government environments. We are looking for a technical authority who will drive portfolio optimization, OEM/ODM vendor management, and rigorous quality assurance, sitting at the intersection of deep hardware engineering, and product lifecycle execution. This role can be based in our Plano, TX, Lawrence, PA, or India offices to allow for direct, hands-on access to our hardware labs, though remote (US) arrangements will be considered for exceptional candidates.

**What You Will Do**

* Technical Portfolio Strategy and Optimization: Evaluate the existing networking, converter, and console server portfolio to drive SKU rationalization, BOM optimization, and margin improvement. Identify which products to consolidate or sunset and which high-margin lines to scale.
* OEM/ODM Vendor Architecture and Management: Act as the primary technical interface with our global manufacturing partners. Influence their roadmaps, negotiate technical SLAs, and drive root-cause analysis and supplier quality corrections for field failures.
* Rigorous Product Engineering and QA Leadership: Own the firmware and hardware validation gate. Design and execute New Product Introduction testing, regulatory compliance verification, and automated test frameworks.
* Level 3 Escalation Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for complex field failures. Perform hands-on debugging in the lab, translate field data into engineering requirements, and enforce corrective actions with vendors.
* Engineering Impact of Compliance and Certification: Partner with the Compliance Manager, who tracks market mandates and certification requirements. You translate those mandates into hardware and firmware requirements, evaluating vendor BOMs and architectures so that component or firmware changes do not silently invalidate FIPS, TAA, UL, NERC CIP, and other relevant standards.
* Lifecycle and Knowledge Execution: Manage the product lifecycle from NPI through End-of-Life. Build the technical documentation, training material, troubleshooting guides, firmware test checklists, and compatibility matrices that empower support, Product Ops, and adjacent product managers.
* Cross-Portfolio Technical Collaboration: Act as the networking subject matter expert for the broader product organization, supporting Sales and Product Marketing with technical content.

**Core Technical Expertise**

* Layer 2 and Layer 3 Networking Standards: VLANs (802.1Q), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP/RSTP/MSTP), link aggregation (LACP), QoS/CoS prioritization, IP routing (Static, OSPF), IGMP snooping, and security mechanisms like 802.1X and ACLs.
* Media Conversion and Physical Layer Mechanics: Optical and copper interfaces (SFP/SFP+, RJ-45, single-mode vs. multi-mode fiber, wavelength specifications), Power over Ethernet standards, and rate-matching mechanics.
* PoE System Engineering: PSE/PD classification and power budget validation across 802.3af, 802.3at, intelligent detection and backward-compatibility behavior, and downstream device power profiling.
* Harsh-Environment and Industrial Specifications: Industrial hardening, wide operating temperatures, high EMC/EMI immunity, redundant power inputs, ring redundancy protocols, and DIN-rail or panel-mount deployment.
* Out-of-Band Management and Connectivity Protocols: Console server architectures, secure out-of-band access, terminal emulation, serial-over-IP encapsulation, and USB extension technology.
* Security, Authentication, and Compliance Implementation: How standards are physically and logically implemented in networking gear, including TPM 2.0, FIPS 140-2/3 validated cryptographic modules, TAA-compliant supply chains, and NERC CIP supporting features; AAA frameworks (TACACS+, RADIUS, Kerberos, 802.1X) and VPN technologies (OpenVPN, IPsec) as applied to secure out-of-band platforms; plus ZTP, RESTful API, and SNMP/LLDP/NTP integration.
* Serial and Signal Extension Technologies: Classic serial interfaces (RS-232, RS-422, RS-485) and V.35/Coax signal conversion, along with the electrical principles of signal attenuation, impedance matching, and long-distance copper extension.
* OT and Industrial Serial Practice: Modbus ASCII/RTU over RS-422/485, and serial line conditioning including bias, termination, isolation (e.g., 2-kV), and surge protection.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role**

* You are a hands-on technical leader who is just as comfortable reading a market trend report as you are hooking up a serial cable to debug a spanning-tree loop in the lab.
* You have experience managing OEM/ODM relationships and know how to hold external engineering teams accountable to strict quality and firmware standards.
* You understand that in an extensive hardware portfolio, strategy is realized through rigorous execution, BOM optimization, and reliable technical sustainment
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

**EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related technical field; OR equivalent hands-on experience with a proven track record in hardware validation and network engineering.
* Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent industrial networking certifications are highly preferred and can substitute for formal education requirements.

title: Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform (Bengaluru)
description:
**We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru**

**About ReN3**

ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment.

**About the Role**

As a Product Manager, you will own a product area from start to finish: the customer problem, the spec, the build, the eval, the release and adoption. You will work directly with engineers, the field team and customers. You create your own path, even when there’s no roadmap to follow, and stand confidently by the choices you make.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own one or two product areas.**
  Examples: agents and workflows, knowledge ingestion and search, or admin and governance.
* **Turn customer reality into decisions.**
  Join customer calls, read RFPs and field requests, and decide what to build, what to defer and what to refuse.
* **Write specs that ship.**
  Your specs cover acceptance criteria, edge cases, permission rules, empty states and failure states. They should be clear enough for a coding agent to build from and for an engineer to review against.
* **Build things yourself.**
  Use coding agents to make prototypes, internal tools, scripts and small product fixes. Opening a PR for a copy change or a UI tweak is part of the job.
* **Define quality for AI features.**
  Build eval sets and golden prompts. Measure answer quality, latency and cost. Make ship or no-ship calls from data, not from a good demo.
* **Run releases.**
  Prioritise, cut scope, write release notes, and equip the field team to sell, deploy and support what shipped.
* **Measure adoption.**
  Know which features customers use, which they don't and why.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Based in Bengaluru
* **3–5 years in product management**
  , at least 2 of them on B2B SaaS, developer or platform products. Engineers and founders who moved into product are welcome.
* **Daily use of agentic coding.**
  You have shipped something real, mostly built with coding agents: a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. You can show it and explain where the agent went wrong.
* **A working understanding of LLM products:**
  retrieval (RAG), tool calling, context limits, hallucination and evals. You know why a demo that works 8 times out of 10 is not yet a product.
* **High agency**
  . Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes.
* **Clear writing.**
  Short specs, crisp decisions, no filler.
* **Comfortable with enterprise requirements:**
  SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, data residency and security questionnaires.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience using evaluation tooling such as promptfoo, Braintrust or LangSmith.
* Experience with enterprise sales cycles, RFPs or tenders.
* Products shipped into banking, government or other regulated industries.

**How to apply**

* Submit your resume (more specifications below).
* Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL or a 3-minute Loom).
* Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on one thing the agent got wrong and how you caught it.

title: Senior Product Manager (CRM Integration)
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud.*

**About the Role**

Cvent's acquisition strategy has brought together some of the most recognized names in event technology, each with their own Salesforce-native application used by event marketers and meeting professionals worldwide. As we integrate these businesses, we're creating a dedicated role to bring unified ownership, strategic clarity, and a cohesive customer experience across our entire Salesforce app portfolio.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility position for a senior product leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM ecosystems, enterprise SaaS, and portfolio strategy. You'll be the single accountable owner across five Salesforce applications — setting the overarching strategy, driving day-to-day roadmap decisions, and ensuring Cvent stays ahead of Salesforce's evolving platform requirements.

**In This Role, You Will:**

**Own a Portfolio of Salesforce Products**

* Serve as the single accountable owner across a portfolio of five Salesforce-native applications spanning our event technology brands — setting strategy, driving roadmap decisions, and ensuring a consistent customer experience.
* Lead our flagship Salesforce application as your core product, managing its end-to-end roadmap and balancing new feature investment against technical debt.
* Shepherd an acquired application from beta through General Availability, working closely with customers and go-to-market teams to define readiness criteria and launch successfully.
* Partner with PMs across acquired brands to align product direction and ensure cohesion across the portfolio.
* Where leadership decides to consolidate apps, own the migration workstream — defining requirements and partnering with Customer Success to ensure a seamless transition for customers.

**Define the Salesforce Strategy**

* Embed AI as a default lens across product decisions; champion AI-native processes within your team.

**Drive Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Lead alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, UX, and acquired-company partners.
* Use data — analytics platforms, customer feedback, and OKRs — to guide prioritization and communicate progress to leadership.

**Here's What You Need:**

* 12+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with direct experience shipping Salesforce-native or deeply integrated CRM products.
* Salesforce AppExchange or managed package experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex, multi-product roadmaps — especially in post-acquisition or multi-brand environments.
* Experience owning customer migration or product consolidation workstreams.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI tools and a track record of embedding AI into PM workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Mixpanel or similar to drive adoption and measure impact.
* Exceptional communicator — comfortable aligning leadership team, engineering, and external partners around a shared product vision.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Director WW Field PM in the Data Security Product Organization department.
  
  
As a key member of the Data Security Product Organization, you will focus on growing and sustaining core business revenue across the APJ region, with a special emphasis on our AI-powered data security product lines.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product Management and Sales leadership to drive field engagements and provide technical and commercial expertise to Sales Engineers and Account Executives throughout the customer lifecycle. Additionally, you will play a critical role in shaping platform evolution by translating real-world customer feedback from the field to solve emerging AI and data security challenges.

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Proven track record of designing, scaling, or securing Generative AI infrastructure and cloud security platforms, with hands-on experience in automated Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), AI-driven data detection, and AI runtime protection
* Comprehensive understanding of core Internet and network protocols (including TCP, UDP, HTTP/S, DNS, SSL/TLS) and modern network traffic architectures

title: Associate Product Director
description:
**About WeRize**

Founded in 2019 by Vishal Chopra and Himanshu Gupta, WeRize is building India’s largest full stack fintech platform for 500 million underserved middle-class customers who live in 5000+ small towns of India. WeRize (Wortgage technologies pvt ltd) also owns RBI registered NBFC subsidiary (Wortgage Finance pvt ltd).

This customer segments not served by private sector banks, Insurers and Mutual Fund companies due to their low ticket-size and lifetime value and is dependent on PSU/Govt. banks. PSU/Government banks rarely provide financial products beyond basic savings accounts and these customers lack access to unsecured loans, MSME loans, credit cards, affordable housing loans, loan against property , health and life insurance and investment products. WeRize manufactures innovative unsecured consumer credit, mortgages, loan against property, MSME loans,savings and insurance products designed for this customer base keeping in mind their needs, requirements and purchasing power, with a view to add a layer of financial security to their lives and enable access to credit.

While customers in these geographies use smartphones, they need proper guidance and support when purchasing the right financial products for themselves. So, a pure digital model doesn’t work for this segment. WeRize has innovated on this front through its ‘Finance ki online dukaan (Social Shopify of Finance)’, a first of its kind social distribution tech platform in the financial services space that educates and enables local financially literate freelancers across these small towns to source business through online and offline channels, recommend the right financial product(s) to customers as well as provide after sales support. These freelancers, who are located in more than 5000+ towns and cities, earn as much as INR 30,000 a month from WeRize in commissions. Our social distribution platform supported by financially literate freelancers means exceptionally low cost of customer acquisition (CAC) and operations costs compared to both fully digital and on-the-ground financial services providers. Digital conversions among this target group are way lower when compared to upper income customers in metros and hence pure digital CAC doesn’t work for this segment. While companies like LIC and Fino Bank also rely on freelancer distribution, they deploy local on-field teams/branches to manage freelancers in every city. That results in very high CAC and operations costs for such companies. WeRize on the other hand, has been able to acquire, train and manage thousands of freelancers in 5000+ cities only through its tech platform and without any feet-on-street team of its own. This results in highly profitable business model for Werize.

title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Corporate Security
description:
**Job Purpose:**
Associate Director, Product Owner - Corporate Security is responsible for maximising the value of the Corporate Security products within across the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Corporate Security Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.
  
  
This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager
* Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc), for all Corporate Security products ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager and the Corporate Security leadership team
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required digital & tech management systems security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Partner with the Director, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager to ensure digital & tech supports Corporate Security strategy to protect GSK places, people and products. Ensure the technology in this space is top quartile and has bold data lead roadmaps
* Partner with the Corporate Security by Design team to ensure that Corporate Security technology standards are consistently delivered on time and to cost at GSK sites.
* Partner with Corporate Security to deliver technology products that support crisis & continuity management and overall risk management
* Ensure the Corporate Security technology stack and associated infrastructure is fit for purpose and is architected according to industry best practices.

**Required Skills & Qualifications :**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
* 15 to 19 Years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
* Experience working within Corporate Security technology domain.
* Experience deploying C-Cure 9000
* Experience of Cloud infrastructure hosting for Security systems
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
* Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
* Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
* Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
* Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
* Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
* Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
* Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.

**Skills**
Access Control (AC), CCTV Surveillance, CCURE 9000, Cloud Hosting, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, Digital Solutions, Physical Security, Product Delivery, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Video Surveillance System
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

description:

title: Senior Digital Product Owner D365 CE – Field Service and Project Operations
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Title: Senior Digital Product Owner D365 CE – Field Service and Project Operations**
**Management Level:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**Job Summary**
Caterpillar is seeking a well‑qualified
**D365 Product Owner – Field Service and Project Operations**
, to support the full functional needs of the Caterpillar Enterprise Resource Platform (ERP) template for Caterpillar Dealers. The ERP solution is built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations integrated with Finance & Operations (F&O).
  
  
The ideal candidate will lead end‑to‑end implementations, architect scalable CE solutions, and drive integrations across enterprise systems, ensuring compliance with Microsoft standards while guiding organizations through digital transformation initiatives. Additionally, the candidate will contribute to solutioning and developing
**D365 CE templates**
for implementation.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and own Dynamics 365 CE product vision and roadmap across Field Service and Project Operations.
* Translate business requirements into secure, high‑performing CE solutions aligned with Caterpillar’s customer engagement strategies.
* Partner with stakeholders to define customer journeys, omnichannel service strategies, scheduling, and reporting frameworks.
* Drive integration strategies between CE, F&O, third‑party, and legacy systems (including Dual Write and Dataverse).
* Partner with Finance, PMO, Operations, and IT stakeholders to define project lifecycle, costing models, revenue recognition, billing methods, and compliance frameworks.
* Drive solution alignment across Project Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and HR modules.
* Champion adoption of Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Microsoft Fabric for advanced CE reporting and analytics.

**System Ownership**

* Configure and manage CE modules including Field Service and Project Operations (Lightweight and Integrated Deployment) to meet Caterpillar dealer needs.
* Stay current with Microsoft D365 CE updates and recommend enhancements that improve service delivery and customer engagement.
* Manage functional and technical interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with D365 Finance & Operations for GL, AR, AP, Cost Accounting, and Financial Reporting, ISV solutions, and Power Platform.

**Requirements Definition**

* Collaborate with Caterpillar, Caterpillar Dealers, and business stakeholders to elicit and document CE requirements.
* Conduct gap/fit analysis across Field Service and Project Operations workstreams, ensuring compliance with Caterpillar’s standards.
* Prepare technical documentation and training materials for engineering teams, alongside non‑technical presentations for stakeholders.
* Communicate dealer and customer feedback to technology teams to improve CE product quality and roadmap alignment.

**Delivery & Execution**

* Prepare test scripts and validations to conduct CRP, UAT, SIT, and support go‑live activities.
* Perform volume testing, regression testing, and end‑to‑end integration testing by modeling real‑world service scenarios.
* Lead backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies to ensure delivery excellence in CE projects.
* Provide support to architects and engineers by fulfilling testing requests, preparing reports, and offering technical assistance.

**Release Management**

* Partner with cross‑functional teams to manage release dependencies and clarify CE requirements.
* Manage DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, and environment strategies for CE projects.
* Oversee Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) and plan testing before code releases across Dev/UAT/Prod environments.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a product advocate within the engineering team, ensuring QA and testing insights are incorporated into CE product improvements.
* Build strong relationships with Caterpillar Digital leads, external vendors, and Caterpillar Dealers to align CE architecture with business goals.

**Change Management**

* Identify opportunities to improve dealer service processes and drive operational consistency across Field Service and Project Operations.
* Manage change requirements by incorporating risk assessments, QA insights, and corrective actions into CE delivery.

**User Training & Support**

* Prepare technical and non‑technical documentation, workflows, and playbooks to ensure dealer understanding and adoption of CE solutions.
* Collaborate with training departments to deliver Field Service and Project Operations training programs and provide ongoing support.
* Assist in resolving or remediating CE issues, ensuring smooth dealer operations.

**What You Will Have**
**ERP & Systems Knowledge (MS Dynamics 365 CE focus)**

* Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE modules (Field Service and Project Operations) in product ownership and delivery roles.
* Strong background in solution design, integrations, and performance optimization across CE workloads.
* Skilled in Azure DevOps for backlog management, delivery tracking, and Agile execution.
* Practical experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Azure services to extend CE capabilities.
* Expertise in Microsoft Fabric and Power BI reporting tools for CE performance monitoring.
* Experience with Dual Write, Dataverse, and data migration strategies for seamless CE–F&O integration.
* Knowledge of ISV solutions and Electronic Reporting for CE–F&O integrations.
* Awareness of Microsoft release cycles and ability to assess new CE features for business value.
* Passion for continuous learning and emerging technologies to enhance CE processes.
* Deep hands‑on experience with:

+ Dynamics 365 Project Operations (PMA)
+ Dynamics 365 Finance (Project Accounting integration)

* Strong understanding of project-centric ERP implementations.

**Business Analysis**

* Deep understanding of customer engagement processes: case resolution, service scheduling, work order management, lead management, and campaign execution.
* Ability to identify gaps in CE processes and design system‑driven solutions.
* Experience supporting KPIs such as first‑time fix rate, customer satisfaction, service response times, and campaign ROI.

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking**

* Analytical skills to interpret CE data and performance metrics, identifying opportunities for improved customer engagement.
* Ability to support CE leadership with actionable insights for service efficiency, customer satisfaction, and sales growth.
* Skilled in assessing interdependencies among CE system elements and related applications that help or hinder performance.
* Manages tools and techniques for testing extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of CE data.

**Effective Communications**

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to translate CE technical requirements into business‑friendly terms.
* Skilled at facilitating workshops, demos, and discussions with service, sales, marketing, IT, and dealer stakeholders.
* Strong presentation and negotiation skills to align diverse stakeholders.
* Collaborative approach to building consensus and driving CE adoption across departments.

**Software Product Business Knowledge**

* Proven experience owning CE product backlogs, defining roadmaps, and managing releases.
* Skilled in writing clear CE user stories and acceptance criteria based on stakeholder input.

description:

Moving Tech (Namma Yatri) is an open-mobility infrastructure company—think of us as the AWS/Google Cloud for mobility. Our family of apps—Namma Yatri (Karnataka, TN), Yatri Sathi (West Bengal), Odisha Yatri, Kerala Savaari, Chennai One (public transit—MTC buses, Metro Rail & suburban trains), Bharat Taxi (government-backed cooperative cab service in Delhi NCR & Gujarat), and more—are transforming mobility by being people-first. Company: movingtech.com

**About the Role:**

At Moving Tech, Product Managers own the product journey end-to-end, balancing product development, operations, and customer engagement. This is an opportunity to be a true creator, not just a coordinator.

**Can PMs become TRUE creators?**

* Can they CODE?
* Can they Design?
* Can they analyze data programmatically?
* Can they deeply empathize with the users they’re building for?

**Yes, they can!**
At Moving Tech, PMs are empowered to upskill themselves and collaborate across teams, including Development, Design, Growth, Communications, Support, and Operations. PMs here don’t just write product specs—they actively participate in the creation process, ensuring specifications are practical and deliverable.

**The PM in the Age of AI**

We believe AI is the next S-curve, a phase transition on the scale of the microprocessor or the internet that will reprice everything. The cost of building software is collapsing, and the bar for real value is rising fast: the PMs who lead will be the ones who use AI to go faster, deeper, and broader.

It is a new way of working. What used to be 10x PM work will become the baseline. Tool users must become tool builders. Spec writers, code writers. Specialists, generalists who move fluently across design, engineering, and growth. The PMs who thrive will be the ones who pair theory with hands-on building.

What does not change is what we believe about building software: that it must create real value, exhibit supreme craft, and be reasoned from first principles. AI is a lever for these beliefs, and a means to deepen our understanding of the problems we solve and the solutions we build.

**Key Responsibilities:**

● Own and drive the vision of the organization.

● Deeply understand and continuously improve knowledge in:

* Domain: Mobility
* Technology: Purescript, Haskell, TypeScript
* Design: Mobile UX/UI (using Figma, Figjam, Protopie)
* Data: User journey analysis and conversions (using SQL & data science tools)

● Deliver impactful results by leading hands-on involvement in product development, leading by example.

● Develop foundational solutions that address core problems.

● Collaborate and coordinate with stakeholders to craft optimal products.

● Continuously optimize the product development process for speed and quality

**Must-Have Qualities:**

● Strong aspiration for value creation and quality.

● Genuine empathy for users and their needs.

● Patience and openness to learn challenging skills.

● A systematic problem-solving mindset.

● Proactive get-things-done attitude.

● Ability to balance big-picture and attention to detail.

● Self-motivation and drive.

● Persuasive, but not forceful—influence with respect.

● A giver attitude, always ready to contribute.

**Bonus Points For Prior Experience in:**

● Technical skills: Programming and curiosity to understand systems.

● Design interests: A keen eye for UX and active interest in mobile design.

● People-centric approach:

* Purpose-driven and open to understanding users deeply.
* Willingness to experience products firsthand (e.g., driving an auto or cab using the driver app).
* Learning local languages.
* Engaging with the open-source community.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

● MBA with an engineering or science background.

● Experience or eagerness to thrive in a high-energy startup environment.

● Prior Product Management experience is not mandatory.

title: Products & Platforms Lead – Insurance Technology
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Products & Platforms Lead – Insurance Technology

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Engineering – NA CI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Products & Platforms Lead who understands insurance at its core and can translate that domain knowledge into technology platform decisions. You will lead the strategy, lifecycle management, and engineering delivery of Chubb's core insurance technology platforms — covering underwriting, rating, policy administration, and associated product engines. You sit at the intersection of insurance domain expertise and platform technology, owning how core insurance platforms are governed, evolved, and modernised to support Chubb's North America business. Internal candidates with deep Chubb platform knowledge are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product and platform strategy for Chubb's core insurance technology platforms — underwriting, rating, policy administration, and product configuration engines.
* Define platform roadmaps aligned to business priorities: product launches, market expansion, regulatory changes, and technology modernisation.
* Lead vendor and partner management for insurance packaged platforms (e.g. Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or equivalent); govern upgrade cycles, licensing, and contractual obligations.
* Drive platform governance: version management, configuration standards, integration patterns, lifecycle controls, and technical debt management.
* Partner with underwriting, actuarial, product, and technology leaders to translate business requirements into platform capabilities and configuration.
* Identify and drive opportunities to leverage AI in core insurance platform operations — intelligent rating, automated underwriting assistance, data-driven product configuration, and claims triage.
* Govern platform integrations across the insurance technology estate: policy, billing, claims, reinsurance, and distribution systems.
* Build and lead a team of platform engineers and product owners; develop deep platform expertise and insurance domain knowledge within the team.
* Engage with global architecture and technology leadership to ensure platforms align with enterprise standards and modernisation strategy.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong insurance domain knowledge — underwriting, rating, policy administration, claims, and insurance product lifecycle across P&C, Specialty, or A&H lines.
* Experience managing or implementing core insurance technology platforms (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, FINEOS, or equivalent).
* Understanding of insurance product configuration, rating factors, underwriting rules engines, and actuarial data requirements.
* Technology leadership experience: ability to define platform strategy and govern complex, multi-system programmes across vendors and internal teams.
* Exposure to AI and analytics applications in insurance — intelligent underwriting, predictive rating, automated decisioning, and claims automation.
* Strong stakeholder management: ability to work effectively across underwriting, actuarial, product, and technology leadership at senior levels.
* Programme management and vendor governance experience in a regulated financial services environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 15+ years in insurance technology, with strong domain depth across underwriting, rating, or policy administration platforms.
* Internal candidates with deep Chubb platform and product knowledge are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India's journey.

**Job Description**

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
