The portfolio currently includes Employee Central, employee and workforce data, Position Management, Organisation Management, employee lifecycle processes and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.
* This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate defects and deliver product improvements. You will ensure that stakeholders remain focused on the business problem and required outcomes, while People Technology brings the product expertise needed to determine the most effective solution.
* You will also create and maintain the detailed configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation needed to support effective governance, auditability, continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, constructively challenging assumptions and translating business requirements into clear options, recommendations, functional designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assigned Foundation capabilities, bringing relevant platform knowledge, leading practices and product insight into business and delivery decisions.

* Work with the Foundation Product Manager and Project Managers on larger initiatives, providing product expertise, detailed requirements, scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery information.
* Analyse People processes, workforce data structures, business rules, roles, permissions, integrations and operational impacts to support effective end-to-end solution design.
* Assess Foundation-related incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolution or improvement routes.
* Assess SAP SuccessFactors release updates and product-roadmap changes, identifying relevant impacts, risks and opportunities and coordinating the testing, documentation, stakeholder readiness and adoption activity required.
* Create and maintain configuration workbooks, configuration records, requirements, functional designs, process documentation, solution decisions, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live product and supports auditability, operational continuity, supportability and future change.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria, undertake or coordinate functional and regression testing, support user acceptance testing and ensure defects, decisions and test evidence are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor product health, data quality, recurring defects, adoption and operational performance, identifying and delivering opportunities to simplify processes, improve configuration, reduce manual activity and increase business value.
* Work confidently with support and implementation partners, leading or contributing to workshops, reviewing designs and deliverables, challenging recommendations and ensuring agreed documentation and knowledge transfer are completed.
* Maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification.
* Share product knowledge, methods, documentation and lessons with colleagues, reducing single points of failure and increasing the resilience of the People Technology team.
* Contribute to the Foundation People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, support adoption and improve the effective use of Foundation capabilities.
* Support other People Technology domains where demand and capacity require, providing flexible delivery capacity, holiday cover and broader development while maintaining accountability for assigned Foundation responsibilities.

* Strong understanding of core HR processes, employee lifecycle activities, workforce data, organisational structures, Position Management and related People Foundation capabilities.
* Experience leading discovery and requirements workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.

* Experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, regression testing, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
* Experience assessing incidents, defects, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendation of appropriate solutions.

* Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.

your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. **Your Role At Baxter**

You will apply expert technical knowledge and engineering principles in the development of products and solutions. You will collaborate with cross functional team for technical issues, design changes, design reviews, and complex problem resolution

* Collaborate closely with software, hardware, and systems teams to support successful product integration and development testing.
* Work with Verification & Validation (V&V) teams to define comprehensive verification strategies and test plans that ensure thorough requirements coverage.
* Provide technical leadership and expertise to help projects achieve key objectives related to quality, cost, schedule, and regulatory compliance.
* Contribute to the successful delivery of innovative healthcare solutions by championing best practices in systems engineering, risk management, and product development.

g

title: People Technology Service and Experience Senior Product Specialist
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.
  
  
The People Technology Service & Experience Senior Product Specialist will work with business stakeholders to understand service challenges, user needs and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Service & Experience portfolio.
  
  
Reporting to the People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager, you will collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, technical specialists and external delivery partners. You will bring strong knowledge of ServiceNow, particularly HR Service Delivery, across capabilities such as case management, service catalogue, knowledge, self-service, lifecycle events and workflow automation.
  
  
This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape service and functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate incidents and defects and deliver service improvements. You will also help design joined-up People services and lifecycle journeys involving other functions, while those functions remain responsible for their own services and activities.
  
  
You will maintain the configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation required for governance, auditability, service continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
  
  
Although primarily aligned to People Service & Experience, you may support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  

* Work with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand service challenges, business problems, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, translating business and service requirements into clear options, service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, bringing strong platform knowledge, leading practices and service insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised ServiceNow configuration, administration, enhancements, workflow improvements and optimisation within agreed access, security, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned changes from discovery through design, configuration, testing, release, operational handover and early-life support, maintaining appropriate traceability, documentation and evidence throughout the lifecycle.
* Analyse People services, processes, user journeys, case-management requirements, service-catalogue structures, knowledge needs, workflows, roles, permissions and integrations to shape effective end-to-end solutions.
* Support the development of consistent global People services and ways of working, simplifying, standardising and automating processes while recognising legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and improve Employee Centre and digital service experiences, service-catalogue, case-management, knowledge, employee and manager self-service and workflow capabilities, including forms, record producers, routing, assignment, approvals, notifications, service levels and supporting metadata.
* Design and configure HRSD lifecycle events, coordinating with other functions where journeys include activities such as IT provisioning, identity and access, equipment, Security, Facilities, Learning or background screening, while those functions remain accountable for their own services.


+ Apply service-design, journey-mapping and experience-design practices to simplify employee and manager interactions and improve end-to-end service outcomes.
+ Assess incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolutions or improvements.
+ Coordinate functional, regression and user-acceptance testing and support product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.
+ Create and maintain configuration workbooks, requirements, service and functional designs, workflow and service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live platform and supports auditability, continuity and future change.
+ Monitor product health, service and workflow performance, adoption and usability, identifying opportunities to improve configuration, simplify services, increase automation and deliver greater business value.
+ Work confidently with support and implementation partners, reviewing and constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing, documentation and delivery outputs, while ensuring effective knowledge transfer and reducing unnecessary partner dependency.

+ Contribute to the Service & Experience People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, strengthen adoption and improve effective use of the portfolio.
+ Support the future development of colleague-listening and experience-management capabilities, including Qualtrics, translating feedback and journey insight into actionable service and product improvements.
+ Partner with the Foundation team and architecture, security, data, integration and Microsoft product teams to support effective integration between ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise technologies.

* Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including practical configuration, functional or service design, testing and controlled platform-change delivery.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, AHS
description:
**Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
  
  
Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
  
  
Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
  
  
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
  
  
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
* Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

At the heart of this global ecosystem is the Partner Program Platform, which powers the foundational infrastructure and lifecycle operations for Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. The techno functional resource shall focus primarily on individual business processes and systems throughout the Finance, Treasury & Analytics functions, however, they also may work with stakeholders of Sales, Supply Chain, and other functional areas as well.
  
  
This individual will work collaboratively across all the Finance business processes and departments to design, build, test, and implement applications solutions. The primary focus will be on our ERP system, which is Oracle Cloud ERP. The ideal candidate will be capable of quickly understanding business processes, organizing projects and tasks, and communicating at all levels of the organization.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**Business Functional Knowledge**

* Partner with business users to define scalable, flexible and cost-effective processes aligned with current and future business needs.
* Design process improvements with minimal disruption to existing systems while considering the impact on key stakeholders.
* Evaluate proposed changes to ensure the best overall fit for the organisation.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to work on multiple tasks and to self-manage deliverables, meetings, and information gathering.

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

title: Senior Manager – GTM Strategy

title: Lead Associate Demand
description:
**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
  
  
We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
  
  
Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
  
  
**Lead Associate Demand**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, and user-centric Manager – Storefront Planning & Analytics to own and elevate the Myntra Club storefront (combining Below-The-Line/BTL initiatives and the dedicated in-app shopping experience).
  
  
In this role, you will stand at the intersection of consumer trends, UX design, data analytics, and growth strategy. You will track what’s buzzing in the branded and premium fashion segments, partner with UI/UX teams to build an elite "experience-meets-commerce" ecosystem, and work closely with category leads to curate compelling stories, events, and IPs that drive engagement and revenue.

* Storefront Experience & UI/UX Strategy
* Best-in-Class Experience: Collaborate directly with UI/UX design and product teams to build and maintain an immersive Myntra Club environment that balances premium brand aesthetics with frictionless commerce conversion.
* Trend & Premium Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of macroeconomic and consumer trends within the branded and premium fashion/lifestyle segments to continuously evolve the storefront narrative.

* Analytics, Search & Performance Optimization

* Portfolio Health: Develop, roll out, and maintain 360-degree performance dashboards to track platform and category-level metrics, helping leadership isolate friction points and double down on high-growth areas.

* Growth Initiatives & Stakeholder Influence
* Flagship Events & IPs: Conceptualize, launch, and scale high-impact growth initiatives, signature shopping events, and exclusive IPs for Myntra Club.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Influence key internal stakeholders across Category Management, Central Planning, Marketing, and Tech to align on strategic roadmaps and achieve top-line goals.
* Business Prioritization: Partner with executive leadership to establish a clear, prioritized list of growth needs across various business segments.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or a related quantitative field from an accredited university or college.
* Experience: 2+ years of direct experience in e-commerce analytics, digital storefront strategy, or category planning.
* Technical Proficiency: Expert-level mastery of Advanced MS Excel is strictly required. Familiarity with e-commerce analytics tools and data visualization frameworks is highly preferred.
* Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven track record of synthesizing data into stories for senior stakeholders.
* Execution & Ownership: Highly self-motivated and results-oriented; able to operate independently with minimal oversight in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

**TITLE: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application**
**Location: This position must be in the Bay Area, CA or Bengaluru, India and required to be in the office 2 to 3 times a week.**
**What You’ll Do**
The Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration for Duck Creek carriers. This role defines how AI agents read, understand, and translate complex carrier product documents into structured, validated Duck Creek product configuration compressing work that takes analysts from weeks to hours.
  
  
This role converts complex carrier workflow needs, AI accuracy requirements, document understanding challenges, and multi-line-of-business scalability goals into clear product priorities, requirements, and measurable outcomes. It requires deep comfort operating at the intersection of agentic AI, insurance product domain knowledge, and enterprise software delivery.
  
  
This role exercises independent judgment and partners across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, AI Platform, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier stakeholders to deliver governed, accurate, and scalable agentic configuration capabilities.
  
  

* Define and maintain the product strategy and roadmap for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration, including document ingestion, structured data extraction, knowledge graph development, configuration generation, output validation, and human review workflow design.
* Translate carrier product configuration needs, document change workflows, accuracy requirements, and line-of-business expansion goals into clearly defined epics, features, use cases, requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to define scalable, reliable, and maintainable agent pipeline patterns, including agent orchestration design, event-driven communication, durable state management, and cloud infrastructure requirements.
* Define product capabilities for a knowledge graph that represents relationships between insurance product elements, enabling intelligent change impact detection, cross-element dependency tracking, and semantic abstraction over raw product document structure.
* Drive an eval-first product culture: define accuracy targets by capability, establish a continuous evaluation methodology using AI observability tooling, and ensure no feature ships without a measurable accuracy signal.
* Partner with AI Platform, Semantic Insurance Data, Data Orchestration, Security, and Governance teams to support trusted context, responsible AI controls, and reliable execution across carrier document types and product lines.
* Define carrier-facing product capabilities, including configuration request intake, pipeline status visibility, reviewer experience, extraction result review, and output approval workflows.
* Evaluate trade-offs across extraction accuracy, pipeline reliability, reviewer burden, scalability, carrier data privacy, infrastructure cost, and time-to-market when shaping product priorities and requirements.
* Define adoption, accuracy, reliability, and business impact measures — including extraction accuracy, configuration validity rates, human review approval rates, pipeline throughput, LOB onboarding velocity, and carrier time-to-configuration.
* Support release planning, readiness, and communication by clarifying scope, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, and expected accuracy outcomes.
* Maintain awareness of emerging agentic AI frameworks, LLM evaluation methodologies, knowledge graph technologies, document understanding models, and insurance product configuration patterns to inform product direction.

**WHAT YOU’VE DONE:**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Insurance, Product Management, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in technical product management, AI product management, platform services, software engineering, or related roles.
* Experience owning complex AI, data, platform, or document-processing product capabilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, architecture, data science, customer-facing teams, and business stakeholders.
* Experience translating ambiguous business and technical problems into product strategy, roadmap priorities, requirements, release plans, and measurable outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree or equivalent advanced experience in a relevant field.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks, LLM evaluation, knowledge graphs, document understanding, structured data extraction, or agentic AI pipeline design.
* Experience in property and casualty insurance, InsurTech, financial services, or another complex regulated industry, particularly in product configuration, underwriting, policy administration, or manuscript management.
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures, cloud-native platforms, LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks, and human-in-the-loop system design.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
**Knowledge**

* Technical product management practices for complex AI, data pipeline, or document processing capabilities.
* AI agent design, including LLM-based extraction, deterministic agent patterns, orchestration frameworks, and multi-stage pipeline architecture.
* Extraction accuracy concepts, including eval harness design, scoring methodology, baseline comparison, and prompt iteration.
* Knowledge graph concepts, including entity relationship modeling, semantic abstraction, dependency graph traversal, and change impact analysis.
* Human-in-the-loop design patterns, including review gate placement, correction capture, audit logging, and reviewer experience.
* Document understanding across complex insurance documents, including rate manuals, carrier filing documents, underwriting guidelines, and product manuscripts.
* Event-driven system design, including versioned event contracts, Pub/Sub patterns, durable state management, and agent checkpointing.
* Responsible AI practices, including hallucination detection, deterministic output validation, schema-enforced output gates, and accuracy-gated deployment.
* Cloud-native platforms, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, and enterprise security patterns relevant to carrier data handling.

**Skills**

* Translating ambiguous carrier configuration needs and AI accuracy requirements into structured product requirements, clear priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluating trade-offs across extraction accuracy, reviewer burden, LOB scalability, infrastructure cost, carrier data privacy, and time-to-market.
* Analyzing accuracy, reliability, pipeline performance, and business impact metrics to inform product decisions and prioritization.

**Abilities**

* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority across a broad cross-functional organization, including Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier customers.
* Ability to explain complex AI extraction, knowledge graph, and validation decisions in clear business and carrier terms.
* Ability to use AI-enabled tools to support product discovery, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and iterative product development.

**Other Requirements**

* Travel: 10%
* Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in the country of the job location.
* Work location: Bay Area, CA Or Bengaluru, India

This collaborative and team-oriented approach is at the core of how we operate and continuously improve our products, services, and systems. As such, Duck Creek is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants – to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital, military, or any other protected status.

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager – Discover**
**Job Description**
**About the Position**
As an
**Associate**
**Product Manager – Discover**
, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Sense’s intelligent automation and agentic AI ecosystem.
  
  
You will work on some of Sense’s most strategic problem spaces, including:
  
  

* Empower recruiters to rapidly identify top-tier candidates for open job orders across ATS and Sense platforms, accelerating time to fill job orders.
* Drive higher application rates for open jobs by connecting job seekers with the most relevant jobs across Email, SMS, Voice, and Chat surfaces.
* Structured AI Decisioning out of unstructured data within automation workflows to ensure rapid yet meaningful outreach and audience engagement
* LLM-powered Recommendation and Decisioning Engines which drive above outcomes
* Reliable Feedback Loop - AI Quality, Observability & Data Quality monitoring to ensure reliable and explainable outcomes for recruiters and customers

This role sits at the intersection of AI, workflow orchestration, automation infrastructure, and recruiter productivity. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and GTM teams to conceptualize, build, and scale products that automate recruiting workflows and empower recruiters with AI-driven assistance.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential Product Manager who enjoys solving complex platform and systems problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to grow into a larger product leadership role over time.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Discovery**
  
  

* Identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve recruiter productivity, operational efficiency, and candidate experience.
* Work closely with Product Leadership to define and evolve the vision for Sense’s Discover roadmap. More specifically, contribute to the roadmap for:

+ Candidate Matching
+ Job Matching
+ AI Decisioning & Actions
+ AI Observability

* Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLM ecosystems, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation trends.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with enterprise customers, recruiters, implementation, customer success, sales and leadership teams to understand and document feedback, pain points and user flow inefficiencies clearly.

**Execution - Design, Development and Delivery**

* Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clearly defined user flow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria within a PRD - explaining aha! moments, self-serve features, guided onboarding, activation experience and instrumentation to track post launch activation and repeat usage metrics.
* Contribute to the implementation of intelligent orchestration capabilities across recruiting workflows and user journeys.
* Partner with user experience and design teams to ship consumer-grade, highly flexible yet scalable and delightful user experiences. Help define interaction patterns and experiences for features owned by your EPD triad across Voice, Chat, Recruiter Hub, Workflows, Sequences and other surfaces.
* Partner with engineering, platform and ML teams to deliver scalable, reliable and maintainable solutions across ingestion pipelines, document processing, feature extraction, data transformations & indexing, vector storage & embeddings, structured and low latency retrieval and amongst other product and platform capabilities.
* Ensure product, design and engineering decisions are documented, and shared with stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Drive feature prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination by maintaining a groomed / ungroomed backlog / project plan in Asana or Jira.
* Work closely with QA teams and perform hands-on UAT to ensure comprehensive test coverage and delivered features meet customer and usability expectations.
* Ensure customer reported issues are resolved under pre-defined SLA windows and are escalated proactively to the appropriate leadership to ensure timely resolution.
* Contribute towards shipping internal tools for engineering and customer support to easily track and debug issues.

**Enablement and GTM**

* Run a structured post launch program to ensure awareness, activation and adoption of key features
* Analyse past usage, revenue and churn risk signals to identify customer segments where a feature is launched and will be useful to drive targeted adoption
* Work closely with product marketing and knowledge base team to create and update the customer facing how-tos and other useful artifacts
* Create internal and customer facing announcement artifacts and adoption playbooks for customer success and implementation teams
* Run structured training sessions for new capabilities, office hours and workshops

**Product Adoption and AI Observability**
  
  

* Define, review and present adoption and AI Observability metrics to stakeholders on a bi-weekly basis

+ Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Synthesis
+ AI Quality / Reliability / Faithfulness -

- Feature extraction accuracy
- Hit Rates, Miss Rates, Relevant Results Density
- Faithfulness of AI explanation on a sample dataset

+ Indexing and Retrieval Reliability - Latency, Failure Rates, Zero Result Rates
+ Conversion Funnel Analysis

* Personally inspect AI Quality - LLM outputs, traces, retrieval results, source-ingestion failures, irrelevant results, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.
* Analyse customer reported issues via bugs and support tickets and identify improvement opportunities
* Partner with Product Analytics and Data teams to ensure timely and evolving instrumentation, derive actionable insights and identify optimization opportunities on a bi-weekly basis.

**Professional Qualifications**

* BE/B.Tech or M.B.A with at least 1-3 years of experience in product management role with deep familiarity with software development lifecycle.
* You need to be a highly analytical problem solver to succeed in this role.
* [Must Have] - You bring hands-on experience with data analysis using SQL and present your findings in a structured way. Experience with tools like Mixpanel, Heap or Amplitude is preferred.
* [Highly Preferred] Previous experience in working closely with engineering and ML on retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluations and observability. Familiarity with AI Observability tools like Arize, Braintrust etc is highly desired.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Asana or Jira.
* Proficient in English, with good written and oral communication and presentation skills
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks
* Ability to process and apply feedback constructively without ego
* Ability to “do what it takes to get the job done” - no job is small for you.

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
Zinier is searching for a deeply technical, execution-obsessed Product Lead to shape our data and AI strategy. You'll own the roadmap for how Zinier captures, structures, and activates data to power agentic, AI-driven field service products — and you'll be equally comfortable writing epics and stories with engineering as you are challenging architecture decisions on data pipelines and LLM interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on, technical PM role. You'll define what data is needed and translate it into clear requirements for the teams building our solutions, own the lifecycle of data and AI initiatives from intent recognition through execution, and partner across Platform, Data Platform, Product Engineering, Design, Security, and Legal to build a scalable, compliant, and highly intuitive solutions.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Shape the data & AI strategy: Define and execute the roadmap — plan, execute, self-correct, and learn.
* Treat data as the fuel: Define what data is needed and translate that into clear requirements for the teams building the solutions.
* Own projects end to end: Define, execute, measure, and iterate — owning the full lifecycle from initial intent recognition and planning frameworks through execution and coordination.
* Lead cross-functionally: Partner with cross functional teams like Platform , Data Platform, Product Engineering, Product Designers, Security, and Legal to build a scalable, compliant, and highly intuitive solutions.
* Write epics and stories: Translate strategy into engineering-ready epics and stories, working in Scrum with clear acceptance criteria.
* Define and own data products: Set up and define data products, including data warehouse and data lake requirements.
* Drive analytics maturity: Define how usage and outcomes are captured and analyzed, including analytics for LLM/agent interfaces.

**Must-have**
**What you'll bring to the role**

* Strong B2B experience.
* Proficiency in Scrum and Jira, with hands-on experience writing epics and stories.
* Proficient in English.
* Technical fluency — able to credibly challenge engineering teams on architecture, data models, and trade-offs.
* You have built or maintained data products.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience building AI-driven products.
* Understanding of analytics: how it's captured, and how to capture and analyze it, including LLM interfaces.
* Direct experience working with AI and Claude specifically, including having built agents.
* Experience setting up and defining data products (data warehouse, data lake).
* Scrum of Scrums experience.
* Experience working as part of a globally distributed team of Product Leads.

**Be Hungry. Be Humble. Be Honest. And Hustle.**
**Shape the data. Power the agents. Own the strategy.**

title: Cloud & Hosting - Senior Product Owner - Observability
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Product Owner, Observability owns the backlog and roadmap for the Observability platform, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Director, Modern Engineering Platform Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required**

* 5+ years in technology, years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Hands-on expertise with modern observability tooling such as Grafana and Google Cloud Observability.
* Proven observability expertise across metrics, logs and traces, telemetry pipelines, dashboards and alerting, with accountability for reliability and cost.
* Experience delivering AI-driven or automated operations on observability data (desirable).
* Experience in a pharma, regulated or comparably complex enterprise environment (desirable).

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standard ground.

**Skills**
AI Observability, API Management, Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Grafana, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Product Ownership, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Senior Product Owner – AI/ML
description:
**Syncron**
is a leading SaaS company with over 20 years of experience, specializing in aftermarket solutions. Our Service Lifecycle Management Platform offers domain-fit solutions for:
  
  
  

* Supply Chain optimization,
* Pricing strategy,
* Service Fulfillment (e.g. warranty management, field service management, service parts management, knowledge management).

We build upon the belief that our greatest strength is our People. Our unique company culture has been appreciated by our Employees.
  
  
With this we are
**winning the hearts and minds of world-leading organizations**
, such as JCB, Kubota, Electrolux, Toyota, Renault and Hitachi.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Senior Product Owner**
to drive the delivery of AI/ML-powered capabilities for Syncron's Contract Price SaaS platform. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and business stakeholders to transform customer needs into scalable product capabilities that improve pricing decisions, contract profitability, and customer outcomes.

title: Business Lead, Digital Product Management
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.

* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.

People Management & Team Development
