title: Data & AI Portfolio, Adoption & Service Excellence
description:
**Job Summary**
The Data & AI Lead is responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering AI-enabled products that improve risk and compliance processes and deliver measurable business value.
  
  
The role sits within the AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) and acts as the bridge between business, data, AI engineering, and governance teams, ensuring AI solutions are aligned to strategic priorities, deliver tangible outcomes, and are successfully adopted by business users.
  
  
In addition to product ownership, the role drives process excellence and value realisation, ensuring AI initiatives generate measurable productivity, risk reduction, and operational efficiency improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Define and maintain the Data & AI capability strategy and product roadmap for Risk & Compliance, ensuring AI initiatives are aligned to business priorities, enterprise AI direction and measurable value outcomes.
* Own the AI use case portfolio across assisted, enabled, generative and agentic automation, ensuring a coherent path from ideation to prioritisation, design, delivery, adoption, scale and retirement.
* Partner closely with respective Product Owners, Business Owners and Process Owners to review the full product and process journey, identifying where AI, data, automation and analytics can materially improve productivity, risk outcomes, user experience and decision quality.
* Lead structured opportunity discovery across products and processes to identify areas where process engineering through AI and data tools can deliver substantial qualitative and quantitative benefits, including cycle-time reduction, effort elimination, quality improvement, control uplift and improved decision support.
* Continuously challenge existing ways of working and push the boundaries of imagination with business stakeholders by bringing practical ideas on GenAI, agentic AI, workflow automation, data intelligence and reusable AI capability patterns.
* Support strategic buy, build, reuse or partner decisions for AI capabilities, ensuring investment is directed towards scalable, reusable and value-accretive solutions.
* Maintain a centralised AI backlog and product pipeline that balances business value, feasibility, risk, complexity, user adoption, delivery capacity and strategic relevance.

**Business**

* Act as the primary business-facing lead for AI capability development, building trusted relationships with Product Owners, Business Owners, SMEs and senior stakeholders to identify, shape and deliver AI-enabled business transformation.
* Work with product and business owners to assess the entire product journey, including upstream inputs, workflow steps, decision points, controls, handoffs, pain points, downstream outputs and user experience.
* Translate business challenges into clear, outcome-led AI opportunities, ensuring each use case has a defined problem statement, target user group, expected benefit, success measure and adoption pathway.
* Lead process and value analysis to determine where AI and data tools can generate measurable business impact, including productivity gains, cost avoidance, improved quality, better risk detection, reduced manual intervention and enhanced decision-making.
* Quantify expected benefits before implementation and track realised benefits after deployment, covering both quantitative measures such as time saved, volume processed, cost avoided and cycle-time reduction, and qualitative outcomes such as improved user confidence, better insights, stronger controls and improved service experience.
* Enable product and business owners to reimagine how work can be performed using AI, including GenAI assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, intelligent triage, automated summarisation, insight generation and decision-support tools.
* Ensure AI products are business-relevant, user-centred, measurable, scalable and designed to deliver sustained adoption rather than isolated experimentation.

**Processes**

* Establish and operate a structured AI product lifecycle covering intake, opportunity discovery, journey review, prioritisation, requirements definition, design, development oversight, deployment readiness, adoption, value tracking and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate end-to-end product journey and process engineering reviews with Product Owners and Business Owners to identify friction, duplication, manual effort, control gaps, rework, delays and decision bottlenecks that can be improved through AI and data-enabled solutions.
* Convert business and process opportunities into well-defined product artefacts, including product requirement documents, user journeys, process maps, feature definitions, prioritisation criteria, value hypotheses and delivery roadmaps.
* Work closely with AI engineering, data and analytics teams, GenAI prompt specialists, governance teams and business SMEs to ensure AI solutions are designed and delivered against clearly defined business outcomes.
* Oversee use case delivery from ideation through deployment, ensuring delivery progress, dependencies, risks, milestones, design decisions, readiness activities and business adoption plans are actively managed.
* Define and maintain value measurement approaches, including baseline metrics, benefit assumptions, productivity scorecards, adoption dashboards, value realisation tracking and portfolio performance reporting.
* Use feedback from users, adoption metrics, operational outcomes, process performance and governance inputs to continuously improve AI products, backlog priorities and product journey design.

**People & Talent**

* Build and own strong working relationships with Product Owners, Business Owners, Process Owners, Technology, Data, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance teams to create a shared agenda for AI-enabled transformation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business teams by helping them understand what is possible with AI, GenAI, agentic AI, data products and automation, while translating ambition into practical, deliverable and governed use cases.
* Facilitate ideation sessions, product clinics, journey walkthroughs and design workshops that encourage stakeholders to rethink how processes, controls and decisions could be redesigned using AI and data.
* Build confidence and adoption across business teams by partnering with learning, engagement and change teams to deliver training, demos, playbooks, engagement plans and user enablement activities.
* Promote a product and value-led mindset across AI delivery teams, ensuring teams remain focused on user outcomes, measurable impact, adoption, continuous improvement and responsible innovation.
* Encourage a culture of curiosity, experimentation and disciplined execution, where teams are empowered to challenge legacy processes and explore ambitious but controlled uses of AI.
* Support the development of AI fluency across business stakeholders by sharing reusable examples, emerging use cases, lessons learned and practical patterns for applying AI to real business problems.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure AI use cases are shaped and delivered in line with enterprise AI governance, responsible AI, data, risk, compliance, security and regulatory expectations.
* Work with Product Owners and Business Owners to identify risks across the full product journey, including process risks, control gaps, data risks, adoption risks, operational risks, model risks and inappropriate automation risks.
* Partner with AI Governance, Risk, Compliance and assurance teams to ensure appropriate validation, explainability, bias assessment, control requirements, monitoring inputs and approval evidence are built into product delivery.
* Ensure AI-enabled process engineering does not compromise control effectiveness, accountability, data integrity, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations or operational resilience.
* Identify and manage delivery risks, dependency risks, value realisation risks, user adoption risks and operational readiness risks across the AI portfolio, escalating material issues where required.
* Ensure AI products are implemented with appropriate human oversight, usage boundaries, business readiness, control documentation, monitoring inputs and feedback mechanisms to support sustainable and controlled use.
* Use qualitative and quantitative performance insights to identify where deployed AI products may require refinement, additional controls, retraining, user education, redesign or retirement.

**Governance**

* Maintain transparent governance over the AI product portfolio, including roadmap status, prioritisation decisions, product journey reviews, delivery progress, adoption performance, value realisation and key risks.
* Ensure each AI use case has clear ownership across Product Owner, Business Owner, delivery team and governance stakeholders, with defined accountability for business outcomes, adoption, controls and value tracking.
* Provide regular reporting to senior stakeholders and governance forums through AI portfolio dashboards, value dashboards, ROI tracking reports, adoption metrics and portfolio performance updates.
* Support governance forums with evidence-based recommendations on prioritisation, investment, scaling, remediation, redesign or retirement of AI products.
* Maintain disciplined portfolio controls so AI initiatives are traceable, measurable, outcome-led and aligned to business priorities, responsible AI expectations and enterprise governance standards.
* Ensure product journey reviews, benefit cases, design decisions, user impacts, adoption evidence and value realisation outcomes are appropriately documented and available for management review.
* Create a continuous improvement governance loop where feedback from Product Owners, Business Owners, users, delivery teams and governance stakeholders is used to refresh the roadmap, backlog, adoption approach and value strategy.

**Key Deliverables**

* AI product roadmap & portfolio backlog (including generative & agentic AI initiatives) aligned to Risk & Compliance strategic priorities.
* End-to-end process re-engineering blueprint co-created with product/business owners (leveraging generative & agentic AI) to transform key Risk & Compliance processes.
* Central AI use case intake & prioritization framework ensuring value-driven selection and disciplined stage-gate development of AI solutions.
* AI adoption strategy & integration plan (with clear adoption KPIs) to drive and measure widespread usage of new AI and data tools across Risk & Compliance teams.
* Business enablement playbook & training modules to build R&C team proficiency and trust in advanced AI tools (e.g., generative & agentic AI solutions).
* AI value measurement framework & dashboards tracking qualitative and quantitative benefits (productivity, risk reduction, ROI) delivered by deployed AI initiatives.
* AI governance compliance documentation and requisite risk & compliance approvals for each AI product, evidencing Responsible AI and regulatory adherence.
* Executive portfolio performance reports for R&C leadership highlighting AI-driven value creation, adoption progress, and future advanced AI opportunities.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key Stake Holders**

* AI Engineering Solution development
* Data & Analytics Data products and datasets
* GenAI Specialists Prompt design and context engineering
* AI Assurance Model validation and governance
* AI Operations Monitoring and lifecycle management
* Business Units AI adoption and value realisation

**Skills And Experience**

* Experience in product management, data analytics, or digital transformation
* Strong knowledge of risk, compliance, or financial services operations
* Ability to operate at the intersection of business, data, and technology
* Strong stakeholder engagement and strategic thinking capabilities

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: HRIS Product Owner (Time & Absence Mgmt)
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Workday Product Owner for a part of the Workday capabilities, with the objective of providing optimal technology support for our HR strategy, driving employee experience and improving HR efficiency and effectiveness.
  
  
In working closely with the HR function, the transformation office and external partners, the role is responsible to understand, challenge and translate Time Mgmt business requirements into effective solutions, by combining technology capabilities with smart process design, clear roles, responsibilities and data definitions. This straddles the whole life cycle, from strategy and architecture work, proactively bringing in ideas and planning out a roadmap, over focused delivery of projects, to ensuring a proper handover to production, periodic monitoring of effective usage and compliance, as well as supporting the ongoing maintenance and evolution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Translate HR business requirements into scalable and sustainable technology solutions within Workday Time Off, Leave of Absence and Time Tracking.
* Lead the analysis, design, configuration, and documentation of Workday Time Mgmt solutions, ensuring compliance with internal policies and best practices.
* Facilitate design and discovery workshops with stakeholders to define optimal solutions while considering platform capabilities, architectural standards, and long-term maintainability.
* Independently configure and maintain Workday functionality across the relevant domains, including supporting testing activities.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams and external vendors to deliver enhancements and issue resolution.
* Continuously monitor new Workday features and releases, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance HR processes and deliver additional value to the organization.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap for the respective Workday domain, prioritizing enhancements and initiatives using agile delivery methodologies.
* Establish and enforce governance and design standards to maintain the integrity, scalability, and security of the overall Workday platform, in close collaboration with other HRIS product owners.
* Enable operational excellence by supporting the creation of training materials and knowledge articles, ensuring first-level support teams are equipped to handle common inquiries and routine maintenance tasks.
* Act as the second-level functional and technical support for the assigned Workday domains, investigating complex issues and coordinating escalations with Workday or external partners when necessary.
* Manage periodic reconciliations and maintenance activities related to Time Mgmt.

Qualifications: Education, Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Information Technology, alternatively a strong background in Workday Time Off, Leave of Absence and Time Tracking
* Proven experience (> 3 years) in Workday Time Mgmt solutions; certification is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across various teams

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for leveraging technology to drive HR excellence, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in shaping the future of our HRIS landscape and making a meaningful impact on our organization's success.
  
  
Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Director of Product Management
description:
**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Director/Senior Director of Product Management to lead the strategy and execution for our DSP Platform,Connected TV (CTV) product line and new initiative . This role owns the foundations that make the DSP scalable and self-serve (campaign workflows, bidding/pacing primitives, reporting/measurement surfaces, APIs, experimentation), while also driving CTV-specific capabilities (supply integrations, deal mechanics, creative standards, measurement, brand safety, and performance).
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of engineering, data/ML, ad operations, supply partnerships, and revenue teams, translating market needs into platform bets and shipping roadmaps that improve scale, performance, reliability, and margin. The ideal candidate has deep programmatic advertising experience (especially CTV), strong platform product instincts, and a track record of building and leading high-performing PM teams.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Product Strategy & Roadmap (Platform + CTV)
  
  

* Define and communicate a 12-24 month product vision for DSP Platform and CTV aligned with company OKRs (revenue growth, margin, scale, retention).
* Own the roadmap and prioritization across platform investments and CTV-specific capabilities (supply, deals, measurement, creative, policy).
* Build business cases for major initiatives and decide build vs buy vs partner.

**Sprint Planning & Delivery Monitoring**

* Lead sprint planning and backlog grooming for Platform and CTV squads: define sprint goals, prioritize work, clarify scope, confirm capacity, and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Ensure stories are execution-ready with clear acceptance criteria, instrumentation requirements, rollout plans, and a shared Definition of Ready/Done.
* Monitor sprint delivery health using lightweight metrics (commit vs complete, velocity trends, cycle time, blocked work) and drive corrective actions (re-prioritization, scope management, escalation of blockers).
* Facilitate sprint reviews and retrospectives to improve predictability, quality, and team health; convert learnings into backlog actions and process improvements.

DSP Platform Ownership (Foundational Capabilities)

title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
  
  
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
  
  
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
  
  
What you’ll work on
  
  
Depending on the week, you might:
  
  
  

* Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
* Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
* Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
* Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
* Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
* Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
* Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
* Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly

Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
  

* You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief
* You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it
* You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters
* You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective
* You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working
* You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving
* You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow

We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
  
  
What you get
  
  
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
  
  
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
  
  
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
  
  
Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.
  
  
**About Team & Role**
Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.
  
  
Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.
  
  
As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.
  
  
The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.
  
  
Further the role will be responsible for
  
  

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description**
Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.
  
  
You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.
  
  
You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.
  
  
You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
  
  
**About You**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Senior Category Manager
description:
**About AppsForBharat**

At AppsForBharat, we are building Sri Mandir, a platform that helps millions of devotees connect with their faith through technology. Our vision is to make religious and spiritual experiences more accessible by combining deep cultural understanding with innovative digital experiences.

We are looking for a
**Senior Category Manager–South Business**
to build and scale our South-focused puja business. This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who can own business outcomes end-to-end, make sharp commercial decisions, and build a differentiated category by understanding customer needs, rituals, product assortment, and pricing.

**The Role**

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the South business P&L and drive its growth by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business & P&L Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end P&L for the South business, driving revenue growth, profitability, and sustainable business performance.
* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and drive repeat purchases.
* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to improve outcomes.

**2. Category Strategy & Catalog Development**

* Build and scale a differentiated South-focused puja catalog based on regional customer needs, rituals, and preferences.
* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals, and everyday devotional needs.
* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.
* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational readiness before launching new offerings.
* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and emerging opportunities.

**3. Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve conversion.
* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional effectiveness.
* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per order.

**4. Growth & App Order Expansion**

* Drive growth in South business orders through relevant category initiatives and customer-focused offerings.
* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and customer journeys.
* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and repeat engagement.
* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and prioritise high-impact initiatives.

**5. Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights**

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals, regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.
* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles, campaigns, and launch plans.
* Develop a deep understanding of South Indian devotional practices and differences in customer preferences across regions.
* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve the category proposition.

**6. Cross-functional Execution**

* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns, product communication, and festival-led initiatives.
* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution of category launches and business initiatives.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.
* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a fast-paced environment.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Category management experience:**
  Experience managing a category or business with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.
* **Strong commercial acumen:**
  Ability to make sound decisions on pricing, assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:**
  Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.
* **Analytical thinking:**
  Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and convert insights into actionable growth plans.
* **Customer-centricity:**
  Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to build offerings around customer needs.
* **Execution excellence:**
  Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* **Learning agility:**
  Curiosity to understand South Indian rituals, regional nuances, and devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other consumer internet businesses.
* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.
* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising, and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with South Indian markets, regional consumer behaviour, or devotional categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Why Join Us?**

* Own and build a business with direct accountability for P&L and growth.
* Work at the intersection of consumer internet, commerce, and India's rich devotional ecosystem.
* Build differentiated offerings for a large and diverse customer base.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams and influence business strategy.
* Take on an entrepreneurial role with the opportunity to create meaningful, measurable impact.

title: Manager - AI GTM and Market Intelligence
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Most GTM teams wait for demand to declare itself. This role builds the systems that find it first. As Manager — AI GTM and Market Intelligence, you will own the engine that identifies high-fit D2C merchants before they raise a hand, the internal tools Marketing and Sales rely on daily to see what our spend is actually producing, and the proprietary data stories that establish GoKwik’s authority in the market. This is a builder’s role rather than an analyst’s: the output is working software and published research other teams depend on, not reports. You will use AI as your primary build leverage, partner closely with Demand Generation, Sales, Brand and PR, and own each system end to end — from the idea to the thing running in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* AI Outbound & Signal Pipeline - Own GoKwik’s outbound motion end to end: build the ICP from proprietary merchant data and third-party market sources, detect intent signals such as checkout migrations, funding rounds and founder activity, and convert them into AI-personalised outreach that reaches high-fit D2C brands before they enter the market.
* Marketing Intelligence Platform - Own the internal tools Marketing, Sales and CS run on: the funnel from lead to go-live, ad spend joined to closed deals for true cost-per-outcome, competitive share of voice, and self-serve AI reporting that removes the dependency on manual data pulls. Each tool ships with a user guide and must be actively used by the team it was built for.
* Data-Led Thought Leadership - Turn GoKwik’s proprietary transaction data into publishable industry research no competitor can replicate. Own the data and the narrative from first principles to final draft, in partnership with Brand and PR.
* Attribution & Funnel Integrity - Own how marketing performance is measured: canonical definitions for lead, MQL, SQL and go-live, campaign taxonomy and UTM governance, and distinct attribution for outbound and signal-sourced pipeline in Salesforce. Hold these definitions steady across Marketing, Sales and Finance when numbers are contested.
* Automation & Reliability - Run these systems as production software, not side projects. Own the scheduled jobs, monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy, and design alerts that stay quiet until something genuinely needs attention.
* Enablement & Documentation - Build for handover from day one. Every tool, dashboard and automated workflow carries written documentation, a named owner and a walkthrough session, so no system depends on one person’s context to keep running.

**Who You Are**

* 4–6 years of experience across growth, demand generation, marketing analytics, revenue operations or product, with a track record of building tools rather than only reporting on them.
* Demonstrable experience building working internal tools, automations or data products using AI as the primary build leverage. You should be able to walk us through something you shipped that other people depended on, and what broke along the way.
* Strong SQL and comfort interrogating a number to its source before it is acted on. Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and with a data warehouse.
* Commercial fluency in D2C, eCommerce, payments or B2B SaaS go-to-market. You understand what a lead, an MQL and a go-live mean, and why the definitions get argued about.
* Proven experience running outbound or lifecycle campaigns, including prospect research, segmentation, sequencing and reply handling.
* Excellent written communication. A large part of this role is explaining a number to a senior stakeholder who will act on it, and writing research that stands up to external scrutiny.
* Comfortable owning systems in production: when a scheduled job fails, you investigate rather than escalate.
* Hands-on experience with ad platforms and campaign measurement across Google, Meta or emerging AI ad surfaces is a strong plus.
* A computer science degree or a background as a software engineer is not required. What matters is the judgment to know what is worth building and the ability to direct AI tooling to build it correctly.

**Why GoKwik**
At GoKwik, you work at the intersection of go-to-market, product and data. This role sits on a foundation that already exists: a live platform of internal GTM products, an outbound engine with a scored universe of more than 16,000 D2C brands, and first-party transaction data across 15,000+ merchants that no competitor can replicate. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are not inheriting a backlog of requests — you are taking custody of systems people already use and deciding where they go next.
  
  
You get unusual autonomy and unusually direct exposure: the freedom to choose what gets built, a short line to senior stakeholders, and work that is visible externally through published research as well as internally through the tools leadership reviews. For someone who wants to build rather than brief, in a performance-driven team with real ownership from week one, there are few roles in Indian eCommerce with this much surface area.
  
  
**Required Skills**
AI stakeholder management Problem-solving marketing automation analytics Business growth

title: People Technology Product Manager
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Enterprise Technology Team**

The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire-to-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.

**The Opportunity**

Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth & Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams. You will translate strategic product visions into high-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning & Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI-driven automation.

**What You'll Do**

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership:**
  Define the multi-year product vision and strategy for the Growth & Talent domain in close collaboration with functional and technical leadership. Translate that strategy into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap that articulates clear business value, return on investment (ROI), and measurable impact on talent operations and employee experience.
* **Talent Ecosystem Modernization:**
  Build data-driven business cases and functional strategies for major platform initiatives across the talent ecosystem (e.g., ATS, LMS, and custom Workday Extend applications), articulating clear ROI, operational efficiency gains, and improved employee and candidate experiences.
* **Delivery Lead Partnership:**
  Partner closely with the Growth & Talent Delivery Lead to translate business priorities and functional requirements into well-scoped epics and user stories, while maintaining clear alignment on trade-offs, velocity, and delivery milestones.
* **Functional & Technical Alignment:**
  Act as the voice of the business and end users within technical discussions, translating complex functional requirements into clear product specifications and acceptance criteria. Partner with the delivery team to evaluate technical trade-offs, balancing user experience, operational risk, and long-term scalability.
* **AI & Talent Automation Strategy:**
  Define the strategy and functional requirements for integrating AI across the talent lifecycle (sourcing, onboarding, learning, internal mobility)—evaluating build vs. buy solutions, designing human-in-the-loop workflows, and ensuring enterprise-grade privacy and ethical AI standards.
* **Global Stakeholder Management:**
  Drive cross-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

**What You Bring to Okta**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.
* **Deep Talent Tech Domain Expertise:**
  In-depth understanding of core Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, and Performance/Talent Management processes, with hands-on familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Greenhouse, Cornerstone, and Workday Talent (or equivalent ATS/LMS/HCM ecosystems).
* **Strategic Business Case & ROI Sizing:**
  Proven ability to translate long-term business goals into multi-year product strategies, build data-backed investment cases, and measure the tangible ROI and operational impact of platform initiatives.
* **Technical Fluency & Cross-Functional Translation:**
  Demonstrated track record partnering with delivery teams on system integrations, data flows, and technical trade-offs—translating complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and PRDs.
* **AI & Automation Acumen:**
  Functional understanding of enterprise AI applications, generative AI capabilities, and automated workflows, with an appreciation for human-in-the-loop design, ethical AI, and data privacy safeguards.
* **Autonomous Global Leadership:**
  Proven success operating with high autonomy across distributed time zones (US / APAC / EMEA), driving alignment and influencing senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams asynchronously.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience scoping and delivering solutions on enterprise platform extensibility frameworks (e.g., Workday Extend, orchestration engines, or custom application ecosystems).
* Direct experience conceptualizing, testing, or deploying agentic AI workflows, conversational interfaces, or autonomous task automation in an enterprise HR context.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance, compliance standards (SOX, SOC2, GDPR), and sensitive employee data handling.

title: Product Owner
description:
Client Engagement & Relationship Management

* Act as the main mobile product point of contact for one or more airline clients throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with client product, commercial, digital, and operations stakeholders.
* Run discovery workshops to understand each airline's mobile experience objectives, passenger journey goals, and operational constraints.
* Manage client expectations on mobile app scope, timelines, and trade-offs; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly.

Requirements & Mobile Backlog Ownership

* Capture, analyze, and translate client requirements into clear mobile app user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Own and prioritize the client-specific mobile product backlog, balancing client requests against platform capabilities and the broader mobile roadmap.
* Distinguish between standard/configurable mobile features and custom development, advising clients on the most efficient path.
* Make data-informed trade-off decisions and negotiate mobile feature priorities with clients when demand exceeds capacity.

Mobile Solution Delivery & Configuration

* Guide clients through configuration of core mobile app capabilities: flight search & booking, check-in, boarding passes, seat selection, baggage, flight status, push notifications, and disruption handling.
* Oversee branding, localization, and client-specific business rules within the mobile application.
* Coordinate integration of the mobile app with the airline's systems (PSS/GDS, loyalty, payment gateways, operational data feeds).
* Support ancillary and loyalty feature enablement on mobile to drive client revenue.

Cross-Functional Coordination (Internal)

* Bridge client needs and internal Agile mobile delivery teams; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and mobile app demos.
* Collaborate with mobile UX/UI, engineering, QA, and delivery/project managers to ensure committed features are delivered to quality.
* Channel recurring or high-value client requests into the core mobile product roadmap as candidate platform features.

Mobile Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement

* Define mobile success metrics with each client (app adoption, conversion, ancillary attach rate, NPS/CSAT, app store rating).
* Use mobile analytics and client feedback to recommend enhancements and demonstrate value realization.
* Conduct post-release reviews and mobile roadmap planning sessions with clients.

Governance, Compliance & Quality

* Ensure delivered mobile solutions meet aviation regulations, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy (GDPR/PCI-DSS), and app store guidelines.
* Maintain clear documentation of mobile app client commitments, decisions, and configuration choices.

In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights. * Partner with Product Managers, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to gather requirements and identify opportunities to improve adoption, customer health, and value realization.
* Define and evolve adoption frameworks, telemetry requirements, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
* Build AI-powered actionable insights that help Customer Success and Account teams proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify new opportunities and drive prioritization.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and enablement across Product, Customer Success, Field, and Corporate Strategy organizations.

* 7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management. Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products is highly desirable.

* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and business stakeholders.

****Job Description:****
TECHNICAL PRODUCT OWNER
  
  
**Experience:**
4–6 Years | Role Type: Technical Product Ownership
  
  
****Job Summary****

* We are looking for a highly motivated Technical Product Owner with 4–6 years of experience in Agile product development and enterprise software delivery.
* The ideal candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, and customers to translate business needs into well-defined technical solutions.
* This role requires a strong understanding of Java-based backend services, cloud-native architectures on AWS, APIs, microservices, and system integrations.
* The Technical Product Owner will serve as the bridge between business requirements and technical implementation, ensuring that business features are decomposed into actionable technical features and user stories with sufficient service-level and component-level detail for efficient development and delivery.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Define and communicate the product vision, goals, roadmap, and desired business outcomes.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring prioritization aligns with business objectives, architectural direction, delivery capacity, and technical dependencies.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, functional, technical, and non-functional requirements.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate business capabilities into technical features and implementation-ready user stories.
* Decompose business features into technical features, enablers, backend services, integrations and platform capabilities.
* Create user stories that include business context, high-level service and component details, affected systems, component interactions, integration points, dependencies, API or event requirements, data considerations, and acceptance criteria.
* Understand and document backend service interactions, data flows, interface contracts, upstream and downstream dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to understand solution approaches for Java and Spring Boot microservices deployed on AWS.
* Collaborate with architects and developers to understand service contracts, REST API requirements, event-driven workflows, and integration patterns.
* Ensure user stories capture relevant non-functional expectations, including security, performance, scalability, availability, observability, error handling, resiliency, and supportability.
* Facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical teams to resolve functional and technical ambiguities.
* Evaluate technical trade-offs, implementation risks, dependencies, and sequencing considerations during backlog prioritization and release planning.
* Lead or actively participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, architecture discussions, and release planning.
* Ensure stories meet the Definition of Ready and provide timely clarifications throughout the sprint.
* Validate completed work against functional and technical acceptance criteria and approve user stories.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, product demonstrations, release readiness, and product launches.
* Monitor product performance, operational feedback, adoption, and business impact to drive continuous improvement.

* Promote Agile best practices, engineering collaboration, and customer-centric product development.

* Technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, risks, and sequencing requirements.
* Clear functional and technical acceptance criteria that enable development, testing, and validation.

**Product Ownership**

**About PhonePe**
PhonePe is India’s leading digital payments platform with over 400 million registered users. Using PhonePe, users can send and receive money, recharge mobile, DTH, data cards, pay at stores, make utility payments, buy gold, and make investments. PhonePe went live for customers in August 2016 and was the first non-banking UPI app and offered money transfer to individuals and merchants, recharges and bill payments to begin with. In 2017, PhonePe forayed into financial services with the launch of digital gold, providing users with a safe and convenient option to buy 24-karat gold securely on its platform. PhonePe has since launched Mutual Funds and Insurance products like tax-saving funds, liquid funds, international travel insurance, Corona Care, a dedicated insurance product for the COVID-19 pandemic among others.

PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Product Manager at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our platform and user centric products. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  
**As a Senior Product Manager, you will:**

* Identify large problem statements and break it down into platform level component designs.
* Scope and phase product building meaningfully over and above standard use cases.
* Translate pod and product strategy into a crisp, annual roadmap and define measurable objectives of a suite of products

* Be the thought leader for the product suite and evangelize goals and objectives. Drive alignment across stakeholders by effectively engaging them with data.
* Participate in interviews for PM, APM roles and provide inputs for resource planning across functions.

**What we look for:**

* Atleast 5+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development
* Analytical and data driven with the ability to to derive action and make decisions based on large data sets.
* Good with scalable data modeling and abstractions on platform design. Can think over and above traditional use cases.
* Come with a strong point of view on all aspects of the business and balance between a data backed view and ambiguity.
* Is able to own output metrics and impact while balancing priorities across pods.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Risk

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.
  
  
You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.
  
  
**What You Will Accomplish**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. Experience working with design research and qualitative tools to ensure the voice of our seller is at the center of our product development
* Strong, concise communicator and effective story-teller; experience using both analytics and qualitative research to express the vision and strategy of the product
* Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering or Business management.

title: Product Owner – Cloud & Compute
description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more
  
  
  
  
**About The Function**
Digital & Technology (D&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.
  
  
This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.
  
  
You’ll be part of a team that’s constantly learning, experimenting and pushing boundaries, with the freedom to explore new ideas and the support to turn them into reality.
  
  
**About The role**
The role requires a combination of technical leadership, architecture, hands-on engineering, operational excellence, security, automation, and stakeholder management. The candidate will be responsible for driving cloud transformation initiatives, improving infrastructure reliability and scalability, and mentoring cloud and infrastructure engineering teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud & Compute Leadership
  
  

* Lead the architecture, deployment, and management of enterprise-scale cloud and compute environments.
* Manage cloud compute services, virtual machines, containers, storage, networking, and associated infrastructure.
* Drive cloud migration, modernization, and transformation initiatives across applications and infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, performance, and resilience of cloud platforms.
* Establish cloud governance, standards, best practices, and operational processes.
* Manage and optimize enterprise on-premises and hybrid compute environments, including physical and virtual server infrastructure.
* Lead and manage server and virtualization platforms including VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix, and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI).

Cloud Architecture & Engineering
  
  

* Design secure, scalable, highly available, and cost-effective cloud solutions.
* Evaluate and implement cloud services across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives, including virtualization, containerization, and cloud-native technologies.
* Review technical designs and provide architectural guidance to engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Automation & DevOps
  
  

* Drive infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform.
* Implement and improve CI/CD processes for infrastructure and application deployments.
* Promote automation for provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, patching, and operational tasks.
* Work closely with DevOps, SRE, application, and security teams to improve deployment and operational processes.
* Support container and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Infrastructure Operations
  
  

* Provide technical leadership for cloud infrastructure operations and production environments.
* Establish and monitor SLAs, SLOs, availability, capacity, and performance metrics.
* Lead incident, problem, and change management for critical cloud infrastructure.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and high-availability strategies and responsible to execute Annual DR activities.
* Ensure infrastructure lifecycle management, patching, vulnerability management, upgrades, and capacity planning.
* Manage enterprise cloud and on-premises Windows/Linux server environments.
* Manage enterprise virtualization environments across VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix/AHV, and Azure Local.
* Manage enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure using Azure and Commvault
* Experience with SCOM and enterprise infrastructure monitoring, including health, availability, and performance monitoring.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Partner with security teams to implement cloud security controls and best practices.
* Ensure appropriate identity and access management, encryption, network security, and security monitoring.
* Support compliance requirements and cloud security assessments.
* Implement least-privilege access and secure configuration standards.
* Identify and mitigate infrastructure and cloud security risks.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Lead and mentor cloud, compute, infrastructure, and platform engineering teams.
* Provide technical direction and support career development of team members.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, application teams, cybersecurity, DevOps, and business stakeholders.
* Manage technical vendors, cloud service providers, and strategic partners.
* Present architecture, infrastructure strategy, risks, and transformation plans to senior leadership.
* Drive technical decisions and ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* Point of contact for OEM / internal teams and ensure for on time renewals of contracts

  
  
**Experience/skills required:**
  
  

* Minimum 10 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud computing, compute platforms, or related technologies.
* Strong hands-on and architectural experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Strong knowledge of cloud compute services such as EC2, Azure Virtual Machines, GCE, autoscaling, load balancing, and serverless technologies.
* Strong understanding of Cloud architecture and design, Virtualization, Compute and storage, High availability and disaster recovery, Monitoring and observability, Cloud security
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Strong knowledge of Linux and/or Windows server administration.
* Experience with DevOps tools and CI/CD platforms.
* Experience with scripting/automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Experience implementing cloud migration and modernization programs.
* Strong understanding of cloud governance, security, compliance, and cost optimization.
* Experience leading technical teams and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Strong experience with enterprise on-premises server and virtualization technologies, including VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix/AHV, and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI).
* Experience with enterprise backup and data protection platforms, preferably Commvault, including backup, recovery, retention, capacity management, and disaster recovery.
* Provide governance and oversight of enterprise infrastructure monitoring using SCOM and other monitoring platforms.
* ITIL Certification and Cloud Certification would be added advantage

  
  
**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
  
  
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Warning***
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
**About the Role**

Delhivery moves millions of shipments a day across one of the most complex physical networks: pickups, line-haul, sorting, last-mile, returns, and cross-border. Every one of those steps generates data, decisions, and money on the table. We believe the next decade of logistics will be won by whoever applies AI most intelligently to the physical world.

We are building a team of Product Managers who will reimagine logistics with an Agentic first approach. You won't be bolting a chatbot on a dashboard. You will own problems where a better model or a smarter agent changes unit economics, customer experience, or network reliability at national scale.

.
**What You’ll Do**

* **Find the right problems.**
  Spend time in hubs, with riders, ops leaders, and merchants. Translate messy operational pain into opportunities for creating a seamless flow that scales.
* **Own outcomes, not outputs.**
  Define success metrics tied to cost per shipment, delivery success, NPS, or revenue, and be accountable for moving them.
* **Ship AI products that real operators use.**
  Design human-in-the-loop workflows, fallbacks, and feedback loops so models earn trust on the ground and keep improving after launch.
* **Drive adoption across the org.**
  Work with Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to embed AI into how teams actually work.
* **Partner deeply with data science and engineering.**
  Shape problem formulation, data requirements, evaluation methodology, and model-versus-rules trade-offs. Understand precision/recall, drift, latency, and cost well enough to challenge and be challenged.
* **Run rigorous experimentation.**
  A/B tests, shadow deployments, and phased rollouts across geographies and hubs, with clear go/no-go criteria.
* **Stay at the frontier.**
  Evaluate new LLM, agentic, and vision capabilities, and decide pragmatically what to build, buy, or fine-tune.

**The kind of problems you could own**

* **Network intelligence:**
  demand forecasting, capacity planning, dynamic routing, and ETA prediction across the network
* **Last-mile optimization:**
  address intelligence and geocoding, delivery-attempt prediction, route and slot optimization, rider productivity
* **Computer vision on the ground:**
  shipment damage detection, automated weighing and dimensioning, sort-center throughput, proof-of-delivery verification
* **Generative AI and agents:**
  autonomous customer support, ops copilots for hub managers, document and invoice automation, internal knowledge assistants
* **Risk and trust:**
  fraud, RTO (return-to-origin) prediction, NDR resolution, and merchant risk scoring
* **Pricing and commercial intelligence:**
  dynamic pricing, serviceability, and yield optimization

You will be matched to problem statements based on impact, your strengths, and the stage of each problem. Expect to work across more than one.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Experience**

* 2–5 years in product management, ideally with at least 1–2 years shipping ML or AI-driven products (or a strong data science, ML engineering, or analytics background that you have transitioned into product)
* A track record of taking a product from ambiguous problem to measurable business impact
* Strong academic grounding; engineering degree from a top-tier institution preferred, MBA a plus but not required

**Skills**

* Working fluency in ML concepts: model evaluation, training data quality, feedback loops, and the practical differences between classical ML, deep learning, and LLM-based systems
* Hands-on comfort with data: SQL is a must, Python or notebooks a plus. You pull your own numbers.
* Experience with, or sharp point of view on, GenAI product design: prompt and eval design, RAG, agents, guardrails, and cost/latency trade-offs
* Excellent structured thinking and the ability to communicate with engineers, data scientists, and frontline ops leaders equally well
* Bias to action, ownership, and comfort operating in complex, high-volume, real-world environments

**Pedigree signals we value**

* Prior experience at product-led or AI-forward companies (marketplaces, e-commerce, mobility, fintech, SaaS, or AI-native startups)
* Evidence of impact: shipped models or AI features with quantifiable results, side projects, or published work
* Curiosity about the physical world: supply chains, operations, and hardware-meets-software problems
