title: Senior Staff Product Manager – Developer Platform Enablement
description:
**Overview**
Join the Intuit Platform and Development Xcceleration group as a Senior Staff Product Manager. The PDX group builds the foundational capabilities that developers across Intuit rely on to build and run flagship applications on cloud native infrastructure at scale. Intuit believes in open source, both as a consumer and a contributor, and our engineers participate actively in communities including CNCF, Istio, and Argo.
  
  
We're looking for a product leader who can own two connected platform domains: the systems that provision and run Intuit's cloud infrastructure, and the systems that make Intuit's APIs and services usable by AI agents, not just human developers. You'll set direction for how infrastructure gets provisioned against policy, and for how AI agents discover, integrate with, and operate Intuit's internal services with less and less human intervention over time.
  
  
This role carries senior staff scope. You'll set product strategy independently, make tradeoffs other teams will build against, and represent these platforms directly to engineering and executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's infrastructure orchestration and provisioning platform, working closely with the engineering teams who build and operate it.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's agent-readiness platform, which evaluates how usable Intuit's internal APIs and services are for AI agents and drives the work that closes the gaps.
* Define the metrics that matter for each platform, from infrastructure reliability and provisioning speed to how much manual work it still takes before an agent can operate a given capability end to end, and use those metrics to prioritize the roadmap.
* Partner with the teams that define platform policy, identity, access, lifecycle rules, so that what you build upholds that policy rather than duplicating or drifting from it.
* Work with capability teams across Intuit to help them raise their agent-readiness scores, generate the integration assets they're missing, and turn what used to be manual, tribal-knowledge work into something an agent or a new engineer can follow directly.
* Represent both platforms to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, with a clear narrative tying platform investment to developer productivity and to Intuit's broader AI strategy.
* Build and run a scrum team based in India, setting the cadence, backlog discipline, and quality bar that let a distributed team ship independently.

**Qualifications**

* 10 or more years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools products.
* Direct experience with AI-enabled products or platforms, with a strong enough technical foundation to work through integration and architecture tradeoffs with engineering.
* Strong experience with AI Evals, model evaluations, technical use cases, shared platform capabilities, driving adoption and growth of platform capabilities, and leveraging AI to assess technical capabilities, and agentic PDLC.
* A track record of owning a product end to end: setting strategy, defining success metrics, and driving a roadmap that a distributed engineering team executes against.
* Comfort partnering across adjacent platform teams where ownership boundaries matter, and judgment about when to defer to another team's policy versus when to push back.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and executives.
* Experience managing or closely partnering with engineering teams based in India strongly preferred.
* Undergraduate degree in computer science or a related technical discipline required. Equivalent professional experience will be considered. Advanced degree or MBA preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Why Join Product at Supernova?

There are very few companies in India where Product Managers get to build and monetise consumer AI products at scale. Supernova is India’s largest consumer AI startup.

Our AI products have been used by 2 crore+ people and generate approximately $17 million in ARR. Over the past three years, we have developed deep expertise in understanding AI users, building AI-native experiences, working with models, prompts, harnesses, agents, evals, and rapidly iterating our way to products people pay for.

If you want to build your career as an AI Product Manager, develop genuine authority in consumer AI, and experience one of the steepest learning curves available in AI Product today, there may be no better place to do it.

About Supernova

Supernova is India's largest consumer AI startup - building AI products that help the world communicate.

Our products have reached 2 crore+ users, and the business has grown to approximately $17 million in ARR.

We currently build two products on a shared communication-AI platform:

Supernova, an AI communication coach and daily English copilot that helps people learn, practise, translate, understand, and communicate confidently.

Superflow, an AI communication utility that helps people express themselves faster and more effectively.

We started with English learning as our wedge. Our larger ambition is to build a category-defining communication AI company.

What You’ll Do

Role is at the intersection of AI, Design, Engineering, Data & product → So if you are a generalist problem solver, you will thrive.

You’ll build AI products & systems that interact with real customers at scale

Your work will include:

Experimenting with different models, prompts, context, and system configurations to determine what produces the best user experience.

Creating evals that measure whether an AI system is genuinely improving—not merely producing outputs that look good in a few hand-picked examples.

Running hundreds of A/B tests across prompts, models, product flows, and AI behaviours.

Defining and tracking the user and business metrics associated with these systems, including quality, engagement, conversion, retention, latency, and cost.

Studying real customer interactions to identify failure modes, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve the product.

Building systematic feedback loops between user behaviour, evaluation results, and product changes.

Working with engineering and data teams on model selection, fine-tuning, datasets, guardrails, and production performance.

Balancing output quality with speed, reliability, cost, and the constraints of serving millions of users.

Developing a point of view about when better prompting is sufficient, when the product experience needs to change, and when fine-tuning or deeper model work is justified.

The job is not simply to “write prompts.” You’ll treat an AI system as a product and an engineering system: understand the user, define what good looks like, measure it rigorously, and improve it through continuous experimentation.

What We’re Looking For

1+ years in Product, Growth, Analytics, Growth Marketing, or an early-stage company, with evidence that you have owned and shipped measurable outcomes.

Strong product and user judgement. AI products rarely have one objectively correct output—you can recognise what feels helpful, natural, accurate, and trustworthy for the user.

Analytical and engineering thinking. You can break AI quality into measurable dimensions, design evals, investigate failure modes, compare model behaviour, and optimise systems methodically. PMs here need to be technically fluent.

Independence with data. You know which questions to ask, can retrieve and analyse the data yourself, and don’t depend on a data analyst for every answer.

First-principles problem-solving. You don’t blindly copy existing playbooks; you break ambiguous problems down, find the root cause, and develop your own point of view.

A builder’s mindset. You take a problem from uncertainty to hypothesis to shipped product—and remain accountable for what happens afterward.

Comfort with speed and experimentation. You would rather run a credible test and learn than spend weeks trying to perfect a plan.

Technical fluency. You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working closely with models, prompts, evals, datasets, and engineering systems.

Clear communication and high ownership. You can bring people along, disagree directly, and keep work moving without continuous supervision.

Good to Have

Very fluent using AI tools in your own workflow to move faster - Very important

Hands-on experience shipping AI / LLM-powered features.

Strong engineering pedigree — IIT/IIM/top-tier institute background is a plus,

Experience at a consumer app, consumer AI, or high-growth product company.

How Product works here

Product at Supernova is not a coordination function.

PMs are expected to understand users, get into the data themselves, develop original points of view, and work closely with design and engineering until something meaningful ships.

We operate with a few strong principles:

Move fast break things

Experimentation beats prolonged debate. We’ve run 2000 ABs in last 2 years

Direct ownership of important product and growth metrics.

Millions of users—and enough scale to know whether your ideas actually work.

A flat environment where scope expands quickly when you demonstrate good judgement.

Competitive Salary and meaningful ESOPs.

You will collaborate with global stakeholders, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure delivery of high-quality, compliant, and cost-effective solutions.

As a Product Owner for Body Control Modules, you will lead the end-to-end development and series support of automotive electronic components, ensuring alignment with vehicle programs, legal regulations, quality standards, and production requirements. You will act as the key interface between OEM teams, suppliers, and engineering partners while driving technical excellence throughout the product lifecycle.

* Lead development and series support activities for Body Control Modules and related E/E components.
* Define, maintain, and update component requirements, including functional safety requirements and system specifications.
* Manage project schedules, component releases, and software versions in alignment with vehicle development milestones.
* Coordinate with purchasing, logistics, quality, and supplier teams to ensure timely delivery and compliance.
* Drive budget planning and tracking for prototype and sample deliveries.
* Collaborate with E/E system partners for seamless integration of subsystem functionalities.
* Ensure documentation and traceability of development activities within engineering systems.
* Participate in concept reviews, design reviews, prototype testing, and vehicle integration activities.
* Coordinate EMC validation, power management assessments, and system compatibility evaluations.
* Lead supplier management activities including requirement exchange, development tracking, change management, FMEA reviews, and defect management.
* Monitor supplier test activities and coordinate Daimler/Mercedes-Benz component validation programs.
* Drive issue resolution and manage ECU defect tracking throughout the development cycle.
* Support hardware and software release activities in accordance with product release processes.
* Coordinate ECU diagnostics, coding, commissioning, and production readiness activities.
* Manage prototype samples, HIL setups, vehicle validation assets, and logistics planning.
* Support creation and release of testing and commissioning regulations for vehicle programs.
* Present technical status, risks, and project updates to stakeholders and vehicle program committees.

**Your Profile**

* Strong experience in Automotive Electronics domain with focus on ECU development and integration with 6-15 Years of Experience.
* Extensive experience working on Body Controllers, BCMs, Engine ECUs, Transmission ECUs, ABS/ESP, Airbag, or other high-complexity automotive control units.
* Sound understanding of vehicle electrical/electronic architectures and body electronics systems.
* Hands-on experience in ECU validation, functional testing, diagnostics, and system integration.
* Strong understanding of Functional Safety concepts and ISO 26262.
* Experience with requirement management tools such as DOORS.
* Knowledge of supplier development processes and OEM-Tier1 collaboration models.
* Familiarity with HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop), Vehicle Testing, and ECU verification environments.

* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with global and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to mentor and guide junior team members.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.

**Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech (Full-Time) in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or related disciplines.
* Good understanding of Automotive Body Electronics, Safety Systems, and Electronic Control Units (ECUs).
* Experience in system testing using HIL setups, simulation platforms, and test vehicles.
* Strong knowledge of Automotive V-Model development lifecycle.
* Exposure to supplier management and product release processes within automotive programs.

* Exposure to global OEM development programs and advanced vehicle architectures.

* Continuous learning and growth in automotive software, systems engineering, and functional safety.

title: FinTech Solutions Lead
description:
360Labs is among Asia's fastest growing AI companies. We build AI agents, enterprise software and products for clients across government, defence, healthcare, fintech and beyond, and we ship fast: working prototypes in days, production systems in weeks. We're looking for an engineer who can take an idea and ship it as a working product, covering data, model, backend, frontend and deployment.

**What you'll do**

* **Own our fintech products.**
  Set the vision and roadmap for the AI products we build for banks, investment managers and other financial institutions. Decide what we build, what we don’t and why.
* **Know the client’s world.**
  Work alongside clients in retail banking, investment banking and asset management as part of their team, not a vendor. Learn how their desks, operations and risk teams really work, and find where AI can make a measurable difference.
* **Stay hands-on.**
  Prototype in code, dig into the data, review model outputs and work side by side with our engineers to get products shipped. You’ll lead from the codebase, not a slide deck.
* **Translate between finance and engineering.**
  Turn client needs into precise technical requirements. Explain what our systems can and can’t do in terms a portfolio manager or chief risk officer will trust.
* **Set the bar for rigour.**
  Define how we measure success. Design the evaluations, backtests and benchmarks that prove our products are accurate, robust and explainable enough for a regulated industry.
* **Build for regulation.**
  Bring compliance, model risk and data security into product decisions from day one. Work closely with our CLO so that everything we ship meets the standards financial institutions expect.

**About you**

* You have 5+ years of experience across software engineering, quantitative research or product roles.
* You are a strong engineer. You write clean, production-quality code, ideally in Python, and you have built real systems with machine learning or large language models.
* You have worked at a leading financial institution, such as a retail or investment bank, a hedge fund, a trading firm or an investment manager. You understand how these firms make decisions, manage risk and buy technology.
* You think like a product leader. You can take an ambiguous problem, work out what matters most and lead a team to a product that works.
* You are as credible with a head of trading as you are with a machine learning engineer. You write clearly and explain complex ideas simply.
* You are rigorous. You test your assumptions, follow the evidence and know the difference between an impressive demo and a product a bank can rely on.
* You are happy working with autonomy in a small, fast-moving remote team, and confident asking questions when you need more context.

**We especially want to hear from you if you have**

* Experience as a quant, quant developer or quantitative researcher at a hedge fund, trading firm or investment bank.
* A track record of taking AI or machine learning systems into production in a regulated environment.
* A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics.

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can’t wait to hear from you.

title: Product Manager, Payroll Integrations
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Product Manager to lead the Payroll Integrations team, which transforms complex payroll activity into accurate accounting data customers can trust. In this role, you’ll define and build the next generation of accounting automations, using AI to build products that generate journal entries, sync payroll data to ERPs, catch errors before they reach the ledger, and help finance teams resolve issues and close their books faster.
  
  
You’ll own an end-to-end product surface with a dedicated engineering team, building for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers while partnering closely with customer-facing teams to translate messy payroll and finance workflows into scalable product experiences.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Set the vision and roadmap for Payroll Integrations, a product area that helps customers turn payroll into accurate financial data they can trust.
* Own the full product experience, from helping customers get set up quickly to making sure data flows reliably into the systems their finance teams depend on.
* Bring AI into real customer workflows so finance teams can catch issues earlier, recover faster, and spend less time on manual follow-up.
* Partner with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to turn messy operational problems into simple, scalable products.
* Build for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex payroll customers, then generalize those learnings into products that can serve thousands more.
* Make thoughtful prioritization calls across customer commitments, platform reliability, and strategic AI investments

**What You Will Need**

* 4+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to payroll, accounting, finance systems, integrations, data platforms, or B2B SaaS workflows.
* Systems thinking: you can understand messy real-world workflows, model the underlying data and state transitions, and design products that scale beyond the first customer.
* Technical judgment. You should be able to understand how data moves through complex systems, identify where things can break, and partner with engineering to build products that are reliable, scalable, and easy for customers to trust.
* Customer empathy and judgment: you can separate loud symptoms from root causes and build the product customers actually need.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity, make tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, design, support, implementation, and GTM teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex payroll-accounting concepts understandable to engineers, customers, executives, and GTM teams.
* Bias for ownership and follow-through. You don’t just ship features; you own whether the workflow works in production.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

Discovery, a premier global media and entertainment company, offers audiences the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of content, brands and franchises across television, film, streaming and gaming. The company combines Warner Media’s premium entertainment, sports and news assets with Discovery's leading non-fiction and international entertainment and sports businesses.

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons. and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Roles and Responsibilities :**

The Content Intelligence team is seeking a Staff-level Technical Product Manager (PM-T) to support the development and execution of AI/ML capabilities powering next-generation content localization workflows. This role focuses on context-aware localization, including transcription, subtitling, translation, captioning, audio description and dubbing workflows, as well as content intelligence capabilities that improve localization quality through scene, character, dialogue, and metadata awareness. These capabilities play a critical role in expanding the global reach, accessibility, and discoverability of WBD content by enabling content availability across more languages, markets, and audience segments.

This is a hands-on product management role with a strong emphasis on execution, cross-functional coordination, and operationalizing AI/ML capabilities within content localization workflows. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working closely with engineering and program management, and experienced in defining requirements and driving delivery for AI/ML-powered systems and backend platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with engineering and program managers to drive execution across sprint cycles, including backlog management, story writing, feature clarification, dependency management, and release planning.
* Write product requirement documents (PRDs) and define detailed functional and technical specifications for AI-powered localization workflows, including translation, dubbing, captioning, subtitle generation, audio description, editorial review, quality evaluation, and workflow orchestration systems.
* Define and support capabilities that leverage content context, including character identity, dialogue history, scene metadata, terminology, style guides, content metadata, and franchise-specific knowledge to improve localization quality and consistency.
* Support the evolution of localization workflows from asset-level processing to context-aware systems that leverage metadata, character relationships, dialogue history, content intelligence, and editorial feedback to improve quality and consistency at scale.
* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to operationalize context-aware localization systems utilizing large language models (LLMs), metadata enrichment, retrieval-based approaches, and multimodal content understanding.
* Facilitate near-term roadmap planning and coordination across engineering and partner teams supporting localization and content intelligence initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and decision-making across AI/ML engineering, media supply chain, global content operations, human-in-the-loop (HITL) operations, editorial, legal, accessibility, and external vendor partners to remove blockers, manage dependencies, and ensure successful execution of localization programs.
* Partner with Product Data Science to define and evaluate experimentation frameworks, interpret results, and assess localization quality, model performance, post-edit efficiency, workflow productivity, and business impact to inform product decisions and prioritization.
* Work with engineering and system architects to define integration requirements across localization supply chain systems, order management platforms, editorial tools, content management systems, metadata services, and adjacent AI/ML platforms.
* Assist in evaluating the impact of feature changes across adjacent systems on localization workflows and AI/ML pipelines, working with partner teams to scope dependencies and downstream effects.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across content operations, localization teams, marketing, and cross-functional technology teams to gather requirements and incorporate feedback while effectively managing the uncertainty inherent in AI/ML development.
* Partner with editorial and localization operations teams to design and optimize human-in-the-loop workflows, ensuring reviewer feedback mechanisms align with model evaluation, quality measurement, and continuous improvement objectives.
* Directly support product operations, including triaging user feedback, investigating product issues, and partnering with engineering and program management to prioritize fixes and enhancements.

**What to Bring :**

* 9–12 years of product management experience, including experience as a Technical Product Manager.
* Strong experience writing PRDs, defining features, and partnering with engineering teams through agile development and sprint execution processes.
* Familiarity with machine learning systems, including deep learning and large language models, deployed in production environments.
* Experience working with AI/ML systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, particularly those involving human-in-the-loop workflows, content processing pipelines, or post-editing workflows.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent feature tracks, dependencies, and decisions across complex systems.
* Experience translating business and operational requirements into technical product capabilities and measurable outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Background in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Familiarity with language AI technologies and media localization workflows, including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Machine Translation (MT), Large Language Models (LLMs), Text-to-Speech (TTS), dubbing, captioning, subtitling, and audio description.
* Experience with context-aware localization systems leveraging metadata, terminology management, style guides, character context, dialogue history, and retrieval-based approaches.
* Familiarity with localization quality evaluation methodologies, human-in-the-loop review processes, and post-editing workflows.
* Comfortable working with AI evaluation methodologies and quality metrics, including precision, recall, confidence scoring, translation quality assessment, and human evaluation frameworks.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Deliver scalable AI-powered localization capabilities that improve localization quality, editorial efficiency, accessibility outcomes, and operational throughput.
* Advance context-aware localization workflows by incorporating content metadata, character context, dialogue history, and editorial feedback into AI-assisted processes.
* Drive measurable improvements in localization quality, post-edit effort, consistency, accessibility coverage, and cost efficiency across global content catalogs.
* Successfully coordinate delivery across engineering, AI/ML, editorial, operations, legal, accessibility, and vendor teams while maintaining strong execution rigor and stakeholder alignment.
* Help scale the organization's localization AI capabilities by translating emerging AI technologies into operationally viable products that deliver measurable business value

**What We Offer:**

* A Great Place to work.
* Challenging ML problems in Media Domain.
* Equal opportunity employer
* Fast track growth opportunities

**How We Get Things Done…**

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at

















www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/

along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
  
  
Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APJ region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
  
  
Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
  
  
A Snapshot
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong product manager to help shape and deliver high-impact digital products at AirTrunk.
  
  
In this role, you will own the discovery, design, delivery, adoption and continuous improvement of technology-enabled products that help our teams work faster, smarter and with greater operational discipline. Depending on business priorities, these products may include internal SaaS-style applications, workflow platforms, data-enabled products, decision support tools, integrations, automation solutions and AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
You will work closely with business teams, engineering, data, AI and technology stakeholders to turn complex operational needs into clear product strategies, pragmatic roadmaps and scalable solutions. You will be comfortable operating across the full product lifecycle, from identifying the right problem to solve, through to shaping user journeys, defining requirements, partnering with engineering, managing delivery, measuring value and iterating based on feedback.
  
  
This is an ideal role for someone who combines strong product management discipline with technical depth. You do not need to be an AI product specialist, but you should be fluent in how modern product teams can use AI to improve discovery, delivery, analysis, prototyping, documentation and decision-making. You should also be able to identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation and data-driven capabilities where they genuinely improve product outcomes.
  
  
Your Day to Day
  
  
Product Ownership & Delivery
  
  
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of digital products and technology-enabled capabilities, from discovery and problem definition through to delivery, adoption, measurement and iteration.
  
  
Develop clear product visions, roadmaps, value cases and success metrics aligned to business priorities.
  
  
Page | 2
  
  
Translate complex business needs into well-structured product requirements, user stories, process flows, data needs and technical considerations.
  
  
Make clear prioritisation decisions based on user value, business impact, feasibility, risk and delivery capacity.
  
  
Bring structure and product discipline to ambiguous opportunities, helping teams move from ideas and requests to clearly defined problems, outcomes and delivery options.
  
  
Technical Product Delivery
  
  
Partner with engineering, data, AI, architecture and technology teams to design and deliver scalable products, platforms and technology-enabled capabilities.
  
  
Work across user experience, workflow design, data models, APIs, integrations, reporting, security, governance and operational support requirements.
  
  
Help shape SaaS-style and platform-based solutions that are reliable, usable, maintainable and designed for enterprise adoption.
  
  
Collaborate with technology teams to define MVPs, delivery increments and long-term product evolution.
  
  
Ensure products are designed with appropriate attention to usability, performance, resilience, data quality, security and supportability.
  
  
Balance speed, quality and scalability by making pragmatic trade-offs between immediate business value and longer-term product sustainability.
  
  
AI, Automation & Modern Product Practice
  
  
Use AI and automation tools to improve the way product work is done, including discovery synthesis, research analysis, prototyping, documentation, backlog creation, testing support and stakeholder communication.
  
  
Identify practical opportunities to embed AI, automation or data-driven decisioning into products and workflows where they create measurable value.
  
  
Promote responsible, secure and pragmatic use of AI within product delivery and product experiences.
  
  
Model modern ways of working by using AI thoughtfully to improve quality, speed, clarity and decision-making across current initiatives.
  
  
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  
Partner with business domain experts to understand operating models, pain points, workflows, decisions and user needs.
  
  
Communicate product vision, trade-offs, delivery progress, risks and value outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Facilitate alignment across business, technology, data, AI, security and operations teams.
  
  
Act as the bridge between business problems and technology solutions, ensuring delivery remains anchored to measurable outcomes.
  
  
Influence without authority across complex stakeholder groups, bringing clarity to competing priorities and helping teams make informed product decisions.
  
  
Product Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Use product analytics, telemetry, user feedback and operational data to evaluate product performance and identify improvement opportunities.
  
  
Page | 3
  
  
Drive adoption and change management in partnership with business teams, ensuring products are embedded into real ways of working.
  
  
Continuously improve product practices, templates, rituals and standards across AirTrunk’s product community.
  
  
Stay informed on modern product management, enterprise SaaS, digital platforms, AI-enabled product delivery and emerging technology trends.
  
  
Create a strong feedback loop between users, business stakeholders and delivery teams to ensure products continue to evolve based on evidence, value and changing business needs.
  
  
**Requirements**
5+ years' experience in product management, technical product management, digital product delivery, enterprise technology, SaaS products, platform products, data products or related roles.
  
  
Demonstrated experience owning products or technology-enabled capabilities through the full lifecycle, including discovery, prioritisation, delivery, adoption, measurement and continuous improvement.
  
  
Strong product management discipline, including problem discovery, user research, roadmap development, requirements definition, backlog management, Agile delivery, release planning and value measurement.
  
  
Strong technical fluency across modern software delivery, APIs, integrations, data platforms, workflow systems, cloud environments and enterprise architecture concepts.
  
  
Experience working closely with engineering, data, architecture or platform teams to deliver software products, enterprise applications, internal platforms or full-stack digital solutions.
  
  
Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  
  
Strong prioritisation and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance user value, business impact, technical complexity, delivery capacity, risk and long-term product sustainability.
  
  
Comfortable using AI and modern productivity tools to improve product workflows, accelerate analysis, support documentation, improve delivery quality and model contemporary ways of working.
  
  
Understanding of security, privacy, data governance, operational risk and responsible AI considerations in enterprise technology environments.

title: Head of Product
description:
**Head of Product — Sitrep Technologies**

**About Sitrep Technologies**

Sitrep Technologies is a new, independent clinical technology company commercialising a proven Electronic Data Capture (EDC) / eCRF platform originally built and battle-tested inside a working CRO. We are turning that internal system into a standalone software product for CROs, cosmetic and FMCG companies, biotech, and pharma — organisations that need compliant, configurable data capture without the cost and overhead of the incumbent enterprise tools.

We are small, lean, and building deliberately. This is a founding-team role with real ownership.

**The role**

As
**Head of Product**
, you own the transformation of a working internal tool into a commercial, multi-customer software product — and then its roadmap as we grow. You set product direction, translate customer needs into what gets built, own the compliance and validation documentation that regulated buyers demand, and work hand-in-hand with the Technical Lead to ship. In practice, you will operate as the senior day-to-day product and delivery leader of the business.

You report to the Founder, who holds strategic direction and governance.

**What you will own**

* **Productisation.**
  Define what it takes to move the platform from an internal tool to a sellable, multi-tenant, configurable product — and drive it to done.
* **Roadmap and prioritisation.**
  Own the product roadmap. Decide what gets built, in what order, and why, balancing customer demand against engineering capacity.
* **Customer requirements.**
  Turn conversations with CROs, sponsors, cosmetic/FMCG and pharma buyers into clear, prioritised product requirements.
* **Implementation framework.**
  Build the repeatable process for onboarding and configuring the platform for each new customer.
* **Validation and compliance documentation.**
  Own the product's regulated-software readiness — validation packages (IQ/OQ/PQ), 21 CFR Part 11 alignment, GAMP 5 / computer system validation documentation — working with our quality/compliance consultant.
* **Delivery coordination.**
  Partner closely with the Technical Lead to plan, sequence, and ship releases.

**What success looks like**

* **First 90 days:**
  a clear, costed productisation roadmap agreed with the Founder and Technical Lead; a documented view of the gap between the current internal build and a market-ready product.
* **First 6 months:**
  the platform configurable for an external customer; an implementation framework and core validation documentation in place.
* **First 9–12 months:**
  the product supporting its first external customer(s) beyond the founding CRO, with a prioritised roadmap driving the next phase.

**Must-have experience**

* Proven track record taking a
  **B2B software product from early to commercial**
  as a product owner / product manager / head of product.
* Experience in a
  **regulated or compliance-heavy software domain**
  — clinical, healthcare, life sciences, medical devices, or similar — where validation and audit requirements are part of the product, not an afterthought.
* Working knowledge of regulated-software expectations:
  **21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5 / CSV, data privacy**
  , and what enterprise/pharma procurement demands.
* Enough
  **technical depth**
  to partner credibly with engineering on architecture and trade-offs.
* Comfort operating
  **lean and hands-on**
  in an early-stage, single-product company — setting direction and also doing the work.

**Strong plus**

* Direct experience with
  **EDC, eCRF, CTMS, or clinical data systems**
  .
* Experience selling or supporting software sold to
  **CROs, sponsors, or pharma**
  .
* Exposure to
  **multi-tenant SaaS**
  productisation and configuration.
* Experience standing up a
  **QMS or pursuing SOC 2 / ISO 27001**
  .

**Who this is for**

Someone who wants founding-level ownership of a product with a real head start — a working platform and a first customer — rather than a blank page. You are comfortable being the senior operator who makes the product happen, you think commercially, and you are energised by building the company, not just the backlog.

title: Content Infrastructure Owner - Research
description:
**About LSEG**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is one of the world's leading financial markets infrastructure and data providers. The company delivers financial data, analytics, news, indices, trading, clearing, and risk management solutions to more than 44,000 customers across over 170 countries.
  
  
With a history spanning more than 300 years, LSEG plays a critical role in global financial markets by helping organizations raise capital, manage risk, make investment decisions, and meet regulatory requirements. Its businesses include Data & Analytics, FTSE Russell, Risk Intelligence, Capital Markets, and Post Trade services. Through trusted data, innovative technology, and strategic partnerships, including its collaboration with Microsoft, LSEG is driving the transformation of financial markets through cloud, analytics, and AI-powered solutions.
  
  
**Purpose:**
Driving financial stability, empowering economies, and enabling sustainable growth.
  
  
**Key Businesses:**

* Data & Analytics: Financial data, research, and analytics solutions
* FTSE Russell: Global index and benchmark provider
* Risk Intelligence: Compliance, KYC, and risk management solutions
* Capital Markets: Exchange and trading services
* Post Trade: Clearing, settlement, and trade optimization services

**About The Business**
**Broker Estimates**
provides forward-looking financial forecasts for publicly listed companies based on research analyst consensus and broker models. The coverage includes financial statement forecasts, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Segment-level estimates, Same-Store Sales (SSS), Other company-specific operational metrics. The objective is to help clients understand the expected future performance of companies.

Additionally, any successful applicant will be expected to manage these internal product capabilities to ensure new functionality is fit for purpose; that functionality is readily available to all internal customers to apply in support of LSEG Content offering which is produced to supply external and internal customers.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* BSc in Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics or
* 10+ years of financial markets and operations expertise, with demonstrated success in data operations and management

Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

,

title: Senior Director, Product Management
description:
ThoughtSpot is a Data & AI platform that helps companies turn data into enterprise advantage. We're Gartner MQ leaders with more than 1,000 customers globally and offices in Mountain View, Chicago, London, Bangalore, Sydney, and Tokyo.
  
  
**About Spotter**
Spotter is ThoughtSpot’s agentic analytics product. It reasons over governed enterprise data and shows its work, so its answers hold up in a board meeting. It covers:
  
  

* Data connectors that bring structured and unstructured data into Spotter.
* Spotter Analyst, the AI analyst inside ThoughtSpot.
* Slack and Microsoft Teams connectors that deliver answers where teams already work.
* The MCP Server, which brings Spotter into Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
* Embedded Spotter, for customers building it into their own applications.

**What You'll Do**
You’ll own a product for all of Spotter and lead the Spotter PM team, with the full backing of ThoughtSpot’s R&D organization.
  
  

* Set the strategy. Decide where Spotter goes across data, surfaces and embedding, and what to cut.
* Make trust in the product. Partner with Engineering so accuracy, reasoning and governance hold up whatever the data source and wherever the answer is delivered.
* Win every surface. Make Spotter the analytics layer people reach for in ThoughtSpot, in Slack and Teams, in AI assistants and in customers’ own applications.
* Ship in days, not quarters. Get things in front of customers early and iterate in the open.

**What You Bring**

* You’re a builder. You stay hands-on: you prototype, try the product yourself and get into the details, rather than leading from a distance.
* You’ve run a product for an AI or data platform at scale.
* You understand both end-user and developer/platform products: data integration, MCP, APIs and embedding.
* You have a strong point of view on where agentic analytics is going, and you change course fast when you’re wrong.
* You build PM teams that own their decisions.

****In-Office at ThoughtSpot****
Spotters are expected in-office 3+ days per week to be part of the energy of their local team. Momentum compounds when we're in the room together with faster decisions, sharper problem-solving, and the kind of peer learning that doesn't happen over a screen. Being in-office is our default way of working, with flexibility available where it's genuinely needed.
  
  
**About ThoughtSpot**
The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. With simple, natural language search and AI, anyone can ask questions, discover insights, and act with confidence. Unlike legacy tools that sacrifice performance for complexity, ThoughtSpot is intuitively designed for every business user while being built to handle the most complex, large-scale data, wherever it resides. This unique combination of speed and simplicity is why enterprise leaders trust ThoughtSpot to transform decision-making into a truly data-driven culture.
  
  
At ThoughtSpot, we’re a curious, data-driven bunch. We believe the world works better when everyone has access to facts. That’s why we build products that make asking and answering data questions as natural as having a conversation.
  
  
**Mandatory And Required Skills For All ThoughtSpot Roles**
Spotters are expected to demonstrate AI literacy and workflow integration to include to ability to:
  
  

* Comfortably and confidently integrate artificial intelligence into their daily workflow to increase productivity and quality.
* Hands-on experience to leverage AI tools (industry-leading LLMs) to increase productivity, automate routine tasks, and improve work quality.
* Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.
* Write effective prompts to get the most accurate and creative results from AI tools.

Spotters are expected to exemplify these key traits and AI Mindset:
  
  

* Curiosity in exploring new AI tools
* Adaptability to quickly learn and implement new, emerging AI technologies
* Critical thinking to know when to identify when AI should be used versus when human judgement is necessary

This combination of curiosity, adaptability, and discernment defines the AI mindset, and it’s required for every role at ThoughtSpot.
  
  
****AI Mindset for All Spotters****
At ThoughtSpot, we believe AI is a necessary and essential part of how we work. Every role, across every team, is expected to be fluent and comfortable with using AI to do their best work.
  
  
All Spotters are expected to experiment with ThoughtSpot’s AI tools (like Spotter and SpotterViz) and leading industry LLMs to streamline workflows, enhance output, and uncover new insights. Whether drafting content, analyzing data, or summarizing documents, AI is a daily partner. We value curiosity, openness to learning, and thoughtful application of AI to create real value. Training and resources are provided so every Spotter can confidently create with AI.
  
  
****ThoughtSpot for All****
At ThoughtSpot, diverse teams build better products. Complex data problems need many perspectives, not just one. We welcome different backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and we work to create a place where everyone can be themselves and do their best work. If this role excites you and you believe you’re a strong match, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
****What Makes ThoughtSpot a Great Place to Work?****
ThoughtSpot is the Agentic Analytics Platform that empowers every enterprise to transform insights into action, on a mission to make the world more fact driven. We hire people with unique identities, backgrounds, and perspectives - this balance-for-the-better philosophy is key to our success. When paired with our culture of Trust, Customer Obsession, Innovation and Intensity, ThoughtSpot cultivates a respectful culture that pushes norms to create world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the business and make your mark on a truly innovative company, we invite you to read more about our mission, and apply to the role that’s right for you.

title: Client Solution Owner in Making IRC302253
description:

What we offer

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross-functional execution. This is a principal-level, hands-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high-revenue initiatives - not for reporting on them - and you carry the dates yourself.
  
  
You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process - managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.
  
  
Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.
  
  
Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.
  
  

* Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.
* Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.
* Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.
* Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.

Level, Location, and Scope
  
  

* Level. Principal-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.
* Location. Bangalore-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.
* Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high-level roadmaps and delivery.
* Establish standardized stage-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high-quality, actionable requirements.
* Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over-engineering the process.
* Own end-to-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives - those involving 3+ functional teams or multi-million revenue impact - from post-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.
* Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.
* Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.
* Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.
* Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.
* Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).
* Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.
* Provide quarterly insights to the C-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.
* Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.
* Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.
* Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.
* Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.
* Proven track record of managing "Top-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth-stage or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0-to-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.
* A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.
* Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.
* Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).
* Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.
* A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real-world results.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Lead AI Product Engineer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
The role
  
  
Cogentiq I2C is Fractal’s agentic AI Product for invoice-to-cash, covering Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Invoice Management and Credit Risk. It runs on a Next.js front end, a FastAPI service layer, the Cogentiq agentic runtime, and a data tier on Azure Databricks with PostgreSQL.
  
  
You own the AI side: the agents, the models and everything that makes them accurate and dependable in front of a finance team. You design it, you lead the team that builds it, and you write code yourself.
  
  
What you will own
  
  

* Technical design of the AI side: agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool design, memory and context strategy.
* The agents across all five modules, from document extraction and matching through to the reasoning steps behind a recommendation.
* Accuracy and reliability. Evaluation sets, regression suites, and a defensible number for how well each agent performs before it ships.
* Guardrails and human oversight: confidence thresholds, escalation to a person, audit trails, and traceable reasoning for any decision touching cash.
* Predictive and machine learning models where they serve the product better than an agent does.
* Model strategy: choice of models, cost and latency per workflow, and the ability to switch providers without a rewrite.
* The interfaces between your side and the platform, agreed jointly with the engineering.

How you will work
  
  

* Lead the AI and agent engineering team. Set standards, coach engineers, and keep the team unblocked.

title: Product Manager — Travel & Hospitality Tech
description: PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months. The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it. THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived. This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it. Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs. One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development. defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped Field Ecosystem Engagement Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP) Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs Ecosystem Integration Ownership Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go-live Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why PRD and Engineering Partnership Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS Market and Regulatory Intelligence Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates Monitor hotel-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives? RequirementsREQUIREMENTS Must Have 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand-holding in every stand-up Comfort with field-heavy, travel-intensive work across India Strong Preference Has worked directly with Concur, SAP Concur integrations, or competing expense management platforms Exposure to bank lodge card programs, virtual card reconciliation, or payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, HDFC, Mastercard) Prior exposure to GST, e-invoicing, or indirect tax reconciliation Has integrated with or mapped data flows from Opera Cloud, Amadeus, Sabre, or equivalent hotel/GDS platforms Experience at a TMC, GDS, OTA, hotel chain, or hotel software company is a significant advantage
